data.jd_text:
**1 Mission** 




 The Project Director is in charge of the complete implementation of the management strategy for projects under his/her responsibility, and for which he/she has the support of resources either inside or outside the affiliate.
 



 To meet the expectations of Clients, for whom he/she is the direct and key contact, the Project Director supervises architectural and technical studies. Every decision of design modification leading to financial consequences is taken by him/her. At the same time, he/she guarantees the economic balance of the project and the respect of Quality principles. He/she also deals with all the contractual issues between Artelia Airports and its clients.
 



 In the management of studies, the Project Director supervises the project teams made available. He/she draws up and manages design contracts entered into with designers outside Artelia Airports and guarantees their functioning. With the support of the functional resources of affiliates, he/she defines the subcontracting strategy, then drafts and manages the subcontracting contracts necessary to project implementation.
 



 He/She contributes to the definition of the affiliate’s strategic focus.
 



  





**2 Line and Staff Relations** 




 The role will directly report to the Director, Production and Operations and will work in close collaboration with the following teams:
 



  




* ARTELIA AIRPORTS Staff
* Design Manager
* Contract Administrator
* Director of Tendering and Consulting
* Resident Engineer
* Planning Engineer
* Design Team, all disciplines
* Supervision Team at site
* QA/QC
* HSE
* External Collaborators
* Client Representatives
* Sub\-Consultants
* Contractors / Sub\-Contractors



  





**3 Key Responsibilities** 




 Ensures the management of signed contracts
 


* He/she negotiates the technical and financial approach to projects in his/her portfolio (with Management assisted by the Business Development)
* He/she defines the progress of the project (consistent with the Client’s specifications) and the recourse to outside resources (subcontracting)
* He/she defines the technical, budgetary and financial resources necessary
* He/she defines resources to be implemented and monitoring indicators
* He/she monitors Management’s continuous and adequate information as far as finance, technical choices and deadlines are concerned, in providing the Administrative, Financial and Human Resources Director and the Director of Production and Operations with the data necessary to their audit (Control Panels and performance indicators)
* He/she uses feedback information from the Administrative, Financial and Human Resources Director and the Director of Production and Operations in the management of his project
* He/she supervises studies and manages teams:
* breaks specifications down into study objectives and study team needs
* establishes the monitoring indicators of studies to be carried out
* directs, focuses and coordinates the group of project contributors, i.e. :
* is in charge of teams under his/her direct responsibility.
* focuses and coordinates the work of outside designers.
* coordinates the work of teams, including those teams working on the site.
* monitors subcontractors.
* monitors Artelia Airports spending and manages it in relation to projected financial schedules.
* guarantees project / Client program appropriateness (functional and technical aspects, study and finishing deadlines and target costs)
* monitors Quality and the respect of project deadlines through continuous dialogue with outside designers (optimization of economic choices, project consistency)
* contributes to the concrete production of studies
* updates the Director of Operations and Production on technical bases
* He/she manages Client relations:
* conducts the technical dialogue on the project with the Client (technical choices, functionality)
* validates the various stages of the project with the Client
* conducts the closure of services due under contracts entered into with Clients
* implements the contracts entered into with the Clients
* monitors the deadlines, quality and costs follow\-up
* is responsible to report to executive management any changes of the Artelia Airports contract
* prepares, with support from the Business Development Manager, the technical and financial files for possible complaints (follow\-up letters etc…)
* advises the Business Development Manager and Executive Management in terms on market opportunities when required
* He/she updates load plans by:
* Defining staff needs according to their skills
* Allowing or denying additional missions
* Accepting vacations
* Managing all the means needed for his project
* Contractors:
* signs all the instructions to the contractor including:
* notice to proceed and eventually to stop the works on site
* technical variation orders
* financial variation orders
* schedule variation orders
* penalty orders for delay
* validates all the contractors’ submissions and quality control plans produced by contractors or he/she can delegate such responsibility.
* He/she follows the project for Artelia Airports by :
* Following its spending and invoices
* Approving the schedule for the project
* Approving the missions and reporting it to the Managing Director
* Within the framework of his activities, the Project Director contributes, in a relevant manner, to the fulfillment of Quality objectives.



  





**4 Profile Specifications – Minimum Requirements** 



* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in airport management, planning, aviation science, or engineering.
* 15 years’ experience minimum on large size construction projects or similar transportation projects in a similar position, with a minimum of 3 airport projects references strongly preferred \- both design and site supervision.
* Thorough knowledge of engineering design, construction estimating, facility operation, project budgeting and scheduling.
* Demonstrated knowledge of capital planning and assessment, cost\-benefit analysis, planning and evaluation, and risk management protocols
* Experienced in Project Management and FIDIC contracts
* Experience in ICAO and IATA regulations is a plus
* Excellent presentation, coordination and leadership skills
* Knowledge of local laws and regulations, international codes and standards
* Fluent in English; reading, writing and speaking
* Proficiency in the use of standard Microsoft Office products, Primavera (Oracle’s Project Management software) or MS Project.
* Eligibility for frequent travels to be expected.
* SoE membership and AUH Engineering license are mandatory or proven eligibility



  





***Note to external recruiters:***
*Please note that Artelia Airports does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Recruitment Fee Agreement, Artelia Airports will not consider or agree to payment of any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without a previously signed agreement, Artelia Airports explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Artelia Airports and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Artelia Airports as a result of the referral or through other means.*

data.jd_text:
Since first going into action in 1909, the BESIX Group has over the years grown into a multidisciplinary company with a leading position in its markets: construction, property development and concessions. BESIX Contracting specializes in construction, infrastructure and marine works, often in contracts with a high level of complexity. In Benelux and France, the Group’s regional affiliates BESIX Infra, Belemco, Cobelba, Jacques Delens, Vanhout, Wust and Lux TP ensure a strong presence and a local approach. With Franki Foundations, West Construct, Socogetra, BESIX Environment and Van den Berg, the Group offers specialist niche solutions for the building market like deep foundations, geo\-engineering, road construction, water treatment and cable and pipeline construction.
   

  





 Backed by our experience in our home markets, we have built up strong positions outside Europe. A typical example is the Middle East, where over a 50 year period we have built up an impressive portfolio. This diversification in activities and geography pays off by reducing our risk exposure
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**Why This Role Matters**




 The Project Director is responsible for leading the successful delivery of large\-scale marine construction projects (USD 300M\+) across the GCC region. This role carries full accountability for project P\&L, execution strategy, and delivery performance, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
   

  





 The position requires a hands\-on leader from a Tier 1 marine contractor background, with proven experience in delivering complex marine works such as breakwaters, dredging, reclamation, quay walls, and port infrastructure within the GCC.
   

  





**What You’ll Drive**



* Supervise and coordinate activities for the successful completion of the project(s) in accordance with client requirements, organizational policies/procedures, contract terms, and specified time and cost parameters.
* Coach and mentor project managers working under them
* Establish the organizational chart and project processes to ensure the proper functioning of the support team in various sections, in accordance with company policies.
* Address processes malfunctions as needed and motivate staff effectively.
* Coordinate activities on the project(s) among different trades and departments.
* Validate contractual options, whether they are technical, financial, or time related.
* Validate legal matters, with the agreement of the Six Construct legal department.
* Manage contractual and financial follow\-up and budget control.
* Approve all engagements related to the project.
* Conclude supply and sub\-contracts after preparatory work by the support team, including pre\-contract quality and performance audits.
* Engage in social contacts and public relations to benefit the company.
* Coordinate with all third parties, negotiate with contractors, suppliers, and subcontractors throughout all stages of the project life cycle, and participate in handling tenders and contracts.
* Implement project budgets and allocate resources, enforce project standards, conduct technical reviews, manage team.


**Qualifications**

**You’re a Great Fit If You Have**



* Proven experience working with Tier 1 marine contractors
* Minimum 15\-20 years of experience in marine construction
* Currently or recently in a Project Director / Senior Project Manager role
* Strong experience in GCC region (UAE, KSA, Qatar, etc.) is mandatory
* Experienced people and team manager, seeking consensus and demonstrating good listening skills.
* Advanced understanding of contract management.
* Is a natural organizer with deep understanding of process management within an organization.
* Holds deep knowledge of marine construction works, both technically and practically.
* Has the ability to rapidly assess issues, develop alternative solutions, and implement pragmatic strategies.
* Excellent communicator, both internally and externally.
* Demonstrates proficiency in negotiating at a high level and in complex environments.
* Exhibits professionalism, an entrepreneurial spirit, and a results\-oriented approach.
* Holds a high degree of flexibility and adaptability.
* Commercially gifted.
* Fluent in English, and additional European language, such as French or Dutch, is considered an asset.
* Willingness to relocate as required by business needs


**Additional Information**

**Why You’ll Enjoy Working with Us**



* Competitive Benefits
* Positive Workplace Culture
* Opportunity to work with a leading international construction group
* Exposure to large\-scale, high\-impact projects in the Middle East
* Collaborative, diverse, and professional work environment
* Career growth and development opportunities

data.jd_text:
**INSPIRE \| EXHILARATE \| DELIGHT**
 For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.
   

  

 Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.
   

  

 Chalhoub Group fosters a people\-at\-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future\-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. Their collective efforts have earned the Group the Great Place to Work® certification in several markets.
   

  

 Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040\.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 The Transformation Program Governance Director provides strategic oversight and leadership across the Group’s multi\-year digital transformation program. This role ensures disciplined execution, strategic alignment, and value realization across all streams, while acting as the guardian of program governance, standards, and vendor accountability. Operating at Group level, this leader drives cross\-entity alignment, embeds best\-in\-class governance frameworks, and establishes the program as a benchmark for disciplined transformation delivery.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Lead executive governance for the entire digital transformation program, strategically allocating resources, budgets, and priorities to maximize business impact.
* Safeguard program outcomes by overseeing benefit realization and hold workstreams accountable for delivering measurable value and results.
* Support and challenge program leaders to ensure delivery excellence, proactively managing risks, dependencies, and barriers.
* Provide senior leadership with data\-driven insights, independent assurance, and strategic recommendations to guide decision\-making.
* Define, document and continuously evolve Group\-wide governance frameworks, standards, and policies to ensure consistent and mature program delivery.
* Establish and maintain a Transformation Governance Center of Excellence (CoE) offering tools, methodologies, and training for standardized delivery.
* Uphold governance rigor by designing and maintaining clear decision\-making structures, reporting mechanisms, and escalation protocols that ensure transparency and accountability at all levels.
* Act as a senior escalation point and manage strategic vendor relationships, ensuring partners meet contractual commitments, quality standards, and timely delivery.
* Shape vendor engagement models and collaborate with Procurement, Legal, and Finance to optimize commercial terms, risk management and cost control across all vendor engagements.
* Ensure alignment across Group entities and business units, so that transformation initiatives are integrated seamlessly into the operating model and enable scalable adoption.
* Drive transparent, timely reporting and foster collaboration across geographies and functions to maintain senior stakeholder engagement and informed executive committees and SteerCos, enabling informed decision\-making and program steering.


**What You’ll Need To Succeed**
* Proven experience in leading governance and execution for large\-scale, multi\-year digital transformation programs, ideally in a multi\-entity or international group context.
* Deep expertise in governance design, operating models, and transformation frameworks, with a track record of institutionalizing standards at Group level.
* Strong leadership and influencing skills, with the ability to engage at C\-suite and Board level.
* Demonstrated success in vendor and partner governance, including complex system integrator or technology engagements.
* Strategic thinker with operational discipline, able to balance control, flexibility, and delivery speed.
* Excellent communication, diplomacy, and stakeholder management skills across diverse cultures and functions.


**What We Can Offer You**
 With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.
   

  

 We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.
   

  

**Using GenAI in Your Application Process**
 To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.
   

  

**We Invite All Applicants to Apply**
 It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.
   

  

 We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

**About Techne Agency** 





 Techne is a boutique marketing agency operating at the intersection of brand, content and performance. We specialise in social media, content production, influencer marketing, paid media and website content, delivering integrated strategies across the full customer journey.
 





 We work with premium and luxury brands across hospitality, fashion, beauty and technology, supporting both brand\-building and performance\-driven marketing with a strong track record of results across the UK, UAE and Europe.
 





 Our teams are based across London and Dubai, working with clients on both sides — European and UAE markets. This international footprint allows us to combine cultural relevance, creative execution and performance expertise across multiple markets.
 





 As the agency continues to grow, we are building a senior leadership layer to support this expansion. We are looking for someone who can help shape the future of the business, elevate our standards and play a key role in delivering exceptional work across all clients.
 




  





**The Role** 





 We're looking for a senior operator to lead client delivery across the agency and act as the right hand to the Founder \& CEO.
 





 This is a pivotal role within Techne, offering the opportunity to take ownership of high\-profile client relationships, shape the quality and direction of our work, and build a delivery function designed to scale.
 





 This is not a traditional account management role. You will operate across multiple disciplines — combining strategic oversight, team leadership and hands\-on execution to ensure consistently exceptional output. You'll manage the team, own the day\-to\-day, and be the person who keeps everything moving to a high standard.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Client Leadership** 



* Own senior client relationships across our European and UAE portfolio, acting as the main point of contact for strategy, performance and escalation
* Lead communication and direction across retainers and projects, ensuring accounts are proactively managed
* Identify and drive growth opportunities within existing accounts and support new business where relevant
* Balance client ambition with operational feasibility — ensuring what gets sold can be delivered



**Delivery \& Standards** 



* Take full ownership of delivery across all accounts, including the transition from new business into execution
* Oversee social media, content production, influencer campaigns, paid performance, and website and editorial content
* Define clear processes and pipelines to deliver each scope item to a high standard
* Challenge output and hold a high bar for creative and strategic quality across all functions
* Understand team strengths and gaps, and step in where needed to support or unblock delivery
* Be comfortable getting hands\-on when required to demonstrate standards or solve execution challenges



**Team Leadership** 



* Manage and develop the social, content, influencer and performance team across London and Dubai
* Set clear expectations and hold the team accountable for performance and delivery
* Provide regular visibility to the Founder \& CEO on team performance, risks and priorities
* Build a culture of ownership, pace and accountability — shifting the team from reactive execution to structured, proactive delivery



**Operations \& Problem Solving** 



* Continuously review workflows, resourcing and delivery structures
* Identify inefficiencies and implement practical, scalable solutions
* Expand and improve the agency's network of vendors, tools and capabilities
* Move the team from ad\-hoc execution to structured, repeatable systems over time



**Growth \& New Business** 



* Support the CEO and the Client Growth Manager on new business pitches through strong strategic, creative and operational input
* Shape proposals, scopes and pricing aligned with both client ambition and delivery capability
* Contribute ideas to improve the agency's offering, positioning and commercial structure



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 7–10 years in a digital marketing agency environment, with at least 2–3 years at a senior account or director level
* Strong working knowledge across social media, content, influencer marketing, paid performance and website content — you don't need to execute everything, but you need to know what good looks like
* Proven experience owning client relationships and driving account growth, not just managing delivery
* Experience managing and developing junior and mid\-level team members
* Commercially aware — strong understanding of scope, resourcing and how to protect margin
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, lean agency — this is not a corporate role
* Experience working with premium or luxury brands — you understand the standard these clients expect
* Based in Dubai with UK market experience, or based in the UK with proven UAE market experience
* Highly solutions\-oriented, with a bias for action and ownership over process



  





**A Note from the Founder** 





 This role is central to the next stage of growth at Techne across London, Dubai and New York.
 





 I'm looking for someone who can take ownership of client delivery, elevate standards across the team and help build a more scalable and structured way of operating — without losing the pace and quality that defines how we work.
 





 This is not a hands\-off or purely strategic role. You'll be expected to lead from the front, bring solutions and step into execution when needed. If you're looking for a highly structured corporate environment, this likely isn't the right fit. If you're motivated by ownership, pace and building something, we should speak.

data.jd_text:
Project London is looking for a Senior Architect to join our Dubai studio as we continue to grow our presence in the UAE.
 



  





 You must be based in Dubai
 



  





 We are a London founded architecture, interiors and project management studio, now bringing the same level of process, detail, commercial rigour and client care to Dubai. Our work is primarily high end private residential, including villas, apartments, bespoke new builds, refurbishments and full interior led transformations.
 



 This is a senior role for someone who can combine strong design judgement with technical competence, site confidence and the ability to manage projects properly from concept through to completion. We are looking for someone who understands that good architecture is not just about beautiful images. It is about clear thinking, proper coordination, robust detailing, buildability, budget awareness and protecting the client’s interests throughout.
 



  





 The Role
 



 The Senior Architect will take responsibility for leading architectural design and technical delivery across a range of private residential projects in Dubai. You will work closely with the Director in Dubai, as well as our interiors, project management and procurement teams, external consultants, contractors, suppliers and client teams.
 



 You will be expected to manage projects with confidence, communicate clearly and bring order to complex design and construction processes. The right person will be comfortable working both in the studio and on site, and will have the experience to spot issues before they become problems.
 



 As Project London UAE grows, this role will offer genuine involvement in shaping how the studio operates, how projects are delivered and how we set standards in the Dubai market.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Lead architectural design packages from early concept through to detailed design and construction information.
 



 Prepare and oversee drawings, specifications, schedules and technical documentation.
 



 Develop layouts, spatial planning, elevations, sections, details and coordinated design packages.
 



 Coordinate with interior designers, MEP consultants, structural engineers, landscape designers, contractors and suppliers.
 



 Review consultant and contractor information to ensure quality, accuracy and alignment with the design intent.
 



 Support authority and developer approval processes, including Emaar, Dubai Municipality, Trakhees and relevant community or master developer requirements.
 



 Attend site meetings and carry out site inspections to review workmanship, progress and compliance with the drawings.
 



 Identify design, technical and coordination risks early and propose practical solutions.
 



 Assist with tender documentation, contractor queries and technical clarifications.
 



 Support project managers with programme, sequencing, cost control and client reporting.
 



 Maintain high standards of drawing presentation, technical accuracy and file organisation.
 



 Represent Project London professionally with clients, consultants and contractors.
 



  





 Requirements
 



 Degree in Architecture or equivalent professional qualification.
 



 Minimum 8 to 10 years’ professional experience, ideally with at least some UAE or GCC project experience.
 



 Strong experience in high end residential architecture.
 



 Excellent technical detailing and construction knowledge.
 



 Confident working across concept design, technical design, tender and construction stages.
 



 Good understanding of Dubai authority, developer and community approval processes.
 



 Strong AutoCAD skills are essential.
 



 Confident on site and comfortable challenging contractors when required.
 



 Strong coordination skills across architecture, interiors, MEP, structure and specialist suppliers.
 



 Excellent written and spoken English.
 



 Highly organised, proactive and commercially aware.
 



 Able to manage multiple workstreams without losing sight of detail.
 



 A calm, professional manner with clients and project teams.
 



  





 The Person
 



 We are looking for someone who takes pride in doing things properly. Someone who can bring design sensitivity, technical rigour and a steady hand to fast moving projects.
 



 You should be comfortable working in a growing studio environment, where everyone contributes and where standards matter. This is not a role for someone who wants to hide behind drawings. We need someone who can think, communicate, coordinate and take responsibility.
 



 You will suit the role if you are:
 



 Practical as well as creative.
 



 Detail focused without losing sight of the bigger picture.
 



 Comfortable with clients, consultants and contractors.
 



 Able to bring calm and clarity to complex situations.
 



 Interested in raising standards in the Dubai residential market.
 



  





 Why Join Project London
 



 This is an exciting opportunity to join Project London UAE at an early stage of its growth, while being backed by an established London studio with a strong reputation in high end residential architecture, interiors and project delivery.
 



 You will work closely with the Director in Dubai and have real involvement in the development of the studio, the way projects are delivered, and the standards we set as we grow. This is not a role where you will disappear into a large corporate structure. You will be close to the decision making, close to the clients and close to the work itself.
 



 We are building something carefully in Dubai, not chasing volume for the sake of it. The aim is to deliver exceptional private residential projects with the same rigour, attention to detail and client care our London clients expect.
 



 For the right person, this is a chance to help shape a growing studio, contribute meaningfully from day one and be part of a business with genuine ambition in the UAE market.
 



  





 Package
 



 Competitive salary, dependent on experience.
 



 Full time role based in Dubai.
 



 Immediate or early start preferred.
 



  





 How to Apply
 



 Please send your CV, portfolio and answers to the questions below to:
 



 sm@projectlondon.co.uk
 



 Subject line
 



 Senior Architect Application, Dubai
 



 We would particularly like to see examples of residential projects where you have been involved in technical design, coordination and site delivery, not just concept imagery.
 



  





 Application Questions
 



 Please answer the following four questions when applying. 
 **Anyone who does not answer all four questions will not be considered.** 



1. **Please summarise your relevant experience and explain why you believe you would be a strong fit for this Senior Architect role at Project London UAE. Please include the types of projects you have worked on, your level of responsibility and what you would bring to the team.**
2. **Please describe one completed residential project where you were responsible for taking the design from concept through to technical detailing, tender or site delivery. What was your role, what were the main challenges and what did you personally resolve?**
3. **In Dubai, residential projects often involve tight coordination between architecture, interiors, MEP, structure, authority approvals, contractors and suppliers. Please give an example of where you identified a coordination issue before it became a site problem. How did you handle it?**
4. **Please attach or link to one drawing package, detail sheet or technical example that best represents your own work. Briefly explain what you personally produced and why it demonstrates your suitability for this role.**

The role delivers manufacturing excellence aligned with business strategy, approved budgets, and customer requirements, while ensuring compliance with UAE regulatory authorities and international standards.

**Job Dimensions**

* Reports to: Manufacturing Operations Director
* Direct Reports: Business Unit Managers, Maintenance Manager, Supply Chain Manager, Purchase Manager, Production Engineering Manager, Contracts Manager and Finance Manager
* Functional reports: IT Lead, Regional HR Manager, HSE Manager, Quality Manager


**Key Accountabilities**
 Strategy \& Operations
   

  

* Develop and execute the manufacturing and operations strategy in alignment with business objectives.
* Deliver production targets with consistent On Time In Full (OTIF) performance and right first time quality.

* Ensure effective performance management and accountability across the Operations leadership team.

 Quality \& HSE

 Financial Performance

* Drive material and conversion cost reductions in collaboration with Procurement and Supply Chain


 People \& Leadership

**Job Description**
 The Associate Director / Technical Director – Rail will provide senior technical leadership across multidisciplinary rail projects while helping to grow the rail business in the UAE and wider Middle East market.
   

  

 The role requires broad experience across rail design and delivery, including track, civil works, stations, systems, signalling, power and operations, together with proven delivery of major rail programmes such as high\-speed rail, metro and light rail in regional and international markets.
   

  

 This position suits an experienced rail leader with strong technical credibility, established client relationships, and the ability to support project delivery, technical assurance and work\-winning across the region.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership \& Design Governance**
* Provide senior technical leadership and act as technical authority, or deputy where appropriate, on rail projects in the UAE and across the Middle East.
* Define and uphold technical standards, design principles and governance processes in line with UAE and regional authority requirements.
* Lead the delivery of multidisciplinary rail design projects as Project Director, Project Manager or Subject Matter Expert, as required.
* Lead multidisciplinary design reviews, technical approvals and assurance activities across complex rail programmes.
* Ensure compliance with international standards and regional regulations, codes and approvals processes.


**Multidisciplinary Rail Design Oversight**
 Provide technical oversight and coordination across all rail disciplines, including:
   

  

* Track \& Alignment
* Civil \& Structural Works (bridges, viaducts, tunnels, earthworks)
* Stations \& Buildings (architecture, MEP, fire \& life safety)
* Rail Systems (signalling, traction power, OCS, substations, SCADA)
* Communications \& Telecoms
* Depots \& Rolling Stock Interfaces
* Systems Integration, Interfaces \& RAMS


 Ensure coordination and technical consistency across disciplines to deliver safe, operable and integrated rail systems.
   

  

**Business Development \& Client Engagement**
* Play a leading role in business development and work\-winning across the Middle East rail market.
* Shape bid strategies, technical solutions, delivery methodologies and fee proposals for priority rail opportunities.
* Act as a senior technical representative in client meetings, workshops, presentations and bid interviews.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with government entities, rail authorities, operators, developers and contractors across the UAE and wider region.
* Contribute to pipeline growth, key account development, market intelligence and strategic positioning for rail in the Middle East.


**Project Delivery Support**
* Work with Project Directors and discipline leads to support the successful delivery of major rail programmes across the UAE and Middle East.
* Resolve complex technical, interface and systems integration issues across multidisciplinary rail projects.
* Support technical review of contractor submissions, authority submissions and design deliverables.
* Provide technical input during construction, testing and commissioning phases where required.
* Promote high standards of design quality, safety and engineering excellence.
* Support the application of RAMS, safety assurance and risk management processes.
* Proactively identify technical and integration risks and support mitigation strategies.
* Ensure full compliance with regional and local QHSE requirements.


**Quality, Safety \& Risk**
* Promote high standards of design quality, safety and engineering excellence.
* Support the application of RAMS, safety assurance and risk management processes.
* Proactively identify technical and integration risks and support mitigation strategies.
* Ensure full compliance with regional and local QHSE requirements.


**People \& Capability Development**
* Mentor and develop engineers and discipline leads across the Middle East rail team.
* Collaborate effectively with global rail colleagues and contribute to cross\-region technical excellence.
* Support recruitment, succession planning and capability growth to meet the expanding Middle East rail market.
* Promote knowledge sharing, lessons learned and regional best practice across the business.


**Qualifications**
* Degree in Civil, Railway or Systems Engineering; a Master’s degree is advantageous.
* Chartered Engineer status, or the ability to demonstrate progress toward chartership.
* Typically 15 to 18\+ years of experience in rail engineering and rail design consultancy.
* Proven rail project experience in the UAE and/or Middle East, including familiarity with regional authorities, standards and approvals processes.
* Strong multidisciplinary rail background with experience across the full project lifecycle and a track record of rail design and delivery.
* Experience leading bids, proposals, client engagement and business development activities.
* Ability to operate confidently in a client\-facing technical leadership role.
* Strong technical credibility across rail disciplines, with systems\-thinking and problem\-solving capability.
* Strong commercial acumen, with experience supporting bids, client frameworks and market growth.
* Client\-focused, collaborative and credible with senior stakeholders.
* Clear communicator with the ability to influence clients, partners and internal stakeholders.

Experience a fast\-paced, multicultural environment where your expertise in human resources will contribute to building a world\-class employee experience while advancing your own career on a global stage.
   

  

 As the
 **Project Manager – Transformation Lead (2 Year Temporary Contract)** 
 , you will act as the lead for a HR rewards technology transformation programme, owning the end\-to\-end delivery across the business. As the key interface between HR, the business, and technical development teams, you will translate business needs into clear technical requirements, drive alignment, and ensure solutions are fit\-for\-purpose. You will lead the change strategy, ensuring strong stakeholder engagement, effective communication, and a structured approach to implementation, adoption, and embedding of new systems and ways of working to deliver measurable business impact.

 Qualification
   

  

 To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:

* Demonstrable exposure to project management, change implementation and systems development management.
* Experience using project management tools, application support and business analysis methodologies.


 Emirates Group is an international organisation with employees from over 170 nationalities, we encourage applications from across the globe. Your application journey begins by applying via the Emirates Group Careers website. Please ensure your CV is up to date for our talent acquisition team to review your profile. If you are shortlisted, you will then be invited to interview with our hiring managers. If you are successful, your recruiter will reach out to you with an offer and then our Onboarding team will ensure a smooth transition to your new role at Emirates Group.

**Job Title:** 
 Chief Internal Audit \- Manager Level (Emirati)
 



**Department:** 
 Internal Audit Office

 Control and Audit

 13
 



**Reports To:** 
 Director of the Internal Audit Office

 None
 



  





 Job Purpose
 



 To audit and verify the extent to which the Authority and its organizational units comply with administrative, operational, and financial procedures, regulations, and policies, after conducting risk assessments and preparing independent and objective reports and recommendations to increase the effectiveness and efficiency of those procedures.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Functional Responsibilities
 


* Conduct risk assessment interviews with managers of technical departments as well as heads of non\-technical departments, and participate in the preparation of the strategic and annual internal audit plan in light of the results/practice of the risk assessment.
* Exercising professional care in carrying out audit engagements related to the financial, operational, legal, and technical aspects of the organization.
* Directing internal auditors to conduct interviews, review documents, develop and administer surveys, and prepare urgent memos, working papers, and document issues and recommendations related to audit work.
* Ensuring the quality of work performed by internal auditors.
* Developing risk\-based audit programs.
* Conducting audit tests in defined areas and identifying reportable issues.
* Reviewing the adequacy of the internal control design and providing recommendations for its improvement.
* Ensuring timely execution and completion of engagements in accordance with the audit plan.
* Performing special tasks, e.g., investigations, management consultations, and independent reviews in areas related to anti\-fraud, risk management, and any other relevant areas.
* Executing tasks assigned by the Director of the Internal Audit Office based on requests from the Chairman of the Board.
* Preparing draft reports, quality assurance stage reports.
* Conducting preliminary/final audit engagement meetings.
* Preparing and archiving audit files for completed audit engagements and reviewing audit documents uploaded via the Audit Office tool.
* Coordinating with management (under the supervision of the Director of the Internal Audit Office) to discuss external audit engagements in terms of defining the scope, audit plan, observations, etc., to obtain maximum assurance and avoid duplication of audit efforts.
* Following up with operations officers to verify the status of execution work, updating the follow\-up schedule based on the results of follow\-up work, and preparing audit and follow\-up reports for review by the Director of the Internal Audit Office.
* Ensure compliance with the Internal Audit Methodology, the Internal Audit Charter, and relevant management policies and standard operating procedures to ensure efficient work performance and adherence to the Authority's rules, standards, policies, and procedures, as well as applicable laws and regulations in the UAE and other relevant documents.
* Organizational documents such as the Internal Audit Charter (at the manual level).
* Contribute to identifying opportunities for continuous improvement of processes, systems, and practices, taking into account international best practices, improving business processes, reducing costs, and enhancing productivity.
* Assist the Director of the Internal Audit Office in developing training and continuing development programs, and follow up on professional development activities, including internal and external training, membership in professional associations, and sharing acquired information with colleagues.
* Prepare audit reports for review by the Director of the Internal Audit Office and submit audit findings and project consultancy reports via written reports presented to the Director of the Internal Audit Office.
* Prepare audit and follow\-up reports.
* Maintain adequate records of audit reports issued to management.
* Prepare and compile presentation/documentation materials for review by the Chairman of the Board or senior management for review by the Director of the Internal Audit Office.
* Prepare a conflict of interest report and submit it to the Director of the Internal Audit Office.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities related to the position and as assigned.



 Operational Responsibilities
 


* Provide support in analyzing data periodically and as requested, and present it to leadership to support decision\-making.
* Report any operational risks or obstacles to achieving its goals and objectives.



 Financial Management
 


* Ensure alignment with relevant financial policies and procedures in place for the function.



 Stakeholder Management

* All Organizational Units within the Authority.



  





**Key External Stakeholders** 



* Relevant Semi\-Government and Private Entities.

 Required Qualifications
 



  





**Academic Qualifications** 




**Professional Experience and Skills** 



* 6\+ years of relevant work experience.
* Professional certifications such as CPA, CIA, CMA, or CFE.
* Data collection and analysis.
* Knowledge of best practices in auditing, professional standards, and ethics standards issued by the Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) and any related future changes.
* Management, processing, and implementation of compliance procedures.
* Innovative problem solver, able to find actionable solutions and resolve complaints.

**Human Resources Director** 




**Location:** 
 Dubai, United Arab Emirates
 



  





 Role Overview:
 



 We are seeking an experienced Human Resources Director to lead the HR function for a growing construction business based in Dubai. This role will focus heavily on talent acquisition, workforce planning, compensation and benefits strategy, and building scalable HR frameworks to support project\-based operations across the UAE and wider region.
 



 The HR Director will act as a strategic partner to executive leadership, ensuring the organisation attracts, develops, and retains top\-tier talent while maintaining compliance with UAE labour laws and industry regulations.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning
 


* Develop and implement a comprehensive talent acquisition strategy aligned with business growth and project pipeline demands.
* Lead high\-volume recruitment across technical, engineering, project management, and corporate functions.
* Build strong talent pipelines for critical construction roles (e.g., project directors, engineers, quantity surveyors, site managers).
* Establish employer branding initiatives to position the company as an employer of choice within the construction sector.
* Oversee recruitment partners, agencies, and international hiring campaigns where required.
* Implement workforce planning models to ensure manpower forecasting aligns with project timelines.



 2\. Compensation \& Benefits
 


* Design and implement competitive compensation and benefits frameworks aligned with market benchmarks in the UAE construction industry.
* Lead salary benchmarking exercises and ensure internal equity across roles and geographies.
* Develop incentive schemes linked to project performance and business outcomes.
* Oversee benefits administration including health insurance, allowances, bonuses, and expatriate packages.
* Ensure compliance with WPS (Wage Protection System) and UAE Labour Law requirements.



 3\. HR Strategy \& Leadership
 


* Develop and execute the overall HR strategy in alignment with business objectives.
* Establish HR policies, procedures, and governance frameworks suitable for a project\-driven environment.
* Lead organisational design initiatives to support business expansion.
* Provide strategic counsel to senior leadership on people\-related matters.



 4\. Employee Relations \& Compliance
 


* Ensure full compliance with UAE Labour Law and regulatory requirements.
* Oversee employee relations matters including disciplinary processes and conflict resolution.
* Develop retention and engagement strategies to reduce turnover across site\-based and corporate employees.



 5\. Performance Management \& Development
 


* Implement performance management frameworks aligned with KPIs and project milestones.
* Support leadership development and succession planning initiatives.
* Promote a culture of accountability, safety, and high performance.



  





 Candidate Profile
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field (Master’s degree preferred).
* 12\+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role within construction, engineering, or infrastructure sectors.
* Strong expertise in talent acquisition within project\-based environments.
* Proven experience designing compensation and benefits frameworks in the UAE market.
* In\-depth knowledge of UAE Labour Law and HR compliance requirements.
* Experience managing multi\-site or geographically dispersed workforces.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
* Professional HR certification (CIPD, SHRM, or equivalent) preferred.

We're a Dubai\-based IT solutions studio specialising in structured cabling, enterprise networking, AV integration, CCTV, access control, cybersecurity, and full IT fit\-out delivery.
 



 Our clients include financial institutions, private equity offices, family offices, real estate developers, and professional services firms across the UAE.
 



  





 We operate as a senior\-engineer studio, not a volume contractor.
 



 Every project is led by experienced engineers, and our reputation is built on precision, technical depth, and trusted client relationships.
 



  





 We're hiring a Sales Manager to build our commercial function from the ground up.
 



 You'll design and execute the sales strategy, recruit and develop a team of three Sales Executives, and take full ownership of pipeline growth across project\-based and managed service revenue streams.
 



  





 You'll report directly to the Managing Director and play a central role in shaping the next phase of the company's growth.
 



  





**Expectations** 




 → Build and lead a sales team of three, defining territories, vertical specialisations, and individual KPIs
 



 → Own the full sales cycle — from outbound prospecting through to contract signature
 



 → Develop pipeline across structured cabling, AV, networking, CCTV, access control, and managed IT services
 



 → Implement CRM processes and forecasting disciplines to track pipeline health and conversion
 



 → Drive outbound activity via LinkedIn, email sequences, industry events, and direct engagement
 



 → Build a referral network across fit\-out contractors, MEP consultants, and facilities management companies
 



 → Identify cross\-sell and upsell opportunities — turning project wins into recurring managed service contracts
 



 → Represent OPS IT at industry events and networking opportunities across Dubai and Abu Dhabi
 



  





**Your Team** 




 You'll recruit and develop three Sales Executives, each with a defined focus:
 



  





 1\. Projects \& Fit\-Outs — new\-build and fit\-out opportunities through contractor partnerships and construction announcements
 



 2\. Enterprise \& Managed Services — recurring revenue through IT support contracts and network monitoring agreements
 



 3\. Financial Services \& Regulated Sectors — DIFC and ADGM corridors, targeting PE offices, family offices, and regulated entities
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 • 5\+ years of B2B sales experience, with at least 2 years leading or managing a sales team
 



 • Track record of hitting revenue targets in the UAE market
 



 • Experience selling IT infrastructure, technology solutions, AV, or related services to commercial clients
 



 • Proven ability to recruit and develop high\-performing salespeople
 



 • Strong understanding of the UAE commercial real estate, construction, and fit\-out landscape
 



 • Proficiency with CRM platforms and sales enablement tools
 



 • Excellent English communication skills — Arabic is a strong advantage
 



  





**Nice to Have** 




 • Existing network among facilities managers, IT managers, and procurement teams in the UAE
 



 • Experience selling into regulated sectors (DIFC, ADGM, healthcare)
 



 • Familiarity with Apollo.io, HubSpot, or similar outbound platforms
 



 • Conversational understanding of networking, structured cabling, or AV technologies
 



  





**What We Offer** 




 • Competitive base salary \+ performance\-based commission tied to team revenue
 



 • Company vehicle or vehicle allowance
 



 • Mobile phone
 



 • Medical insurance
 



 • Direct line to the Managing Director — no layers, no bureaucracy

 Are you energized by partnering with senior leaders to enable business success through people\-focused solutions? As Head of HR, you will work closely with leaders and their leadership teams across the Middle East with focus on UAE and Saudi\-Arabia to support the delivery of the people agenda.
   

  

 In this role, you will act as a trusted HR advisor on a broad range of people and organizational topics, helping leaders translate business priorities into effective people actions and play an important role in supporting leadership teams through change, organizational development, talent decisions, and workforce planning.
   

  

 This role combines senior HR partnering with hands\-on execution of (a.o.) HR cycle topics.

**Strategic HR Leadership \& People Advisory**
* Act as a strategic advisor to Executive Management on all HR and workforce\-related matters
* Partner with leaders to design organizations that effectively support both operational and office\-based teams
* Translate business priorities into practical people\-centered actions that resonate across all workforce segments
* Lead employee relations initiatives, including dispute resolution and organizational interventions

* Oversee recruitment, onboarding, and employee lifecycle processes
* Partner with leadership on hiring strategies, workforce structures, and succession planning
* Ensure smooth onboarding and integration, especially for expatriate and site\-based employees
* Ensure attraction, development, and retention of talent while maintaining workforce stability

* Ensure fair, consistent, and legally compliant HR practices
* Develop and implement HR policies and conduct audits to ensure governance and continuous improvement


**Performance, Development \& Engagement**
* Implement performance management practices aligned with business goals
* Support leaders in driving performance through effective people management
* Drive career development, succession planning, and talent initiatives
* Foster a high\-performance culture while ensuring employee engagement and sustainable workloads


**Compensation, Benefits \& Employee Value Proposition**
* Design and manage competitive compensation and benefits structures
* Lead salary benchmarking, job evaluations, and incentive programs
* Enhance benefits and offerings to meet both organizational and employee needs


**HR Operations, Systems \& Employee Experience**

* Proven experience in employee relations, labor law, and workforce management
* Experience supporting organizational change and leadership decision\-making
* A collaborative style and confidence working across all levels

* Experience in HR transformation and project management


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strategic thinking and business acumen
* Leadership and stakeholder management
* Change management and transformation expertise
* Communication and influencing skills
* Strong business understanding and the ability to translate business priorities into people actions
* Analytical and problem\-solving abilities an end\-to\-end experience which anchors improved performance
* A pragmatic, resilient, and solutions\-oriented mindset
* The ability to work effectively in a dynamic and fast\-changing environment

 You will report to Global HR BP ICS of VL and work closely with the regional VL and VI HR colleagues, and HR Functions and HR Service team.

 We’re building an ecosystem of digital products and services that power everyday life across the Middle East \- fast, scalable, and deeply customer\-centric.  Noon’s fastest hyper\-local delivery platform, Noon Minutes, offers a localized assortment of FMCG \& grocery products with delivery within 15\-minutes. Currently live across the UAE and Saudi Arabia, offering thousands of products to customers in record time.
 



  





 noon’s mission: Every door, every day.
 



  





**What you'll do:** 




 Oversee daily production operations in the cold kitchen facility, ensuring production targets are met while maintaining food safety standards. Manage workflow, monitor team performance, control wastage, and coordinate order fulfilment to dark stores.  , part of the Investment Corporation of Dubai, is a leading GCC construction group with over two decades of success delivering some of the region’s most complex and high\-profile projects. As a publicly listed company, ALEC continues to set benchmarks in quality, innovation, and operational excellence across the Middle East.
 



 ALEC Holdings serves as the central hub for governance, finance, risk, and shared services, enabling business units across the Group to operate with consistency, control, and confidence.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 As a
 **Risk \& Internal Audit Senior Analyst** 
 , you will play a key role in strengthening ALEC’s governance framework and supporting informed decision\-making across the organisation. Your work will directly contribute to improving internal controls, managing risk, and enhancing operational efficiency across diverse business units.
 



 At ALEC, we don’t just build iconic projects, we build strong, sustainable businesses and exceptional careers.
 



  





**About Your Team** 




 Our Risk \& Internal Audit function operates within a
 **lean, high\-impact structure** 
 , currently consisting of two team members, including this role.
 



 Reporting directly to the Head of Risk \& Internal Audit, you will work closely with finance, operations, and senior stakeholders across the business. The team operates in a
 **hands\-on, delivery\-focused environment** 
 , where individuals are expected to take ownership of their work and contribute both from an execution and advisory perspective.
 



 This is a role suited to someone who is
 **self\-sufficient, proactive, and comfortable working with minimal supervision** 
 , while engaging confidently with senior stakeholders across the organisation.
 



  





**Your Role** 




**As a Risk \& Internal Audit Senior Analyst, you will:** 



* Support the delivery of enterprise risk management and internal audit activities across the Group
* Plan and execute risk\-based internal audit engagements end\-to\-end
* Perform detailed risk assessments and maintain up\-to\-date risk registers
* Identify control gaps, inefficiencies, and emerging risks
* Evaluate compliance with internal policies, procedures, contracts, and regulatory requirements
* Analyse business processes and recommend practical, risk\-based improvements
* Prepare clear audit working papers and structured reports with actionable insights
* Engage with stakeholders to validate findings and support implementation of recommendations
* Track audit actions and follow up on management responses
* Support fraud reviews, investigations, and special assignments
* Contribute to audit innovation, including tools, templates, and data analytics initiatives
* Provide guidance and support to junior team members where required



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




**Must\-Have Skills \& Attributes** 



* Strong knowledge of internal audit, risk management, and control frameworks
* Ability to work independently and manage end\-to\-end audit and risk activities
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the confidence to challenge and influence
* A proactive, direct, and confident communication style
* High levels of integrity, objectivity, and attention to detail



  





**What Will Set You Apart** 



* Experience in project\-based industries such as construction, engineering, or contracting
* Ability to operate effectively in lean teams without heavy structure or supervision
* A practical, commercially aware approach to risk and audit



  





**Experience We Value** 



* Strong background in
 **construction, contracting, or engineering sectors** 
 (essential)
* Experience within
 **large\-scale project environments** 
 (infrastructure, real estate, EPC)
* Exposure to complex delivery environments with multiple stakeholders and subcontractors
* UAE experience is preferred but not mandatory



  





**Qualifications \& Background** 



* Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related discipline
* Professional certification such as
 **CPA, CA, ACCA, or CIA** 
 (strongly preferred)
* Big 4 experience in audit, risk advisory, or assurance is highly desirable
* Minimum 5 years’ experience in internal audit, enterprise risk management, or similar roles
* Experience supporting construction or engineering clients (either in\-house or advisory)



  





**What We Offer** 




 · The chance to contribute to some of UAE’s most iconic projects.
 



 · A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.
 



 · Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.
 



  





**Ready to shape the future of digital construction?** 




 If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.
 



 Join ALEC Building and play a pivotal role in delivering digitally driven, high\-quality construction projects.
 



  





**Apply today and be part of something excellent!** 




  





*Please note we encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as this advert may close once we’ve found the right candidate. Although we can’t respond to every application, we want to thank you for taking the time to apply and for considering a future with us.*

data.jd_text:
The Executive Assistant (EA) will report to the Head of Middle East. This is a key role within the Middle East team. The successful candidate will bring substantial EA experience, gained within an international Law Firm(s) based in the Middle East. A high level of professionalism, discretion and commercial awareness is essential.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 This is a full\-time, fixed\-term position of up to eight months to cover maternity leave. Working hours are Monday to Friday, 9 00am to 6 00pm, with the option to work from home one day per week.
   

  




  


  

  

 We are seeking an agile, highly organised and responsive professional who is passionate about providing outstanding EA support to the Head of Middle East and contributing positively to the wider team. The role requires someone who can proactively manage competing priorities, build strong working relationships with stakeholders at all levels, and consistently deliver work to a high standard. The ideal candidate will take pride in going above and beyond, while exercising sound judgement and maintaining confidentiality at all times.
   

  

 Please note that, as part of the recruitment process, successful shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete Numeracy, Comprehension and Prioritisation assessments, which will take approximately 60 minutes in total.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Roles and Responsibilities
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Executive support, Diary \& Stakeholder Management
   

  

  
   

  




  


 This may include but is not limited to the following
   

  

 •Proactively manage the Head of Middle East’s complex and high‑volume diary, including scheduling internal and external meetings across multiple time zones, often involving numerous senior stakeholders with competing priorities.
   

  

 •Act as a gatekeeper for the Head of Middle East, triaging meeting requests, queries, issues and complaints, redirecting appropriately while ensuring matters are dealt with effectively and without unnecessary involvement from the Head.
   

  

 •Prepare agendas, attend meetings where the Head of Middle East is attending or chairing, take detailed notes and action logs, and proactively follow up with action owners to ensure completion within agreed timeframes.
   

  

 •Attend additional meetings alongside or on behalf of the Head of Middle East where appropriate, independently managing follow‑up actions and keeping the Head fully briefed.
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East with strategic and commercial decision‑making by proactively preparing briefing materials, summaries, background information and data to ensure decisions are well‑informed.
   

  

 •Anticipate information requirements and liaise with Finance, BD, HR, Compliance and other Business Operations teams to ensure relevant input is available in advance of key meetings or decisions.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Travel, Logistics \& Trip Optimisation
   

  

 •Arrange end‑to‑end complex travel for the Head of Middle East, including multi‑destination international itineraries, coordination of different modes of transport, accommodation and airport transfers.
   

  

 •Manage all visas, permits and travel documentation, ensuring sufficient lead time and compliance with jurisdiction‑specific requirements.
   

  

 •Provide strategic input into travel planning, designing trips that maximise effectiveness by combining multiple objectives (client meetings, internal meetings, events and business development) into a single itinerary where possible.
   

  

 •Liaise extensively with colleagues across offices and business functions to ensure a joined‑up firm approach and maximise the value of each trip.
   

  

 •Remain flexible and responsive, managing last‑minute changes to travel and schedules calmly and efficiently when required.
   

  

 •Prepare detailed post‑trip reports summarising meetings held, key outcomes, opportunities identified and agreed next steps, for circulation to relevant internal stakeholders.
   

  

 •Ensure all follow‑up meetings and actions arising from travel are diarised promptly, tracked and progressed to completion.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Marketing / Business Development Support
   

  

 •Manage speaking engagements and thought‑leadership commitments, including tracking article and submission deadlines, coordinating preparatory research, and drafting briefing materials such as panel questions or speaker scripts.
   

  

 •Arrange and coordinate preparatory and briefing meetings in advance of panels, speaking slots or publications, ensuring the Head of Middle East is fully prepared.
   

  

 •Liaise with the Knowledge team and other internal stakeholders to obtain research support and background material where required, to ensure contributions are accurate, relevant and high quality.
   

  

 •Register the Head of Middle East for events when instructed and prepare comprehensive pre‑event briefings, including attendee information and engagement objectives, to maximise the value of attendance.
   

  

 •Working with the Head of Middle East and Business Development teams to maintain up‑to‑date client target lists.
   

  

 •Track and maintain updates on client target status, ensuring actions and deliverables assigned to relationship partners are followed up and progressed.
   

  

 •Provide regular status updates to the Head of Middle East on progress, upcoming actions and any slippage against agreed objectives.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Billing, Finance \& Expenses
   

  

 •Manage the full monthly billing process for the Head of Middle East’s matters, maintaining detailed knowledge of client fee agreements, caps and billing arrangements.
   

  

 •Prepare draft bills for approval, liaise with Finance as required, and issue final approved invoices to clients in their preferred format with appropriate covering correspondence.
   

  

 •Manage client billing queries in coordination with Finance and the Head of Middle East.
   

  

 •Maintain oversight of expense submissions for the Head of Middle East, including liaising directly with vendors (restaurants and transport providers etc) to obtain duplicate receipts or supporting documentation where receipts were not provided or have been misplaced.
   

  

 •Ensure expenses are accurately described, correctly coded and supported by appropriate budget holder approval in line with firm policy.
   

  

 •Proactively follow up with clients regarding outstanding invoices and payments, providing regular updates to the Head of Middle East and keeping the Billing and Finance teams fully informed of progress, issues or agreed payment timelines.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Performance \& People Processes
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East throughout the performance review process, ensuring review meetings are scheduled in line with firm‑wide deadlines.
   

  

 •Prepare performance review meeting packs, ensuring all required documentation and financial data are available in advance.
   

  

 •Proactively monitor and follow up to ensure reviewees complete required system inputs ahead of meetings.
   

  

 •Attend performance review meetings to take detailed notes and assist the Head of Middle East during discussions.
   

  

 •Support completion of post‑meeting evaluations, notes and system requirements, ensuring timely and accurate submission.
   

  

 •Maintain oversight of outstanding actions arising from performance reviews.
   

  

 •Maintain close and regular communication with HR throughout the performance review cycle, ensuring awareness of progress, confirming deadlines, understanding process or system changes, and ensuring all requirements are met accurately and on time.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 CRM \& Relationship Management
   

  

 •Maintain and update the Head of Middle East’s contacts and relationship data in InterAction, ensuring activities, meetings and relationship notes are accurately recorded.
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East in managing and maintaining effective working relationships with other law firms and referrers, supporting collaboration across jurisdictions.
   

  

 •Track inbound and outbound referrals between the firm and external law firms, ensuring referrals are recorded accurately and progress is monitored.
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East in ensuring referral relationships are actively maintained, with appropriate follow‑up on agreed actions and opportunities.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Recruitment \& Business Operations Liaison
   

  

 •Maintain oversight of Middle East recruitment activity, liaising with HR and providing regular updates to the Head of Middle East.
   

  

 •Act as a key coordination point with Business Operations functions (HR, Finance, BD, Compliance, IT and Operations), ensuring strong communication, alignment and effective delivery of initiatives impacting the region.
   

  

 •Establish regular Middle East Operations meetings, ensuring all Business Operations functions are kept informed, aligned and engaged on regional matters.
   

  

 •Use these forums to share relevant knowledge or developments that may impact specific functions, agree deliverables, and capture upcoming activities, deadline changes and requirements that should be on the Head of Middle East’s radar.
   

  

 •Ensure key outputs from Middle East Operations meetings are fed into agendas and briefing materials for wider Middle East leadership or team meetings, promoting alignment and proactive planning across the region.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Person Specification
   

  

 •Proven experience as an Executive Assistant, Legal PA or similar role supporting a senior Partner or regional lead, ideally within an international law firm or professional services environment.
   

  

 •Demonstrable experience managing complex diaries and multi‑time‑zone scheduling for senior stakeholders.
   

  

 •Strong experience arranging complex international travel, including multi‑destination itineraries, visas and short‑notice changes.
   

  

 •Experience supporting billing and financial processes, including preparation of draft bills, liaising with Finance and following up on client payments.
   

  

 •Experience supporting people and performance review processes, including scheduling review meetings, preparing documentation and assisting with system requirements.
   

  

 •Experience working closely with HR, Finance, BD, Compliance and other Business Operations teams, with the ability to coordinate and track actions effectively.
   

  

 •Highly organised, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment.
   

  

 •Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence drafting correspondence and reports on behalf of a senior leader.
   

  

 •Ability to exercise sound judgement, discretion and confidentiality when handling sensitive matters.
   

  

 •Proactive, flexible and resilient, with the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities.
   

  

 •Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, with experience using practice management, CRM and expense management systems.
   

  

 •Professional, client‑focused approach, with the confidence to liaise directly with senior internal stakeholders and clients.
   

  

 •Fluent written and spoken English.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Benefits include (but are not limited to)
   

  

 •Competitive salary (negotiable depending on experience)
   

  

 •Premium international medical, dental, and optical insurance
   

  

 •30 days of annual leave
   

  

 •Employee Assistance Programme
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Competencies
   

  

 •Working together
   

  

 •Integrity and respect
   

  

 •Inclusive
   

  

 •Personal impact and growth
   

  

 •Driving high standards
   

  

 •Commercial mindset
   

  

 •Client \- centric
   

  

 •Responsible

data.jd_text:
**Who We Are:** 
 At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award\-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest\-growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
   

  

**Summary:** 
 We're seeking a strategic and hands\-on
 **Head of Post\-Production** 
 to lead and elevate Huda Beauty's video content function. In this role, you will own the post\-production vision across brand campaigns, social\-first content, and marketing initiatives, while managing and mentoring a team of four in\-house editors.
   

  

 You'll work closely with Creative, Marketing, and Social teams to ensure best\-in\-class output, efficient workflows, and consistent on\-time delivery. This role requires deep post\-production expertise, strong leadership, and the ability to operate in a fast\-paced, high\-volume content environment. You'll be responsible for setting creative and technical standards, streamlining operations, developing talent, and ensuring creative excellence from concept through final delivery.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role: highly strategic, yet hands\-on when needed \- supporting shoots, defining technical approaches, and building a scalable ecosystem of videographers and freelance partners.
   

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Manage and mentor a team of 4 editors
* Lead, plan, and manage post\-production for a full slate of video projects
* Manage post\-production schedules and traffic control
* Create and implement processes and workflows that enable the team to work efficiently and independently
* Guide team development, helping junior members grow towards independence
* Oversee branded storytelling, ensuring delivery of best\-in\-class assets in line with brand vision
* Juggle multiple high\-priority post\-production projects in various stages, ensuring deadlines are met
* Identify workflow gaps in post\-production and lead continuous improvement initiatives
* Develop and refine a distinctive Huda Beauty editing style \- color grading, motion graphics/animation, sound design
* Work closely with the Head of Agency to build efficient project tracking, workflow systems, and deadline rigor
* Be a force for innovation \- integrate AI or other new tools into video production where appropriate
* Build robust storage solutions and archives
* Maintain a network of freelancers/vendors to scale up for projects when needed


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years' experience in post\-production management or a closely related field
* Deep understanding of all areas of post‑production: editing, color grading, VFX, sound design
* Ability to manage multiple projects at once under tight deadlines
* Experience working in agency, brand in\-house, or post\-production house environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, align, and drive decisions across multiple teams
* Prior experience managing teams of 5\+ direct reports and freelancers
* Proficient with editing software (Premiere Pro is required; After Effects, etc.)
* Excellent creativity, communication, and attention to detail
* Social\-first mindset with a deep understanding of digital and platform\-native video content


**Benefits**
* Monthly "Self Love Days" (at company discretion)
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in\-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting


*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*
