**JOB TITLE**
 Director, Health and Safety \| MAF Properties \| Head Office
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The role will take a key position within the Project Management Team and serve as an integral member of the Project Management Delivery Team. In addition, the role is expected to contribute to the development of the department’s portfolio\-wide strategic initiatives. The role is primarily focused on Health and Safety leadership, requiring strong collaboration with wider project teams to ensure seamless integration of health and safety within project delivery.
   

  

**ROLE PROFILE**
* Champion Health and Safety strategic initiatives to support the development of best\-practice processes, procedures, controls, and management systems across the department.
* Lead and manage team members’ corporate and project objectives, monitoring progress and providing guidance and mentorship.
* Identify, assess, and manage key Health and Safety risks across departmental operations, project development, and construction activities.
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with consultants, contractors, project managers, and key design firms.
* Enhance the department’s and organization’s knowledge and understanding of Health and Safety practices and standards.
* Maintain awareness of regional industry trends, legislative developments, and professional standards, ensuring best practices are embedded in project delivery.
* Develop and maintain Occupational Health and Safety policies, procedures, forms, and guidelines aligned with international standards, including ISO 45001\.
* Participate in or lead post\-tender evaluations to assess compliance with Health and Safety requirements.


**Requirements**
* Master’s degree in health and safety is a plus, Diploma in HSE from a recognized body, such as National Examination Board in Occupational Safety and Health (NEBOSH) or British Safety Council.
* 15\+ years of construction work experience in Health and Safety Management.
* Proven experience in the implementation and management of Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems, including OHSAS 18001 / ISO 45001 frameworks.
* Strong capability in HSE auditing, compliance monitoring, risk management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experienced in implementing and promoting Behavior\-Based Safety (BBS) programs to strengthen safety culture and workforce engagement.
* Willingness to travel internationally or work outside the UAE when required to support project teams.

data.jd_text:
**Head of Service Operations** 




**MENA Assistance** 




  





 MENA Assistance is a regional authority in roadside, vehicle, and motorist support services, working with major automotive brands across the Middle East and North Africa. We design, manage, and govern service programmes across markets, ensuring reliable, consistent, and high\-quality delivery through controlled operational networks.
 



  





 Our focus is on delivering service performance in environments where operational discipline, control, and judgement matter.
 



  





 We are seeking a Head of Service Operations to lead and safeguard the performance and integrity of service operations across markets. This is a senior operational leadership role focused on service reliability, operational excellence, and disciplined evolution within a live, SLA\-driven environment.
 



  





 The role is suited to an experienced operator who has already held full ownership of service operations in a live environment.
 



  





 In addition to maintaining current operations, the role is responsible for ensuring that service operations expand in capability as new services, programmes, and operational initiatives are introduced, without compromising control or performance.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL DO** 




 • Lead end\-to\-end service delivery across live roadside assistance programmes, with full accountability for performance and continuity.
 



 • Ensure service levels, response times, and utilisation targets are consistently achieved and remain stable under operational pressure.
 



 • Ensure the effectiveness of the operational control layer, including dispatch, service coordination, and case management, maintaining control, consistency, and visibility across all service interactions.
 



 • Govern service provider performance to ensure compliance with agreed standards and service levels.
 



 • Lead operational response during service\-critical incidents to ensure continuity and control.
 



 • Ensure operational decisions are made with full awareness of service impact, risk, and client expectations.
 



 • Assess operational readiness for new services, enhancements, and territory launches.
 



 • Lead and operationalise the introduction of new services and operational initiatives, ensuring they are translated into executable and scalable operational processes.
 



 • Ensure that new programmes and service enhancements are implemented without destabilising live operations.
 



 • Drive disciplined improvement, including simplified KPIs, updated SOPs, and the effective use of operational systems, applications, and technologies where they deliver clear operational value.
 



 • Ensure dispatch models, service workflows, and provider network capabilities evolve in line with operational and service requirements.
 



 • Ensure effective use of operational systems, applications, and connected vehicle technologies (including BCall and telematics integrations) to support service delivery and operational control.
 



 • Provide clear, structured, and trusted visibility of service performance, operational risks, and constraints to senior leadership.
 



 • Ensure operational efficiency and cost control across service delivery, maintaining alignment between service performance, provider costs, and operational expenditure.
 



  





**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




 • Proven ownership of service operations performance within SLA\-driven, multi\-market or distributed operational environments.
 



 • Strong understanding of distributed service operations, including coordination between centralised control functions and field execution.
 



 • Proven judgement in escalation management, operational risk, and decision\-making in live service environments.
 



 • Experience operating across multiple markets or regions.
 



 • Experience leading or operationalising the introduction of new services, operational initiatives, or programme expansions within a live operational environment.
 



 • Operational understanding of vehicle systems and mobility environments, with the ability to translate differences in vehicle design (including electric vehicles, internal combustion engines, and evolving automotive technologies) into operational requirements and service delivery models.
 



 • Experience working with operational systems, applications, or connected vehicle technologies, with the ability to translate system capabilities into effective service operations.
 



 • A structured, calm, and reliable leadership style, with a strong sense of accountability.
 



  





 Automotive or mobility sector exposure is preferred. Deep mechanical expertise is not required, but operationally relevant technical understanding is expected.
 



  





 Candidates should be comfortable operating in environments where service performance is visible, measured, and accountable.
 



  





**WHY JOIN** 




 • A senior, trusted role with real ownership and accountability.
 



 • A stable operation with scope to evolve and improve thoughtfully.
 



 • Direct visibility and influence at leadership level.
 



 • Work closely with the Founder \& CEO in a role built on trust, clarity, and operational autonomy.
 



 • An organisation that values reliability, discipline, and long\-term service quality.
 



  





**FINAL NOTE** 




 This role will suit operators who take pride in delivering consistently high service standards and who understand that operational excellence is built through discipline, clarity, and controlled execution over time.
 



  





 It is particularly suited to individuals who can maintain control in live environments while also building the capability required for future services and operational growth.
 








**This role is not suited to candidates stepping into full operational ownership for the first time.**

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a dedicated Associate Director to lead Enablement efforts across Client Management teams within the UAE and MENA region. This role plays a pivotal part in championing standardised procedures and best practices to enhance operational excellence and risk management. You will be instrumental in fostering a culture committed to zero operational loss and first\-time right execution, acting as a subject matter expert and advisor.
   

  

**Strategy \& Enablement Standards**
* Lead the consistent implementation of Department Operating Instructions (DOIs) and embed standard work methodologies across client\-facing teams to ensure operational consistency and compliance.
* Promote a collaborative and consultative approach to risk mitigation by engaging with stakeholders to identify and address potential risk issues proactively.
* Drive the development of a transparent and open communication culture with auditors and regulators, ensuring engagement aligns with regulatory expectations.
* Elevate client management capabilities by embedding robust governance frameworks and risk reporting best practices.
* Serve as an expert resource, facilitating a culture focused on precision and operational integrity within the teams.


**Business Collaboration**
* Provide critical support for regulatory inspections and audit inquiries related to client management operations.
* Build and maintain effective cross\-functional relationships with Business Units, Finance, Risk, Technology, and Operations to align objectives and enhance team performance.
* Undertake special projects and responsibilities as assigned by the Line Manager and Country Head, ensuring delivery of agreed outcomes.


**Process Management – Credit Documentation**
* Oversee and execute key credit fulfilment processes, including comprehensive BCA reviews, preparation and validation of facility documentation, and management of security documentation.
* Ensure timely and accurate execution of the Key Control Self\-Assessment (KCSA) and Control Standard Test (CST) processes, maintaining strict adherence to internal control guidelines and deadlines.
* Monitor collateral valuations, document expirations, and ensure the issuance and discharge of credit limits are conducted seamlessly to support business needs.


**Core Responsibilities**
 In this role, you will undertake a wide range of responsibilities designed to support and enhance client management operations and compliance frameworks. Your key duties will include:
   

  

* Strategic Enablement: Lead initiatives to harmonise department operational procedures, ensuring teams consistently adhere to established standards and regulatory guidelines.
* Risk Mitigation: Partner closely with risk and compliance units to implement proactive strategies that identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks within client management processes.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Develop and nurture transparent communication channels with internal and external stakeholders including auditors and regulatory bodies to foster trust and compliance.
* Operational Excellence: Champion a culture of continuous improvement by providing training, guidance and support to Client Management teams aimed at enhancing accuracy, efficiency and first\-time right outputs.
* Credit Documentation Oversight: Manage and execute critical credit documentation tasks, ensuring all legal and procedural standards are met and documentation lifecycle is properly maintained.
* Reporting \& Controls: Oversee the implementation and monitoring of key controls such as KCSA and CST, ensuring timely completion and accurate reporting to uphold governance standards.
* Cross\-functional Collaboration: Engage proactively with various business units, technology, finance, and operations to streamline workflows, solve complex challenges, and contribute to collective growth.


**About Standard Chartered**
 Standard Chartered is a global banking group with a long\-standing heritage spanning over 170 years. We bring together the agility of a challenger with the strength and stability required to make meaningful impacts worldwide. Our commitment is to improve lives, create sustainable value, and foster innovation in everything we do.
   

  

 At Standard Chartered, our purpose is to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity. Our brand promise, 'Here for Good', reflects our dedication to responsible banking and long\-term client relationships. We're proud to cultivate a workplace where every person’s unique talents are valued and where inclusion is more than a policy – it’s a way of life.
   

  

**Our Core Behaviours Underpin How We Work Together**
* Do the right thing: Act with integrity, courage and accountability putting clients first.
* Never settle: Pursue continuous improvement, innovation, and simplicity.
* Are better together: Foster inclusion, collaboration and mutual respect among diverse teams.


 Join us in shaping a future where finance works for everyone.
   

  

 What We Offer
   

  

 We Recognise And Value Each Employee’s Contributions And Strive To Provide a Comprehensive Package That Supports Your Professional And Personal Wellbeing. Our Offerings Include
   

  

* Competitive remuneration: Reflecting the responsibilities and markets in which we operate, aligned with our Fair Pay Charter.
* Robust benefits: Core bank contributions towards retirement savings and essential insurances including medical and life cover, tailored voluntarily to local needs.
* Generous leave entitlements: Annual leave, parental leave up to 20 weeks, sabbatical opportunities up to 12 months, and volunteering leave to encourage community engagement.
* Flexible working arrangements: Options that balance office presence and remote work, supporting diverse work styles.
* Wellbeing initiatives: Access to Unmind, a leading digital mental health platform, wellbeing workshops, global Employee Assistance Programmes, and designated mental health first aiders.
* Learning and development: Continuous opportunities for reskilling, upskilling, and career progression through digital, virtual, and in\-person learning platforms.
* Diversity and inclusion: An inclusive culture where unique perspectives are respected, and everyone has the chance to thrive and contribute fully.

* Ensure compliance with local authority regulations and international standards.

**3\. Project \& Commercial Management** 



* Manage project budgets, cost control, and financial performance.
* Oversee consultant contracts, scope negotiations, and deliverables.
* Support tendering, bid preparation, and resource planning.
* Ensure timely delivery within budget while maintaining quality standards.



  





**4\. Stakeholder \& Client Management** 



* Act as the primary interface with clients, government authorities, and key stakeholders.
* Lead coordination meetings, technical workshops, and executive discussions.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships to support repeat business.



  





**5\. Team Leadership \& Development** 



* Lead, mentor, and develop engineering teams and project managers.
* Manage resource allocation across multiple concurrent projects.
* Promote a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and collaboration.
* Support recruitment and succession planning.



  





**6\. Business Development** 



* Identify new project opportunities and support market expansion strategies.

**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering (Master’s or PhD preferred).

**Core Competencies** 



* Strategic Leadership \& Vision
* Infrastructure Design \& Delivery Expertise
* Commercial \& Financial Acumen (P\&L)
* Stakeholder \& Client Management
* Risk \& Governance Management
* Team Leadership \& Organizational Development



  





  





 At Binghatti, we don’t just build properties – we build legacies. You’ll join a team driven by ambition, creativity and excellence, where ideas move fast and every project makes a statement. Here, you’ll work alongside some of the brightest minds in real estate, contributing to iconic developments that define Dubai’s future. If you’re ready to be part of a company that’s shaping history, Binghatti is where your story begins.

The Head of Engineering is responsible for establishing and leading the engineering function as a core competitive advantage for the System Integration Division. The role provides strategic and technical leadership across design, protection, automation, panel engineering, and system architecture to ensure delivery of reliable, cost\-effective, and compliant solutions.
   

  

 The position drives engineering excellence through standardization, technology adoption, strong customer technical engagement, and robust project execution while ensuring profitability, quality, safety, and customer satisfaction. The role also builds organizational capability by developing high\-performing engineering teams, strengthening supplier and OEM partnerships, and supporting bids, new solutions, and product development initiatives.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
****Job Responsibilities****
****Job Requirements****
**Engineering Strategy \& Technical Authority**
* Define and implement the engineering strategy, design philosophy, and technical governance framework for the division.
* Establish company standards for drawings, documentation, SLDs, wiring diagrams, design templates, and BOM structures.
* Act as the final technical approval authority for all engineering deliverables and design packages.
* Own technical risk management and ensure alignment with business profitability and margin targets.
* Lead high\-level technical engagement with clients, consultants, utilities, and OEM partners.
* Define and execute the technology roadmap including adoption of modern substation automation, IEC 61850 architectures, smart MCCs, and digitalization initiatives.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective action for major technical failures, NCRs, or quality concerns.


* Project Engineering \& Bid Management
* Provide technical leadership during bids, tenders, and proposal stage, ensuring optimal technical and commercial positioning.
* Validate technical compliance with customer specifications, international standards, and contractual requirements.
* Oversee project engineering to ensure designs are delivered on time, within budget, and with zero major deviations.
* Manage interfaces with clients, consultants, OEMs (Siemens, ABB, GE, SEL, Schneider, etc.), and internal stakeholders.
* Balance standardization vs. customization to improve efficiency without compromising project requirements.
* Support business growth by enabling engineering capability for new markets, products, and solutions.
* Ensure seamless coordination with Testing \& Commissioning teams for successful system validation and handover.
* Departmental Leadership \& Capability Building
* Establish and lead a high\-performing engineering organization including Protection, Automation, Design, and Application Engineering.
* Define competency frameworks, skill matrix, and succession pipeline for critical roles.
* Drive recruitment, mentoring, and technical capability development.
* Optimize engineering resource planning across multiple concurrent projects.
* Foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Commercial \& Value Engineering
* Own engineering cost optimization through value engineering and design efficiency.
* Review and influence project profitability through technical decisions.
* Identify cost drivers within BOMs and propose alternatives without compromising performance.
* 
+ Support contract negotiations on technical clauses and deviations.

* Quality, Safety \& Compliance (Non\-Negotiables)
+ Ensure all engineering outputs comply with international standards including:
+ IEC 60255
+ IEC 61850
+ IEC 61131
+ IEC 61439
+ IEEE C37
+ ISO 9001
+ Integrate Safety by Design principles including arc\-flash mitigation, segregation, and isolation philosophy.
+ Ensure robust documentation control, ISO compliance, and accuracy of as\-built drawings and O\&M manuals.
+ Maintain centralized engineering data repository and knowledge management systems.


**Qualifications**
**Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering (Master’s preferred).** 
****Experience****

* Minimum 5–8 years in a senior engineering leadership or departmental head role.
* Experience handling multi\-million AED EPC or system integration projects is preferred


**Knowledge \& Technical Expertise** 
  

  

* Protection Engineering
+ Deep expertise in protection schemes (Differential, Distance, REF, Overcurrent, Busbar).
+ Relay coordination , system studies, and CT/VT sizing.

* Panel \& System Design
+ LV/MV panel design, heat dissipation, segregation, earthing, and wiring philosophy.

* Automation \& Communication
+ SCADA, RTU, IEC 61850, Modbus, DNP3, IEC 60870\-5 protocols.

 You will support the delivery and development of a Manchester City Football School venue, helping to ensure programmes are delivered to a consistently high standard. **Why Choose Us** 




 Working at City Football Group means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.
 



  





 This role offers a comprehensive international relocation package, including housing, medical cover, transport allowance, flights and visa sponsorship, alongside the opportunity to gain valuable global coaching experience.

 If you’re ready to take the next step in your coaching career and explore an international opportunity with Manchester City, we’d love to hear from you. Please click Apply and submit your CV by 31 May.

The
 **Head of Business Intelligence** 
 will own and lead the end\-to\-end BI strategy, architecture and insight delivery across the business. This role is responsible for transforming complex data into clear, actionable intelligence that enables leadership teams to make faster, smarter and more profitable decisions.
 



 You will build and lead a high\-performing BI function, establish best\-in\-class reporting standards, and partner closely with Commercial, Trading, Merchandising, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain and senior leadership to drive measurable business impact.
 



 This is a senior, hands\-on leadership role requiring strong technical expertise, commercial acumen and the ability to translate data into decision\-ready insight.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**BI Strategy \& Architecture** 



* Define and own the group\-wide BI roadmap across DTC and marketplace channels.
* Translate trading, pricing, merchandising, supply chain and finance requirements into scalable data models and reporting layers.
* Design and maintain a single source of truth across brands, regions and channels, despite fragmented upstream systems.
* Set clear ownership of raw data, transformed layers, business logic and reporting views.



**Data Integration \& Pipelines** 



* Lead the structuring and transformation of core data tables including orders, traffic, pricing, promotions, logistics, inventory and returns.
* Build and maintain robust pipelines to support daily, weekly and near real\-time trading decisions.
* Partner closely with technology and data teams to improve data reliability, timeliness and accessibility, and to define new data fields or views where required.



**Reporting, Dashboards \& Analytics** 



* Design decision\-first dashboards that drive action, not just visibility.
* Create standardised reporting frameworks while accommodating brand\-level nuances.
* Enable self\-serve analytics for trading, finance and senior leadership teams.



**Business Partnering \& Decision Support** 



* Act as a strategic BI partner to Trading and Commercial teams, proactively surfacing insights, risks and opportunities.
* Help evolve the organisation from reactive reporting to proactive and predictive insight.



**Data Governance \& Quality** 



* Define clear data definitions, metric logic and documentation to eliminate multiple versions of the truth.
* Implement data quality checks, alerts and reconciliation processes to ensure trust in reporting.



  





**What You’ll Bring** 



* 12\+ years’ experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics or Data, with at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Strong background in e\-commerce, fashion retail or consumer\-facing brands.
* Expert\-level SQL (BigQuery preferred) and deep understanding of modern data warehousing and modelling concepts.
* Advanced experience with BI tools such as Tableau or equivalent.
* Working knowledge of Python or similar for data analysis, automation or advanced analytics.
* Strong commercial mindset with a proven ability to influence senior stakeholders.
* Experience building and scaling BI teams in fast\-growth, high\-change environments.

Executive Opportunity: Head of Regional Sales (MEA)
 



  





 Zenith Technologies
 



 Location: Riyadh, KSA based
 



 Start Date: Immediate
 



 ⸻
 



 About Zenith
 



  





 Zenith Technologies, founded in Melbourne and established across Australasia and the Middle East, is a recognized leader in Homeland Security, Intelligence Systems, and Advanced Security Technologies.
 



  





 For over 15 years, Zenith has partnered with governments, ministries of interior, defense organizations, and elite law enforcement agencies to deliver end\-to\-end mission\-critical solutions that fuse physical, digital, and cyber domains. Our solutions are engineered entirely in\-house, giving us unmatched flexibility to innovate, customize, and deliver at scale.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 Our Portfolio
 



  





 Zenith’s portfolio reflects a track record of world\-first innovations and proprietary platforms that transform how governments and agencies secure their nations. Key domains include:
 



 • Intelligent Mobility \& Enforcement Systems – including the world’s first AI\-powered Intelligent Lightbar, combining ANPR, live data analytics, communications, and edge AI for real\-time enforcement and situational command.
 



 • Next\-Generation ANPR \& Video Analytics – advanced fixed, mobile, and covert platforms enabling real\-time vehicle intelligence, threat detection, and multi\-domain data correlation.
 



 • AI\-Powered Data Fusion \& Analytics – proprietary platforms that ingest and integrate structured and unstructured data streams, delivering actionable intelligence and predictive insights to decision\-makers at speed.
 



 • Open\-Source Intelligence (OSINT) \& Social Media Monitoring – cutting\-edge solutions for live monitoring, deep\-data correlation, and AI\-enhanced threat intelligence across open sources, social media, and digital ecosystems.
 



 • Command \& Control Solutions – scalable, integrated C4i platforms enabling strategic oversight, rapid response, and mission\-critical decision\-making across multiple agencies.
 



 • Cyber\-Physical Security Integration – bridging digital and physical domains to deliver end\-to\-end national security resilience against emerging threats.
 



  





 Zenith’s unique strength lies in IP ownership and in\-house R\&D, enabling us to deploy fully integrated ecosystems rather than fragmented systems — a decisive advantage in the Homeland Security, National Resilience, and Law Enforcement sectors.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 The Role
 



  





 Zenith is seeking a Head of Regional Sales (MEA) to drive strategic expansion across the GCC, with primary focus on the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
 



  





 Reporting directly to the Group CEO, this executive will lead Zenith’s market growth, government engagement, and multimillion\-dollar program delivery across one of the world’s most dynamic security environments.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 Key Accountabilities
 



 • Define and execute regional sales strategy aligned with Zenith’s growth objectives.
 



 • Lead high\-level engagements with Ministries of Interior, law enforcement, and homeland security agencies across KSA and GCC.
 



 • Manage full lifecycle: pipeline development, bid and proposal management, high\-stakes negotiation, and closure of complex projects.
 



 • Build, lead, and inspire a high\-performing regional sales force.
 



 • Establish and deepen strategic alliances with leading system integrators and security partners.
 



 • Deliver strong commercial outcomes while ensuring operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and market leadership.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 Candidate Profile
 



 • 10\+ years in senior sales leadership within Homeland Security, Security Technology, or Defense.
 



 • Minimum 5 years of demonstrable success in the GCC, with direct experience engaging KSA MOI.
 



 • Proven track record in structuring and closing multimillion\-dollar government security contracts.
 



 • Strong professional networks across security, defense, and law enforcement communities in the region.
 



 • Master’s degree (Business or Engineering), MBA preferred.
 



 • Fluent in both Arabic and English.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 What Zenith Offers
 



  





 This is a high\-impact executive mandate within one of the most respected innovation\-driven players in the homeland security sector. Zenith offers:
 



 • Attractive executive package (base \+ commission).
 



 • Opportunity to shape national\-level security transformation.
 



 • A platform to operate at the intersection of AI, intelligence, and homeland security innovation in one of the fastest growing regions globally.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 How to Apply
 



  





 Submit your CV (PDF/Word) to employment@zenith.com.au
 



 Subject line: “Head of Regional Sales (MEA) – \[Your Name]”
 



  





 Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

**COME AS YOU ARE \& JOIN THE 25h TRIBE.**
**Job Description**
**How does your working day look like …**
* Manage the implementation of the Hotel IT plan, in line with the overarching IT strategy, through hotel\-specific service level agreements (SLAs) and internal quality controls, in order to ensure that all IT efforts are delivered as per the agreed upon budgets, timelines and standards.
* Receive guidelines from the Group IT function and/ or the Head of Tech and apply them to implement the group\-wide hotel systems, hotel operations and enterprise architecture initiatives within the Hotel, to ensure that it benefits from IT investments and innovations.
* Manage the regular assessment and update of the Hotel's IT systems and infrastructures to ensure that they are secure, scalable and have the capacity and reliability to effectively support the Hotel's operations and growth.
* Manage the delivery of day\-to\-day IT support services to Colleagues, including network connexions, user access control, hardware configuration etc. in accordance with the agreed upon SLAs, to ensure the provision of seamless and efficient IT support.
* Manage the response to all ad\-hoc IT queries received from Colleagues and Guests and facilitate the accurate and timely provision of solutions, in order to ensure the provision of high levels of end\-user service and to enable business continuity.
* Manage the investigation of end\-user problems escalated by IT Support Colleagues, identify their source, determine possible solutions and implement them to ensure the prompt and effective resolution of problems.
* Oversee all network infrastructure operations, installation and maintenance, including LAN, WAN and interconnect points, in order to ensure that they are maintained up\-to\-date and performant.
* Manage and support all audio\-visual (AV) services within the Hotel, including meeting room setup, event space readiness, and troubleshooting AV equipment to ensure smooth guest experiences and seamless execution of internal and external functions.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to provide timely AV assistance for VIP guests, conferences, and presentations, ensuring high service standards and prompt issue resolution.

 Pattern is expanding and we are looking for an experienced Ecommerce expert to join our MENA Team in Dubai to support the scaling of the business by driving the performance of the brands we represent on Amazon and other Marketplaces.
   

  

 You will own the relationship and financial performance of a portfolio of global brands managing their performance across marketplaces here in MENA. You will support the Associate Director of eCommerce with defining and implementing the E2E growth and profitability plan for your portfolio of brands by working cross\-functionally with Operations, Content, Advertising, Creative, Merchandising and Finance. You will also lead cross\-functional projects to implement processes to scale the organisation in MENA. You will be a strategic and commercial ecommerce professional who can engage partners and internal stakeholders towards a common goal. You will have a growth mindset and love navigating the challenges of working in fast changing landscapes.
   

  

**The core responsibilities of the Senior eCommerce Manager reflect the following**
* Drive revenue growth on marketplaces across MENA through a data\-driven approach across a portfolio of brands through B2B and D2C marketplaces.
* Ensure that a clear activity plan is in place to achieve and surpass the budget targets, including promotional planning, seasonal phasing, NPD launches, advertising campaigns etc.
* Define the strategy and joint business plan with our brands to create mutually beneficial sales and marketing plans which grow market share.
* Represent your brands brilliantly across Marketplaces through best\-in\-class product content, including but not limited to images, enhanced content, keyword SEO, local language translation, advertising campaigns etc.
* Conduct analysis of brands performance using multiple data sources and tools on a regular basis to ensure that performance is continuously optimised across all touch points.
* Manage inventory, working alongside our merchandisers to maintain a healthy pipeline
* .Establish and maintain relationships with appropriate client partners, providing day\-to\-day contact on project status and changes.

**What will I need to thrive in this role?﻿**

**Job Summary**
 The Director, Residential Portfolio Management is responsible for the portfolio‑level governance, planning, and setup of branded residential components across Kerzner’s global Private Homes and Branded Residences development pipeline.
   

  

 The role focuses on the pre‑opening residential lifecycle, from early pre‑development and planning through to opening, providing structured management and coordination with internal and external stakeholders. The objective is to ensure that all branded residential projects are consistently defined, correctly configured, brand‑aligned, and operationally ready for structured handover to OpCo at opening.
   

  

 The position acts as the residential portfolio authority, establishing and managing residential project stage gates, defining residential requirements and standards, and validating outcomes at key milestones to ensure quality, consistency, and readiness across a growing pipeline of residential projects. The role does not include responsibility for day‑to‑day operations, rental programs, or HOA governance, which sit outside of this position.
   

  

 The role requires a strong background in luxury hospitality‑led residential product, portfolio oversight, and cross‑functional coordination, with the ability to translate brand intent and residential requirements into repeatable, scalable outcomes across multiple projects and geographies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Portfolio Governance \& Residential Frameworks** 
  

  

* Establish, own, and maintain portfolio‑wide residential frameworks, standards, and setup playbooks for all branded residential and Private Homes projects.
* Define, document, and maintain Kerzner side residential requirements and performance principles to inform the design and delivery of branded residential projects across the portfolio.
* Establish minimum portfolio requirements (not design solutions) covering:
+ Unit mix and typology principles (performance intent and target ranges, not layouts)
+ Residential amenity principles, including owner only vs shared use positioning
+ Arrival, circulation, privacy, and access requirements, expressed as outcomes rather than spatial solutions
+ Back of house and servicing requirements necessary to support efficient future operation and homeowner experience
+ Residential technology readiness criteria, defining capability requirements rather than system design

* Ensure consistent interpretation and application of branded residential standards across all projects and geographies.


**Residential Project Stage Gates (Portfolio Control)** 
  

  

* Establish and manage Residential Project Stage Gates aligned with the wider development lifecycle.
* Define required residential inputs and outputs at each stage, including:
+ Deal feasibility / concept confirmation
+ Concept design
+ Schematic design
+ Design development (residential “red‑flag” review)
+ Design and Build Phase
+ Pre‑opening residential readiness
+ Handover to OpCo

* Act as the Kerzner residential authority at each stage gate by:
+ Validating compliance with portfolio standards and residential requirements
+ Identifying material risks, gaps, or deviations
+ Confirming readiness to progress from a residential perspective

* Maintain a portfolio‑level record of residential stage‑gate reviews, approvals, and deviations
* Present stage gate readiness to all key internal stakeholders.


**Pre‑Development \& Planning (Residential Input)** 
  

  

* Provide residential subject‑matter input during pre‑development and early planning phases of new branded residential opportunities.
* Support Business Development and Design and Construction teams with residential assessments relating to:
+ Brand alignment and positioning
+ High‑level residential scope and feasibility assumptions
+ Unit mix strategy, typologies, and sizing logic
+ Amenity positioning and residential value proposition
+ Preliminary operational and governance implications

* Define early residential product principles to inform project briefs prior to design commencement.
* Identify and mitigate early‑stage risks that could impact:
+ Residential liveability and owner experience
+ Long‑term asset and portfolio value
+ Operational viability and handover readiness

* Ensure residential planning decisions align with a scalable, repeatable portfolio strategy.


**Design \& Project Interface (Residential Input Only)**
* Provide structured residential input to Design and Project teams at defined project milestones.
* Review residential layouts, adjacencies, circulation, and functional planning from an owner, operator readiness, and portfolio perspective.
* Ensure residential requirements and assumptions are clearly documented and integrated into the design process.
* Monitor design evolution to prevent unintended deviations that may negatively affect residential quality or long‑term usability.
* Maintain a collaborative, non‑authoring relationship with Design, respecting design leadership and consultant ownership.


**Brand Compliance \& Residential Product Integrity** 
  

  

* Ensure branded residential standards are interpreted and applied consistently across the portfolio.
* Review key residential elements impacting brand equity and owner experience, including:
+ Finishes intent and durability
+ Amenity positioning and exclusivity
+ Privacy, acoustics, and spatial separation

* Monitor and document residential deviations, concessions, and approved exceptions.
* Provide portfolio‑level insight into recurring issues and lessons learned across projects.


**Residential Operating Model \& Operating Plan Development**
* Define the Residential Operating Model and develop a structured Residential Operating Plan (ROP) for each project during the planning phase
* Ensure the defined residential operating plan is fully supported by design and asset configuration, validating that back‑of‑house layouts, access, storage, plant capacity, service flows, and residential technology capabilities enable efficient, discreet, and brand‑appropriate operation.
* Validate residential operational readiness from a governance perspective, confirming the asset can be realistically operated as intended, that material operational risks, inefficiencies, or cost drivers are identified and mitigated early, and that the project is ready for OpCo acceptance without fundamental re‑planning
* Formally package and transition the Residential Operating Model to OpCo as part of pre‑opening and handover, ensuring clarity of intent, scope, and assumptions.


**Pre‑Opening \& Handover** 
  

  

* Coordinate with OpCo teams in advance of opening to support a smooth transition of responsibility.
* Lead residential readiness activities prior to opening from a portfolio and governance perspective.
* Ensure completion of all residential handover requirements, including obtaining TCO and OC, establishing asset and warranty register frameworks, completing residential handover checklists, and confirming owner move‑in readiness principles.
* Coordinate structured handover of residential assets to:
+ OpCo (operations)
+ Director of Residence

* Formally transition responsibility at opening, retaining oversight only for portfolio‑level tracking, consult level support and continuous improvement.


**Portfolio Reporting \& Stakeholder Coordination** 
  

  

* Maintain strong collaboration with internal and external stakeholders including:
+ Design
+ Projects / Construction
+ Business Development
+ Property Management
+ OpCo

* Provide regular portfolio reporting on:
+ Residential pipeline status
+ Key risks and mitigation actions
+ Stage‑gate progress and readiness

* Support leadership decision‑making with clear, evidence‑based residential insights.


**Explicit Exclusions (Boundary Clarity)**
* No responsibility for residential rental programs or leasing
* No day‑to‑day residential operations or staffing
* No HOA or residential governance management
* No design authorship or consultant management


**Skills, Experience \& Educational Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate, Business, Hospitality Management, Architecture, or related field required; Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum 8–10 years’ experience across branded residences, luxury mixed‑use developments, or hospitality‑led residential platforms.
* Strong understanding of branded residential product, owner expectations, and residential lifecycle planning.
* Proven experience working at portfolio level across multiple concurrent projects.
* Ability to influence across Design, Development, Projects, Operations, and Property Management without direct authority.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical and organisational skills with ability to manage complexity across geographies.
* Comfortable operating in an owner‑side, non‑operational, governance‑focused role.
* Willingness to travel internationally as required.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; strong Excel skills preferred.
* Fluent in English; additional languages advantageous.


 Our company is expanding faster than ever before. We are investing in the growth of our company, and that means we are committed to investing in you. Join a team that is open\-hearted, innovative, inclusive, and inspiring in spirit. We believe in making our guests happy beyond anything they have ever imagined. We wow them at every turn and create memories that will last a lifetime. You will be at the heart of this vision, to constantly innovate to deliver Amazing Experiences and Everlasting Memories.

Thunes is scaling fast rapidly across the Middle East and we’re looking for elite hunters to open new markets and close transformational deals. If you love building, thrive on delivering big deals, and want to sell a product that actually moves money globally in real\-time, this is your opportunity!

* Build and convert a high\-quality pipeline of fintechs, banks, PSPs, and digital platforms
* Open new markets, landing strategic logos and unlocking revenue fast
* Drive senior\-level conversations with founders, C\-suite, and product teams

**What You’ll Bring**
* 8\+ years in B2B payment sales, proven hunter DNA
* Strong network across PSPs, fintechs, banks, wallets, e\-commerce players
* Track record of exceeding targets and closing complex commercial deals
* Execution\-first mindset \- proactive, resilient, self\-driven, hands\-on
* Fluent English; other regional languages welcome


**Why join Thunes**
* Uncapped commission with real earning power
* High\-growth fintech backed by global investors
* Sell a mission\-critical payments network used by world\-class brands driving financial inclusion
* Huge white\-space markets \- build and own your territory

**About Thunes**
 Thunes is the Smart Superhighway to move money around the world. Thunes’ proprietary Direct Global Network allows Members to make payments in real\-time in over 130 countries and more than 80 currencies.
   

  

 Thunes’ network connects directly to over 7 billion mobile wallets and bank accounts worldwide, as well as 15 billion cards via more than 320 different payment methods, such as GCash, M\-Pesa, Airtel, MTN, Orange, JazzCash, Easypaisa, AliPay, WeChat Pay and many more.
   

  

 Thunes’ Direct Global Network differentiates itself through its worldwide reach, in\-house SmartX Treasury System and Fortress Compliance Platform, ensuring Members of the network receive unrivaled speed, control, visibility, protection and cost efficiencies when making real\-time payments, globally.
   

  

 Members of Thunes’ Direct Global Network include gig economy giants like Uber and Deliveroo, super\-apps like Grab and WeChat, MTOs, fintechs, PSPs and banks.

**About j. awan \& partners**

We also have our own Technology company creating bespoke cutting\-edge RegTech solutions. Our business presence covers multiple jurisdictions with offices in the UAE, KSA, UK \& Ireland, Singapore, Porto, Pakistan, Qatar and South Africa. We provide Regulatory Governance, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Recruitment and Technology services to many clients including global, regional and local financial services institutions, governments and other industry partners.

The role ensures clients are fully aligned with regulatory expectations by implementing best\-in\-class compliance frameworks, conducting ongoing monitoring, and serving as the principal regulatory liaison. Reporting to the Director of Compliance, the role drives business growth by converting existing relationships into new opportunities and supporting the expansion of the compliance practice across our operating jurisdictions. * Compliance deliverables completed on time.
* Policies and procedures aligned with latest laws.
* No material compliance issues.

* Coordinate internal/external audits.
* Conduct compliance reviews and spot checks.
* Identify and remediate control weaknesses.
* Compliance reviews completed on schedule.
* Gaps addressed with corrective action.

* Effective risk communication.
* Strong stakeholder relationships.
* Professional representation at all levels.



  





**Continuous Improvement** 



* Stay updated on regulatory developments.

* Implementation of improved processes/tools.
* Measurable reduction in compliance risk.
* Adoption of industry best practices.

* Support talent attraction and retention.
* Coach and mentor junior team members.
* Positive internal engagement scores.
* Contribution to team development initiatives.
* Evidence of mentorship and knowledge sharing.

* Regulatory Expertise \& Strategic Mindset: Demonstrable experience engaging with regulatory authorities across the region, with the ability to design and implement compliance programs that mitigate risk and drive organisational effectiveness.

* Stakeholder Management \& Cultural Agility: Skilled at building partnerships and influencing clients, regulators, and internal teams, with the adaptability to work effectively across diverse organisations and cultural contexts.



  





**Role\-Specific Competencies**

The Director – Risk will ensure alignment of risk strategies with DHI’s investment and business goals. The role serves as a key advisor to senior leadership on risk exposure and resilience strategies.
 



  





 If you are ready to embark on a dynamic journey where your talents are valued, and your contributions make a real impact, we would like to hear from you.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Risk Strategy \& Framework**

* Lead risk identification and assessment processes for financial, operational, regulatory, and strategic risks impacting DHI’s investments and operations.



  





**Risk Monitoring \& Reporting** 



* Implement robust risk monitoring systems and dashboards to provide timely, accurate, and actionable insights to senior leadership.
* Prepare and present comprehensive risk reports to the SVP – Finance and DHI Management, highlighting emerging risks and mitigation strategies.

**Operational \& Investment Risk Management** 



* Partner with investment teams to assess risks associated with new deals, capital formation, and portfolio management activities.

* Collaborate with Governance \& Compliance team to ensure adherence to internal and external compliance requirements.
* Maintain strong relationships with regulatory bodies and external auditors to ensure proactive compliance.








**Who we are looking for:** 



* Minimum 10–12 years of relevant experience in risk management, with at least 5 years in leadership roles within investment or financial services.

**Education / Professional Certification** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field.

**Technical Competencies** 



* Expertise in risk modeling, scenario analysis, and stress testing.

**Behavioral Competencies** 



* Strategic Thinking

* Problem Solving \& Decision Making

* Team Leadership



  





**As much as we would be delighted to entertain all applicants, due to the high volumes of applications, only successful applicants will be contacted within 14 business days.**

**Innovation Program Manager (Full\-time, Part\-time or Consultation)** 




  





**About Setup.sa:**




 Setup.sa is a Saudi Consulting firm specializing in softlanding and market entry solutions for international companies. We pride ourselves in being a knowledge house, driven by technology.
 



 Setup.sa was able to leave a mark and build its name in the competitive Saudi market in an exceptionally short time. We are currently one of the fastest growing firms in Saudi Arabia, doubling our number of clients on a monthly basis.
 



  





 As we scale, we still strive to offer operational excellence while changing the way softlanding is done in KSA and raising the bar for the standards of service provision in our sector, pushing the expectations of the clients and the market higher.
 



  





 Being a consulting house, we exist to ensure that the process and journey for foreign companies’ incorporation and operations is done in the easiest and most cost\-efficient way possible.
 



 As this is our North Star, we could build the highest\-value solution in the market and subsequently serve some of the top companies and renowned startups around the world along with multiple government programs. We keep our promises to exceed our clients’ expectations by always going the extra mile, even if the client doesn’t get to know about it.
 



  





 The people working with us expect a lot from themselves and are interested in building solutions that change the way the industry works. They have strong ambitions to achieve exceptional success personally and professionally.
 



  





 Our team is performance\-driven and serious. And we would like to invite you to work with us and become a part of a growing company that has a credible brand name and enjoy an exceptional learning journey.
 



  





**Job Title:**




 Innovation Program Manager
 



  





**Seniority Level:**




 Mid\-senior Level
 



  





**Job Type:**




 Full\-time, Part\-time or Consultation
 



  





**Job Location:**




 Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
 



  





**Role Overview:**




  





 The Innovation Program Manager leads the design and execution of incubation, acceleration and venture building programs in Setup.sa, guiding startups across the full journey from idea validation to go\-to\-market. The role focuses on building and managing the entrepreneurship ecosystem by connecting founders with mentors, partners, and investors. It also ensures the successful delivery, growth, and impact of innovation programs aligned with strategic objectives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




  




1. Design, develop, and continuously improve incubation, acceleration and venture building programs covering the full innovation lifecycle from idea validation to go\-to\-market.
2. Identify and attract high\-potential startups and entrepreneurs locally and internationally.
3. Guide startups through key stages including problem validation, solution design, MVP (Minimum Viable Product) development, product\-market fit, and scaling.
4. Oversee the progress of startups within the program, and support founders in developing clear business models, value propositions, and go\-to\-market strategies.
5. Attract and manage relationships with investors, venture capital firms, angel networks, and funding entities.
6. Facilitate investor readiness for startups through pitch coaching, financial modeling guidance, and preparation of investment materials, while organizing demo days, investor meetings, and networking events to connect startups with funding opportunities.
7. Build strategic partnerships with corporates, government entities, and ecosystem players to support program objectives.
8. Establish a strong network of mentors, advisors, and industry experts, ensuring relevant and high\-quality support for startups.
9. Monitor market trends, emerging technologies, and innovation practices to continuously enhance the program.
10. Manage program operations including planning, budgeting, resource allocation, and reporting.



  





**Required Qualifications:**




  




* Experience of 8\+ years in innovation management, entrepreneurship and startup ecosystems
* Proven experience in designing and managing incubation, acceleration and venture building programs
* Strong hands\-on experience across the full startup lifecycle from idea stage to scaling and go\-to\-market
* Deep understanding of the Saudi market and its entrepreneurship and innovation ecosystem.
* Experience in attracting and managing funding partners, investors, or venture capital relationships

data.jd_text:
**Location \-** 
 Al Khobar/Riyadh
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The KSA Buildings \& Infrastructure (B\&I) Director is responsible for leading, growing, and elevating Bureau Veritas’ B\&I portfolio across the region. This strategic leadership role oversees the full product line performance—shaping the long‑term vision, delivering the annual P\&L, and ensuring excellence across all operations.
   

  

 The Director drives topline and gross margin delivery in close partnership with regional leadership, steering commercial strategy, optimizing delivery models, and ensuring high‑quality, efficient, and client‑centric execution. The role leads multidisciplinary teams across
 **Asset Management, Infrastructure Technical Inspections, Project \& Program Management, Environmental Services, and Commissioning** 
 , ensuring cohesive, high‑value solutions for clients.
   

  

 The Director also strengthens BV’s market presence across major sectors including
 **Hospitality, Entertainment, Tourism, Mega Projects, Developers, Contractors, Government Authorities, Urban Development, Smart Cities, Transportation Infrastructure, and Aviation** 
 , building trusted relationships and expanding BV’s impact on safe, sustainable, and resilient built environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and implement the regional B\&I growth strategy aligned with regional and global Product Line priorities.
* Drive portfolio expansion, commercial performance, and market penetration across all B\&I service domains.
* Lead the annual budgeting cycle and manage end‑to‑end P\&L accountability for revenue, sales, and gross margin.
* Ensure delivery quality in line with BV’s Operational Excellence standards and performance KPIs.
* Oversee regional commercial activities and support major pursuits, tenders, and key account development.
* Build and maintain strategic relationships with key customers across priority sectors.
* Lead operational governance through structured meetings, reviews, and performance follow‑up.
* Coach and develop teams, drive a high‑performance culture, and lead recruitment and performance assessments.
* Collaborate with Product Line and Area leadership to build a strong B\&I talent pipeline.
* Uphold BV’s Core Values, Code of Ethics, and the 3 Absolutes.
* Ensure rigorous compliance with BV procedures for technical governance, risk, and quality.


**Core Competencies**
**Leadership \& Strategy**
* Strategic thinker with strong decision‑making, accountability, and change‑leadership capability.
* Effective people leader who empowers teams and navigates matrix environments with ease.


**Commercial \& Client Excellence**
* Strong commercial acumen and ability to drive growth across diverse B\&I markets, including Transportation Infrastructure and Aviation.
* Skilled at long‑term client relationship development and key account management.


**Operational Excellence**
* Proven ability to ensure consistent quality, compliance, and operational performance.
* Experience managing complex, multi‑disciplinary programs.


**Technical \& Market Insight**
* Solid understanding of B\&I service lines including inspections, commissioning, and asset management.
* Strong knowledge of regional standards, regulations, and industry dynamics across built‑environment and infrastructure sectors.


**Personal Attributes**
* High integrity, resilient, client‑centric, with strong communication and stakeholder influence.

**About This Role**
**Important note: This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The selected candidate must be located in Riyadh.**
 As the Rare Disease Business Unit Head for the GCC, you will play a critical leadership role in shaping and executing the rare disease strategy across the region. You will drive the successful launch and expansion of innovative therapies in areas such as SMA HD, ALS, and Friedreich’s Ataxia \- ensuring patients gain timely access to life\-changing treatments.
   

  

 You will lead the Rare Disease Business Unit across GCC countries, overseeing strategy, operations, and performance. Working in close partnership with the GCC Leadership Team and global stakeholders, you will build a high\-performing organization, ensure cross\-functional excellence, and deliver both patient impact and business results.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Develop and execute the GCC rare disease commercial strategy at the local level, in close alignment with regional and global teams
* Establish and lead high\-performing cross\-functional in\-country teams, ensuring full launch readiness across medical, value \& access, sales, and supply
* Drive the successful launch and expansion of therapies across SMA, including SMA HD, as well as ALS and FA
* Lead the development and execution of country\-specific account plans to maximize patient access and organizational impact
* Collaborate with regional and global teams to adapt and localize marketing, medical, and value \& access strategies to local market needs
* Lead local segmentation and targeting processes, ensuring effective resource allocation and execution
* Define and oversee local sales targets, incentive structures, and performance review processes for commercial teams
* Own full P\&L responsibility for the Rare Disease Business Unit, delivering against financial and operational KPIs
* Build the necessary pathways and processes to accelerate approval, access, and reimbursement across GCC markets
* Ensure all launch activities are executed on time, on budget, and in compliance with internal governance and launch excellence frameworks
* Act as a key strategic partner to regional and global teams, providing insights on local market dynamics, opportunities, and challenges
* Establish strong governance and collaboration models with specialty business units to ensure alignment and effective use of shared resources
* Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including healthcare professionals, payers, professional organizations, and patient advocacy groups
* Partner with local and regional functional leaders to design and execute effective stakeholder engagement strategies
* Strengthen and maintain the organization’s reputation within the rare disease community through trusted and compliant engagement


**Who You Are**
 You are a strategic and entrepreneurial leader with a passion for making a meaningful impact in rare diseases. You thrive in complex, fast\-evolving environments and bring a strong balance of vision and execution.
   

  

 You are known for your ability to lead through influence, build high\-performing teams, and navigate cross\-functional and multicultural environments. You combine strong business acumen with deep empathy for patients, ensuring that every decision contributes to better outcomes.
   

  

 You are collaborative, resilient, and driven, capable of translating strategy into action while inspiring those around you.
   

  

**Required Skills**
* 10\+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, with a significant number of years in a leadership role
* BSc/BA required (MBA preferred)
* Strong experience in rare diseases or specialty care strongly desired
* Proven track record of leading successful product launches across multiple markets, including pre\-launch, launch readiness, and post\-launch execution
* Demonstrated leadership experience building and managing high\-performing cross\-functional teams across multiple countries
* Proven ownership of full P\&L, including delivering financial targets and performance management
* Deep expertise in market access, pricing, reimbursement, and healthcare systems within the GCC region
* Strong understanding of Saudi Arabia, with relevant experience working in the market
* Strong experience developing and executing local commercial strategies, including account planning, segmentation, and targeting
* Experience defining sales targets, incentive structures, and performance management frameworks
* Proven ability to drive approval, access, and reimbursement pathways in complex environments
* Experience working in matrix organizations, collaborating with regional and global stakeholders
* Fluent in Arabic and English, with high proficiency in commercial IT systems (e.g., CRM platforms)


 Job Level: Management
   

  

**Why Biogen?**
 We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid\-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well\-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. Above all, we work together to deliver life\-changing medicines, with every role playing a vital part in our mission. Caring Deeply. Achieving Excellence. Changing Lives.

We know that diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives make us a stronger and more innovative company, and we are focused on building teams where every employee feels empowered and inspired. **Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with over 11,000 entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
 The Infrastructure and Capital Projects (Infra) team focuses on improving return on investment capital and reducing the risks specific to capital projects. The Infra team is built on deep industry sector expertise with a demonstrably differentiated ability to address the most complex business problems and by supporting our owner/operator/contractor clients with the expertise of our deep project, Alvarez \& Marsal's ultimate goal is to reduce the level of uncertainty associated with the development and operational costs of your projects, contributing to greater shareholder value drawn from procurement through execution and asset management through different solutions.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
 A\&M continues to expand in EMEA, and we are looking to recruit a Director \& Senior Director to be based in our Riyadh office. Working with some of the industry's brightest and most experienced colleagues, you will:
   

  

* Lead the execution of project workstreams, demonstrating expertise and identifying opportunities for process improvement within the assigned tasks.
* Conduct meetings and presentations with clients, as well as internal managerial and executive stakeholders, showcasing proficiency and confidence in discussing project matters.
* Collaborate with teams and clients, engaging in negotiations and fostering effective partnerships between leadership.
* Develop and nurture client relationships, seeking to understand their needs and contributing to their satisfaction.
* Participate in industry events and associations to broaden professional connections and identify potential growth avenues.
* Contribute to the identification and pursuit of new business prospects, aligned with the strategic goals of Infra and other Business Units.
* Drive project analyses, propose actionable plans, and exhibit strong decision\-making capabilities.
* Demonstrate leadership qualities while effectively guiding project delivery.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or master’s degree in business administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* Proven experience in project management and business development, ideally within consulting or related industries.
* 8\+ years experience within public sector large scale projects experience is necessary.
* Arabic language skills is required
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, capable of articulating ideas to diverse audiences.
* Willingness to travel as required.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex situations and develop solutions, emphasizing creativity and critical thinking.
* Self\-starter with strong business acumen and a results\-driven approach.
* Ability to adapt and thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
* Collaborative and team\-oriented mindset.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills for interactions with senior management, clients, and colleagues.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with ambition and risk appetite.
* Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Developing client management skills and aptitude for business development and negotiation.
* Thrives in a high\-energy, fast\-paced, and dynamic culture.


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.
   

  

 We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.
   

  

 Inclusive Diversity
   

  

 A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who can positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M’s core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are the main reasons our people love working at A\&M. Inclusive Diversity means we embrace diversity, and we foster inclusiveness, encouraging everyone to bring their whole self to work each day.  What You'll Do
   

  

 The Business \& Operations Senior Manager drives the effective operationalization of Inverto’s regional growth agenda by leading key commercial, people, financial, and operational processes for the Middle East.
   

  

 Acting as a strategic partner to Inverto leadership and EMESA teams, the role ensures transparency in business development activities, enables strong go\-to\-market execution, and supports high\-quality decision\-making through robust performance and financial management. * Establish processes to systematically gather and synthesize up\-to\-date information on relevant compliance regulations

* Oversee day\-to\-day office operations of the Inverto team and act as a key point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, ensuring smooth and efficient business operations
* Coordinate shared services and functions (e.g., HR, Recruiting, IT) with BCG where applicable, optimizing processes to support local delivery

 Working with global, regional and local teams
   

  

 Hyper motivated individuals

 Teammates that are authentic by nature, they thrive to support the team to win

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 1\-Bid \& Tender Management
   

  

 Lead the end\-to\-end bid process including opportunity tracking, RFP/RFQ analysis, bid qualification, and submission. Coordinate cross\-functional inputs to produce compliant, competitive, and strategically positioned tender responses on time and within scope.
   

  

 2\- Financial Proposal Development
   

  

 Structure and develop comprehensive financial proposals including pricing models, cost\-benefit analyses, ROI projections, and revenue forecasts. Ensure all financial submissions are commercially viable, clearly articulated, and aligned with client expectations and risk appetite.
   

  

 3\-Pitch Design \& Delivery
   

  

 Design and deliver high\-impact pitch presentations that translate complex solutions into clear, persuasive narratives tailored to each audience — whether C\-suite executives, procurement committees, or investment panels. Drive pitch strategy from storyline to slide to room presence.
   

  

 4\- Stakeholder Engagement \& Relationship Management
   

  

 Build and sustain strategic relationships with key internal and external stakeholders — including clients, partners, investors, and government entities. Manage stakeholder expectations proactively throughout the business development cycle to ensure alignment and long\-term trust.
   

  

 5\- Opportunity Identification \& Pipeline Development
   

  

 Proactively identify and qualify new business opportunities through market intelligence, client engagement, and industry networking. Maintain a healthy and well\-qualified pipeline that supports revenue targets and strategic growth objectives.
   

  

 6\- Client Needs Assessment \& Solution Positioning
   

  

 Construct structured discovery sessions with prospective clients to uncover pain points and strategic priorities. Translate insights into tailored solution narratives that differentiate the organization's offering and directly address client objectives.
   

  

 7\- Cross\-Functional Coordination
   

  

 Serve as the central coordinator between technical, legal, finance, and operations teams during the proposal and bid preparation process. Ensure all workstreams are aligned, deadlines are met, and the final submission reflects a cohesive and competitive offer.
   

  

 8\- Post\-Submission Follow\-Up \& Negotiation Support
   

  

 Manage client communication post\-submission, respond to clarification requests, and support contract negotiation efforts. Conduct structured debrief sessions on both won and lost bids to continuously improve proposal quality and win rates.
   

  

**Job Requirements**
 Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
   

  

 A Master's degree (MBA or equivalent) is strongly preferred.
   

  

 Skils
   

  

* Bid \& Tender Management
* Financial Proposal Writing
* Pitch \& Presentation Design
* Business Case Development
* RFP/RFQ Response

 We are looking for a dynamic, results\-driven
 **Riyadh Business Manager** 
 to lead our commercial growth and operational execution in Saudi Arabia. This role is the driving force behind our success in the region, requiring a leader who can balance high\-level business development with hands\-on operational management.
   

  

 You will be responsible for the end\-to\-end client lifecycle and local logistics—from acquiring high\-value sellers and driving buyer revenue to overseeing product on boarding and managing shipments. * Marketing Collaboration: Work closely with the regional marketing team to design, launch, and optimize targeted campaigns aimed at new seller acquisition.
* Conversion Optimization: Oversee the seller journey, identifying bottlenecks and training the sales team to improve conversion rates from initial inquiry to successful listing.


**Buyer Engagement \& Sales Leadership**
* Drive Buyer Revenue: Manage the Riyadh sales team to achieve and exceed regional revenue targets, focusing on high\-ticket conversions and repeat purchases.

* Experience: 5\+ years of experience in Business Management, Business Development, or Operations, preferably within the luxury goods, e\-commerce, or premium retail sectors.
* Dual Skillset: Proven ability to manage both commercial sales / clienteling targets and physical operations/logistics workflows.
* Local Market Expertise: Deep understanding of the Saudi Arabian consumer and cultural nuances, with an existing network of high\-net\-worth individuals (HNWIs) being a strong plus.
* Leadership: Proven track record of managing, coaching, and scaling cross\-functional teams to hit ambitious targets.
* Data\-Driven: Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data (conversion rates, NPS, logistics SLAs, acquisition costs) to drive strategic decisions.


**Communication:** 
 Exceptional interpersonal and negotiation skills.
 ***Fluency in both Arabic and English is required.***

data.jd_text:
The Director of IT (Operational Technology) will lead the transformation, governance, and standardisation of OT across a large, multi\-site mining and processing organisation. The role will define and implement the OT strategy, enabling a transition towards an Industry 4\.0 operating model driven by automation, data, and advanced control systems.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop and implement an OT strategy across multiple mining and processing operations
* Establish OT architecture, standards, and governance frameworks aligned to ISA\-95 and Industry 4\.0 principles
* Assess current OT maturity across business units and define roadmap to achieve target state maturity
* Lead integration of automation technologies including:
+ Base control systems
+ Advanced process control (MPC)
+ AI\-driven predictive control systems

* Define and implement enterprise\-wide OT data architecture, including data governance, storage, and lifecycle management
* Drive standardisation of OT systems across decentralised plant environments
* Partner with plant managers and operational leaders to embed OT improvements at site level
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on process stabilisation and optimisation
* Build confidence and capability across OT teams and business units
* Oversee a multidisciplinary team of 20\+ professionals across OT, data, innovation, and technology enablement
* Collaborate with VP\-level stakeholders across IT, Data \& AI, Innovation, and Technology Enablement



**Key Interfaces** 



* Plant Managers across mining and processing sites
* Business Unit Leaders
* IT and Digital Leadership Team
* Data \& AI and Innovation functions
* Operational Technology and Fleet Management teams



**Candidate Requirements** 



* Extensive experience in mining, metals, or heavy industrial environments
* Strong background in Operational Technology (OT) and industrial automation
* Experience with ISA\-95 frameworks and Industry 4\.0 transformation
* Deep understanding of industrial control systems and predictive technologies
* Experience with mining fleet management systems and operational data environments
* Proven ability to lead large\-scale OT transformation in decentralised organisations
* Strong leadership experience managing cross\-functional technical teams
* Ability to engage and influence senior operational and technical stakeholders



**Transformation Focus** 




 This is a strategic leadership role driving a step\-change in OT maturity (from \~2/5 to \~4\.5/5\), enabling:
 


* Increased automation and operational autonomy
* Data\-driven decision\-making across all operations
* Predictive and AI\-enabled industrial control systems
* Standardised, scalable OT architecture across all sites

**Job Description**
 What if you could shape a career as unique as you?

 As a
 **Project Manager** 
 you support the Senior Project Manager and Project Director in leading the planning, execution, and delivery of complex master planning projects. You will support all aspects of the project, including scope, schedule, budget, quality, and stakeholder management, ensuring that the project is completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards to the successful delivery of master plans. This role requires a strong understanding of urban development principles and the ability to navigate complex regulatory environments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Detailed Key Responsibilities**
* Project Leadership \& Lifecycle Management
* End\-to\-End Delivery: Lead the tactical execution of Master Planning projects from inception through to delivery.
