**PROJECT MANAGER**
**About TelMAX Inc.**
 Based in York Region, telMAX is a private equity\-backed all fibre digital infrastructure platform that provides a 21 st century alternative to traditional telecom networks. Recognized for four consecutive years as Canada’s Fastest ISP with an industry\-leading net promoter score of over fifty, telMAX is continuing its rapid growth plan to bring its all\-fibre network to residential and business customers across Southern Ontario.
   

  

**Your Position \& How You Will Contribute**
 Reporting to the Senior Manager, Project Management, the Project Manager will be highly experienced and proactive to lead our Fibre to the Home (FTTH) projects. You will be responsible for developing project plans, predicting and monitoring the progress of all construction and materials acquisition activities, and ensuring successful project delivery on time and within budget. In this highly dynamic position, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow in your career and within the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities \& Key Duties**
 Project Planning and Management
   

  

* Develop detailed project plans outlining scope, schedule, budget, and resources required.
* Predict, monitor, and control the progress of all construction and materials acquisition activities.
* Ensure that all project phases are completed on time and meet quality standards.


 Coordination and Execution
   

  

* Coordinate with various teams including engineering, construction, procurement, and external vendors.
* Ensure all teams are aligned and working towards the project objectives.
* Oversee the execution of the project plan, adjusting as necessary to meet changing needs and requirements.


 Stakeholder Communication
   

  

* Communicate project status, risks, and issues to key stakeholders, including senior management and clients.
* Prepare and present regular progress reports and updates.
* Facilitate project meetings and follow up on action items.


 Risk Management
   

  

* Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Monitor and address issues that may impact project timelines and quality.


 Budget and Resource Management
   

  

* Manage project budgets, ensuring that expenditures are tracked and controlled.
* Allocate resources efficiently and effectively to meet project demands.


 Compliance and Documentation
   

  

* Ensure all project activities comply with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies.
* Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including plans, reports, and contracts.


 Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Identify opportunities for process improvements and implement best practices.
* Conduct post\-project evaluations and lessons learned to enhance future project performance.


**Other Responsibilities**
* Help in setting up the resources and processes (contractors, internal resources)
* Work with contractors to detail specific project deliverables
* Develop timelines of goals and objectives for projects
* Delegating projects to teams best suited to complete them
* Tracking project performance and analyzing deliverables against requirements
* Ensuring that all budgetary objectives are met, adjusting as required
* Creating timely reports for executive committee meetings
* Predicting resource requirements based on build volume
* Scope – Design, Permitting, locates, drilling, fibre blowing, splicing, hand\-over to operations
* Coordination of invoicing from the contractors and ensuring work validation with construction management
* Ensuring the updating of internal systems
* Ensuring the archiving of as\-build drawings


**What You Bring**
* Strong relationship building, judgment skills, problem solving and follow\-up skills
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication abilities
* Ability to maintain confidentiality
* Excellent ability to prioritized and follow through in commitments
* Ability to lead and motivate cross\-functional teams
* Superior level planning and organizing skills, capable of seeing the big picture, understanding system pressures and planning at a detailed level
* Able to tailor your communication style to meet the needs of a variety of audiences, and achieve the desired result
* Comfortable learning new technical systems as needed


**Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in project management, preferably in the telecommunications industry with a focus on FTTH projects
* Proficiency with project management tools and software (e.g., Microsoft Project, Primavera, Smartsheet)
* Strong understanding of construction and materials acquisition processes
* Strong attention to detail with a high level of accuracy and resourceful mindset
* Excellent organizational skills
* Strong time management skills, with the ability to handle multiple on\-going priorities
* Ability to handle confidential and non\-routine information with discretion and professionalism
* Highly professional and diplomatic, with a very positive disposition
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Ability to take initiative and work under pressure with minimal supervision
* Natural interpersonal and communication skills
* Ability to work effectively and prioritize tasks.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn and adapt.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in project management, telecommunications, engineering, or a related field
* Experience in related areas or fields
* PMP or PRINCE2 certification is a plus
* College or University degree in related field


**ImPACT Values**
* Performance \& Commitment


 We hold ourselves to the highest standards, delivering exceptional results through dedication, accountability, and continuous improvement. Our commitment to excellence drives us to push boundaries, take ownership, and always follow through.
   

  

* Agility \& Collaboration


 We move fast, adapt with courage, and work together to solve challenges. Through empowerment and open communication, we foster a culture where bold ideas thrive. We leverage our collective strengths, achieve shared success and deliver exceptional results for our customers and teams.
   

  

* Customer Centricity


 In every decision we make, we think through the customer’s lens. We know that anticipating and exceeding their expectations isn’t just good service—it’s the foundation of who we are. By staying deeply connected to our customers’ needs, we build loyalty, enhance our reputation, spark positive word\-of\-mouth and drive company growth.
   

  

* Trust \& Integrity


 We build trust by acting with integrity, respect, and transparency in everything we do. We communicate with each other openly and presume positive intentions. By upholding these principles, we strengthen relationships, create a culture of respect, and empower teams to succeed together.
   

  

**Why You Should Join TelMAX**
* We are a growing, dynamic organization
* We offer a competitive variable compensation package
* Hybrid positions

**Equity Statement**

**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 As a Service Project Manager at Siemens Energy, you will be at the forefront of executing service orders for the compression fleet, driving meaningful projects that enhance operational excellence and customer satisfaction. Your role will involve strategic planning and coordination, ensuring that projects are delivered within scope, time, quality, and budget, thereby contributing significantly to Siemens Energy’s mission of sustainable energy solutions. You will work in a dynamic team environment that values collaboration, innovation, and proactive communication, fostering a culture of growth and excellence.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Execute compression service orders, including parts, repairs, field service, and complete outage projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives.

* Organize and lead teams, define responsibilities, develop schedules, and allocate resources to address specific project challenges effectively.
* Extend service order management to the Middle Eastern region as needed, ensuring seamless execution and delivery.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to achieve revenue, EBIT, on\-time delivery, and project delivery targets, while driving client satisfaction and supporting cash collection.
* Collaborate with finance for accurate forecasting and coordinate with global teams to align service order execution with global standards.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, project management, or a related field, with 4\-6 years of relevant experience in project management, preferably in the Oil \& Gas industry or with rotating equipment.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and leadership skills, with the ability to develop and implement strategic plans effectively.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and experience with project management and order management tools and concepts.
* Self\-driven and adaptable, with a positive attitude and the ability to solve challenges collaboratively.
* Familiarity with CRM (Salesforce) and ERP software (e.g., SAP) is highly desirable, enhancing operational efficiency.
* Excellent communication, networking, and relationship\-building skills, with strong leadership abilities to influence stakeholders and drive project success.


**About The Team**
 Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* Opportunities to work with a global team
* Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects
* Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens\-Energy platform


 https://jobs.siemens\-energy.com/jobs
   

  

 The job posting will remain open for applications for 14 days from the posting date.

data.jd_text:
We are looking for a
 **Project Manager \- Credit Card Migration to join a well\-known Islamic Bank in Bahrain.** 
 The Ideal candidate will lead and deliver end\-to\-end credit card system and/or portfolio migration initiatives, ensuring successful execution across scope, time, budget, quality, and operational readiness. Own the migration governance, planning, stakeholder coordination, execution, cutover, and post go\-live stabilization while ensuring accurate data reconciliation and business sign\-off.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\) Project Governance \& Delivery Management** 



* Define and apply an appropriate project management framework and delivery governance (steering, working groups, RAID, milestones, reporting cadence) to ensure completion within agreed scope, quality, and timelines.
* Prepare the project brief/charter and initiation documentation; establish clear scope boundaries, assumptions, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Manage scope changes through structured change control; drive decisions and approvals in a timely manner.
* Manage project risks/issues and ensure mitigation plans are actively owned and executed.



**2\) Credit Card Migration Planning \& Execution** 



* Own the end\-to\-end migration approach for new Credit Card system setup and/or system/portfolio migration, including strategy, sequencing, trial conversions, and final migration execution.
* Lead the planning and execution of parallel run and cutover planning.
* Lead data reconciliation and business sign\-off activities.
* Manage migration of account, card, transaction, installment, and fee data.
* Ensure readiness for authorization, clearing, billing, settlement, and collections flows.
* Ensure migration readiness across business, operations, technology, and vendors, including runbooks, cutover checklists, and rollback considerations.



**3\) Testing \& Environment Readiness (SIT/UAT/Parallel Run)** 



* Plan and manage SIT, UAT, and Parallel Run activities end\-to\-end, including test strategy, scope, entry/exit criteria, defect triage, and governance.
* Coordinate business users for UAT execution and sign\-off.
* Drive closure of defects, gaps, and reconciliation breaks prior to go\-live.



**4\) Data Migration, Reconciliation \& Controls** 



* Lead the data migration lifecycle: strategy, mapping, extraction, transformation, loading, trial runs, and reconciliation.
* Establish reconciliation controls and sign\-off packs between old and new systems.
* Ensure accuracy and completeness for key datasets and balances; drive resolution of discrepancies.



**5\) Scheme \& Platform / Vendor Coordination** 



* Work effectively with CMS platforms (VisionPLUS) and associated vendors/partners, ensuring delivery alignment, integration readiness, and clear responsibilities (RACI).
* Ensure the migration scope covers Visa/Mastercard data and scheme\-related flows in alignment with business requirements and operational cutover needs.



**6\) Shariah\-Compliant Product Considerations (Preferred)** 



* Ensure the solution and migration approach supports Shariah\-compliant card structures, preferably Tawarruq/Murabaha\-based settlement and profit calculation rules.
* Coordinate requirements validation and sign\-offs with relevant product owners and compliance stakeholders as applicable.



**7\) Go\-Live Command Center \& Hypercare** 



* Lead the cutover and go\-live command center, including war\-room governance, tracking, and escalation management.
* Lead post go\-live hypercare, ensuring issue triage, prioritization, resolution tracking, and stabilization closure with formal acceptance.



**Required Knowledge \& Experience (Must Have)** 



* In\-depth understanding of credit card lifecycle including: issuance, authorization, billing, settlement, reconciliation, collections, disputes, and chargebacks.
* Proven experience managing and executing credit card migration projects (system migration and/or portfolio migration).
* Knowledge of CMS platforms (VisionPLUS).
* In\-depth understanding and experience on: parallel run and cutover planning; data reconciliation and sign\-off; account, card, transaction, installment, and fee data; authorization, clearing, billing, and collections flows; data migration strategy, trial conversions, and reconciliation.
* Experience working on Visa/Mastercard data.
* Hands\-on experience managing SIT, UAT, and Parallel Run.
* Experience leading cutover planning and Go Live command center.
* Proven ability to lead post GoLive hypercare and issue resolution.



**Preferred / Advantage** 



* Understanding of Shariah\-compliant card structures, preferably Tawarruq/Murabaha\-based settlement and profit calculation rules.
* Experience in setting up a new Credit Card system (greenfield implementation) in addition to migration.



**Education \& Certifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline.
* PMI certification (or equivalent) is strongly preferred.



**Core Competencies \& Skills** 



* Excellent communication and stakeholder management across business, technology, and vendors.
* Customer focus and outcome\-driven delivery mindset.
* Strong planning and organizing skills with governance discipline and structured execution.
* Problem solving, analytical thinking, and a strong reconciliation mindset.
* Accountability and ownership; ability to lead under pressure during cutover/go\-live.
* Ability to negotiate, influence, and broker alignment across multiple stakeholders.



**Key Deliverables (Examples)** 



* Project charter, integrated plan, governance calendar, RAID log, and weekly/monthly status reports.
* Migration strategy and detailed cutover runbook (including rehearsal outcomes).
* Trial conversion results and reconciliation sign\-off packs.
* SIT/UAT/Parallel Run plans, defect dashboards, and final readiness assessment.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose:** 




 To drive the delivery of a risk\-based Technology Audit portfolio, providing strategic assurance and insights that strengthen IT governance, controls, and business performance. The role leads complex technology audit engagements standalone or integrated with business audits, develops high\-performing teams, fosters collaboration, and ensures the Internal Audit function adds measurable value to organizational objectives.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:** 




  





**Technology Audit and Advisory Delivery** 




  




* Supports with the technology component of a risk\-based IA plan by coordinating and managing the delivery of the IT risk assessment and annual planning activities. This involves proposing audit engagements for inclusion in IA plans, including the scope, timing, and required resources.
* Acts as the Engagement Manager\* for multiple or large integrated audit engagements concerning technology audit areas within the IA Department. Responsible for the day\-to\-day project management of the engagements across planning, fieldwork and reporting, ensuring delivery of high\-quality assurance and advice, on time and within allocated budget.
* Establishes and maintains regular coordination between the IA Director (or Executive Director), management and the engagement team on the
* progress of engagements, ensuring corrective actions are taken to address any identified issues impacting the engagement plan.
* Regularly monitors and reports on the progress of management action plans, facilitating the effective and timely implementation of management action plans. This involves guiding action owners (where necessary), challenging revised due dates, escalating overdue actions and managing the verification of closed actions.
* Supports and coach engagement teams throughout the engagement lifecycle, to facilitate the correct application of the IA methodology, and enhances the teams’ functional and leadership competencies.
* Supports the VP, Internal, IA Director (or Executive Director) with the delivery of their role, as delegated.
* Ensure delivery of high\-impact, risk\-based audits that enhance control effectiveness and strengthen control environment and organizational governance.



  





**IT Governance Framework, ERP and Data Analytics** 



* Evaluate the design and effectiveness of IT governance frameworks (e.g., COBIT, ISO 27001, ITIL etc.), ensuring alignment with organizational policies, regulatory expectations, and risk‑management objectives.
* Assess ERP environments (SAP S/4 Hana etc.) for configuration adequacy, access controls, change‑management practices, and process integrity across key business cycles.
* Perform technology risk assessments to identify control gaps, security vulnerabilities, and compliance issues within core IT processes and enterprise applications.
* Leverage data analytics tools (e.g., SQL, Power BI, Python) to perform automated testing, trend analysis, anomaly detection, and continuous\-monitoring routines.
* Develop sound audit findings and recommendations that strengthen IT controls, improve system performance, and enhance data reliability, while collaborating with stakeholders across IT, finance, and operations.



  





**Leadership** 



* Plans, manages, and reviews team performance to monitor achievement of key performance indicators.
* Provides timely feedback, coaching, and development to strengthen team capabilities.
* Proposes and implements initiatives aligned with the IA strategic direction.
* Leads or supports IA strategic initiatives and advocates for positive change in work practices.
* Build a high\-performing, future\-ready IA team aligned with strategic business goals.



  





**Quality \& Operations** 



* Ensures QAIP feedback is addressed effectively to enhance engagement quality and team capability.
* Promotes adherence to quality standards across all IA activities.
* Supports continuous improvement by identifying and implementing process enhancements and best practices.
* Drive culture of continuous improvement and excellence in audit execution.



  





**Business Partnering** 



* Builds and maintains strong client relationships to stay informed and aligned with evolving business needs.
* Develops cross\-functional relationships across TAQA to enable knowledge sharing within IA and across TAQA.
* Supports Directors at portfolio\-level reporting and insights, as required.
* Strengthen IA’s role as a trusted advisor and strategic business partner.



  





**Collaboration \& IA Strategy** 



* Shares knowledge and expertise across the IA team to enhance capability and consistency.
* Collaborates with peers and other IA teams to optimize resource use and deliver quality outcomes.
* Constructively challenges peers to enhance performance
* Recognize and celebrate collaborative behavior.
* Leverages IA Operations support to minimize administrative workload and improve efficiency.
* Foster collaborative, high\-performing culture that drives collective IA team success.
* Actively support in strategic initiatives implementation ensuring quality and timely completion of assigned tasks.



  





**Policies and Procedures** 



* Undertake all audit activities in line with IA’s policies and procedures.
* Ensure performed audit work comply with the pertinent internal audit P\&Ps and Global IIA Standards.
* Ensures consistent compliance for all assigned audit activities, reinforcing the credibility and reliability of the Internal Audit Function.



  





**Education** 



* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
* Professional certification: Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA),



 Certified Risk and Information System Controls (CRISC)
 



 Certified Internal Auditor (CIA)
 



  





**Experience** 



* 8\-10\+ years of experience in leading technology audits or advisory in related areas. 3 to 4 years of leading audit teams.

**Overview:** 




  





 As the Individual and Unit Coach at Al\-Qadsiah Club, you will specialise in developing the technical abilities and individual behaviours of Academy players across multiple age groups. You will play a key role in delivering individual development programmes aligned with the club’s game model, supporting both player progression and overall team performance.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Leadership and Management** 




  




* Collaborate with the Head of Individual Development to deliver the Academy’s Individual Development Model

**Individual Development and Coaching** 




  




* Deliver high\-quality individual and small group coaching sessions focused on technical development and behaviour
* Design and deliver position\-specific and unit\-based training aligned to the Qadsiah Game Model
* Support players across all Academy age groups (U13–U21\) in their individual development journeys
* Provide targeted feedback during team training sessions to support individual player progression



  





**Analysis and Performance Support** 




  




* Lead the design and delivery of video analysis sessions for individual and small group development
* Maintain and develop a library of training sessions and best practice content using club platforms (IterPro, Hudl, SportsCode)
* Collaborate with the Performance Analysis department to enhance player development resources



  





**Collaboration and Player Development** 




  




* Contribute to Individual Development Plans and player performance reviews
* Work closely with multidisciplinary staff across the Academy to support holistic player development
* Engage with coaching staff to ensure alignment between individual and team objectives



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





**Desirable:** 




  




* AFC Pro License or UEFA equivalent
* FIFA Guardian safeguarding qualification
* Skills, Knowledge and Experience:



  





**Essential** 
 :
 



  




* AFC A License or UEFA equivalent
* Proven experience coaching elite academy players
* Strong understanding of individual player development across different age groups
* Ability to deliver structured and targeted individual coaching sessions
* Experience working collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams
* Strong communication skills and ability to engage players effectively
* Proactive and structured approach to problem\-solving
* Comfortable working within a new cultural and professional environment
* Fluency in English



  





**Desirable:** 




  




* Experience using performance and analysis platforms such as IterPro, Hudl, and SportsCode
* Multilingual capability, including Arabic or Spanish
* Previous experience as a professional footballer Experience working in the Middle East
* Strong leadership and teamwork experience



  





  





**Why Join Al\-Qadsiah?** 




  





 Be Part of the Legacy: Join a club that’s redefining the future of Saudi sports, striving to lead the competition and set new standards of excellence.
 



  





 Experience the Culture: Thrive in an environment that values quality, accountability, diversity, synergy, innovation, and ambition, while embracing harmony—this is the Qadsiah Way.

**If this role is of interest, then please press the apply button and include a copy of your CV.**

 This is more than just a job! It’s an opportunity to be part of something larger than yourself. At Al\-Qadsiah, you’ll play a key role in shaping our legacy, contributing to the nation’s sports vision, and making history every step of the way.
   

  




**Overview:**

 The Head of Ticketing \& Memberships is responsible for the strategic leadership, performance and development of the end\-to\-end Al Qadsiah Club ticketing \& memberships function. The role ensures that ticketing activity maximizes income and attendance, supports audience and membership growth, delivers excellent customer \& fan experience and provides high\-quality data and insight to inform organizational decision making. This role provides oversight of pricing, sales channels, CRM (shared responsibility with Head of Digital) and audience insight, while overseeing day\-to\-day operational delivery and acts as the organization’s senior authority on ticketing and data governance systems and sales performance.
   

  

  





**Key Responsibilities:**



* Collaborate with the CCO to develop and implement the Club’s ticketing \& membership strategy in alignment with organizational priorities, revenue targets, and audience development goals, building on the growth and learnings from the past 2 seasons.
* Manage tickets, memberships and experiences pricing, discounting, and yield strategies to balance revenue generation, accessibility, and audience growth.
* Working closely with the Aramco Stadium Team, monitor ticket sales performance against targets, forecast revenue, and adjust pricing or inventory strategies in response to demand and market trends.
* Oversee all ticketing systems, CRM platforms, and third\-party integrations to ensure effective configuration, data integrity, and operational efficiency across events and sales channels.
* Manage all events on sales processes, including CRM setup and ticket inventory configuration, ensuring accuracy and operational readiness.
* Ensure a high standard of customer experience across all ticketing and box\-office operations by establishing and maintaining customer service standards.
* Maintain, amend and enforce ticketing policies and procedures, including refunds, exchanges, discounts, and accessibility provisions, ensuring consistency and compliance.
* Utilize CRM and ticketing data to generate insights that support reporting, marketing initiatives, and audience development strategies.
* Ensure compliance with data protection regulations and organizational policies related to customer data management within the ticketing function.


* Lead and develop the ticketing \& memberships team by providing clear direction, performance management, training, and operational oversight to ensure efficient service delivery.


 Requirements
   

  

* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Marketing, Sports Management, or related field is preferred.


* **Experience:** 
 5\-7 years in ticketing, box office operations and/or CRM leadership (ideally within a sports/entertainment venue environment)
* **Skills:**



 \- Commercial Acumen: Strong ability to drive revenue through pricing strategies, yield management, and sales optimization across multiple channels.
   





 \- Data\-Driven Decision Making: Advanced capability in interpreting ticketing and CRM data to generate actionable insights, forecast demand, and influence strategy.
   





 \- CRM \& Ticketing Systems Expertise: Deep understanding of ticketing platforms and CRM ecosystems, including segmentation, automation, and customer lifecycle management.
   





 \- Strategic Thinking: Ability to translate organizational goals into scalable ticketing and membership strategies that drive both short\-term revenue and long\-term fan growth.
   





 \- Leadership \& Team Management: Proven experience in leading, developing, and scaling high\-performing teams with clear KPIs and accountability frameworks.
   





 \- Stakeholder Management: Strong collaboration skills with senior leadership, media, operations, and external partners to align commercial objectives.
   





 \- Customer Experience Orientation: Understanding of fan behavior and expectations, with the ability to design seamless, high\-quality end\-to\-end customer journeys.
   





 \- Financial \& Forecasting Skills: Strong budgeting, forecasting, and revenue tracking capabilities.
   





  




* **Preferred Experience \& Qualifications:**



 \- Experience within a professional sports club, major entertainment venue, or large\-scale event organization.
   





 \- Proven track record of driving ticketing revenue growth and increasing attendance in a competitive market.
   





 \- Experience implementing or optimizing CRM strategies tied to fan engagement, memberships, and retention.
   





 \- Experience working in high\-growth or transformation environments, where systems, processes, and strategies are being built or scaled.
   





 \- Master’s degree in business, Sports Management, or a related field is a plus.
   

  

  

  




 Benefits

data.raw_snippet:

data.jd_text:
**About Keyrock**
 Since our beginnings in 2017, we've grown to be a leading change\-maker in the digital asset space, renowned for our partnerships and innovation.
   

  

 Today, we rock with over 180 team members around the world. Our diverse team hails from 42 nationalities, with backgrounds ranging from DeFi natives to PhDs. Predominantly remote, we have hubs in London, Brussels and Singapore, and host regular online and offline hangouts to keep the crew tight.
   

  

 We are trading on more than 80 exchanges, and working with a wide array of asset issuers. As a well\-established market maker, our distinctive expertise led us to expand rapidly. Today, our services span market making, options trading, high\-frequency trading, OTC, and DeFi trading desks.
   

  

 But we’re more than a service provider. We’re an initiator. We're pioneers in adopting the Rust development language for our algorithmic trading, and champions of its use in the industry. We support the growth of Web3 startups through our Accelerator Program. We upgrade ecosystems by injecting liquidity into promising DeFi, RWA, and NFT protocols. And we push the industry's progress with our research and governance initiatives.
   

  

 At Keyrock, we're not just envisioning the future of digital assets. We're actively building it.
   

  

**Mission statement**
 The
 **Tech Lead** 
 plays a pivotal role in bridging
 **business objectives** 
 with
 **technical execution** 
 . This role is not purely managerial nor solely individual contributor, but a
 **hybrid position** 
 that combines
 **hands\-on engineering** 
 ,
 **architectural leadership** 
 , and
 **team enablement** 
 . A Tech Lead ensures delivery excellence by actively contributing to the codebase, guiding the team technically, and aligning execution with long\-term strategic goals.
   

  

 At Keyrock, the
 **Tech Lead** 
 is a
 **senior technical contributor** 
 who drives the
 **implementation and delivery** 
 of engineering initiatives within their Business Unit. The Tech Lead is accountable for
 **technical execution and delivery quality** 
 , ensuring that systems are built to high standards of reliability, performance, and maintainability.
   

  

 While the
 **Head of Engineering (HoE)** 
 focuses on
 **strategic alignment \-** 
 ensuring that engineering outcomes meet the broader objectives agreed with the
 **Head of Product (HoP) \-** 
 the Tech Lead operates as the
 **executional deputy** 
 , translating those strategic objectives into code, architecture, and delivery outcomes.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Act as the technical point of accountability for the Service Market Making Business Unit.
* Balance strategic thinking with pragmatic delivery, ensuring systems are built to last while meeting immediate needs.
* Champion collaboration across teams, ensuring alignment between product, design, QA, and engineering.
* Inspire and develop engineers through mentorship, coaching, and technical guidance, fostering growth and autonomy within the team.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Drive Delivery and Alignment: Partner with the Head of Engineering to own delivery of entire work\-streams, ensuring architecture and engineering decisions align with both immediate requirements and business strategy.
* Balance Code and Leadership: Contribute directly through coding, while also focusing on architecture design, peer reviews, and cross\-functional communication.
* Mentor and Elevate Engineers: Provide structured feedback through design and code reviews, support skill development, and empower junior and mid\-level engineers to take ownership.
* Technical Leadership: Guide system design, ensure scalability and resilience, and optimise performance across applications and infrastructure.
* Maintain Standards: Uphold engineering best practices, enforce coding guidelines, and partner with QA to embed automation and validation in the delivery pipeline.
* Codebase Health: Manage technical debt, lead refactoring initiatives, and ensure long\-term maintainability and operational excellence.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to define scope, refine requirements, and plan delivery in a transparent and predictable manner.
* Risk Management: Anticipate technical risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs early, and propose mitigations to safeguard delivery timelines.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
* 5\+ years in a Technical Leadership position guiding teams, shaping architecture, and driving delivery of complex projects
* Demonstrated expertise in architecting and maintaining high\-concurrency, low\-latency trading systems at scale
* Advanced proficiency in Rust; working knowledge of Node.js (JavaScript/TypeScript) and Python is an advantage
* Deep experience with data\-intensive architectures and real\-time data pipelines
* Proven track record deploying, optimising and operating AWS environments for ultra\-low\-latency workloads
* Hands\-on experience containerising applications and managing Kubernetes clusters in production
* Familiarity with GitOps workflows to automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration and deployments
* Solid command of software engineering best practices, including Agile methodologies, DevOps principles and end\-to\-end CI/CD pipelines
* Knowledge of DevSecFinOps principles to embed security, compliance and cost\-governance throughout the delivery lifecycle
* Demonstrated leadership of engineering teams, with a commitment to fostering collaboration, mentorship and continuous professional growth
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills, able to partner effectively with Product, Architecture, Quantitative Research and Operations
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset, with a passion for building scalable, reliable and secure systems
* Deep domain knowledge of finance and trading, particularly within the cryptocurrency sector
* Experience in fast\-paced, dynamic financial or fintech environments is highly desirable


 We would like the successful candidate to be based in the UK or Europe. Remote and flexible work options are available.
   

  

 Soft Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Ownership \& Reliability – Take full responsibility for your work. Deliver high\-quality service, meet deadlines, and follow through on commitments. Anticipate and proactively address potential issues before they arise.
* Initiative \& Problem\-Solving – Approach challenges with a problem\-solving entrepreneurial mindset. Make sound, independent judgments and take the initiative to drive solutions rather than waiting for instructions.
* Operational Diligence – Respond strategically to technical and operational challenges, ensuring robust and reliable trading infrastructure while instilling confidence in the team’s processes.
* Curiosity \& Growth Mindset – Continuously seek to improve your technical skills and knowledge. Stay ahead of industry trends and take the initiative to practice and explore new technologies that excite you.
* Excellent Communication Skills with a team player mindset, collaborating within a fully remote global team.


 We would like the successful candidate to be based in the UK or Europe. Remote and flexible work options are available.
   

  

**Our recruitment philosophy**
 We value self\-awareness in our recruitment process. We seek people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.
   

  

**Our offer**
* A competitive salary package, with various benefits depending on the method of engagement (employee or freelancer).
* Autonomy in your time management thanks to flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely
* The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence


 As an employer we are committed to build an inclusive, diverse and non\-discriminating work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, creed and sexual orientation. We hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.
   

  

 Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

 Today, we rock with over 180 team members around the world. Our diverse team hails from 42 nationalities, with backgrounds ranging from DeFi natives to PhDs. Predominantly remote, we have hubs in London, Brussels and Singapore, and host regular online and offline hangouts to keep the crew tight.
   

  

 We are trading on more than 80 exchanges, and working with a wide array of asset issuers. As a well\-established market maker, our distinctive expertise led us to expand rapidly. Today, our services span market making, options trading, high\-frequency trading, OTC, and DeFi trading desks.
   

  

 But we’re more than a service provider. We’re an initiator. We're pioneers in adopting the Rust development language for our algorithmic trading, and champions of its use in the industry. We support the growth of Web3 startups through our Accelerator Program. We upgrade ecosystems by injecting liquidity into promising DeFi, RWA, and NFT protocols. And we push the industry's progress with our research and governance initiatives.
   

  

 At Keyrock, we're not just envisioning the future of digital assets. We're actively building it.
   

  

**Mission statement**
 The
 **Tech Lead** 
 plays a pivotal role in bridging
 **business objectives** 
 with
 **technical execution** 
 . This role is not purely managerial nor solely individual contributor, but a
 **hybrid position** 
 that combines
 **hands\-on engineering** 
 ,
 **architectural leadership** 
 , and
 **team enablement** 
 . A Tech Lead ensures delivery excellence by actively contributing to the codebase, guiding the team technically, and aligning execution with long\-term strategic goals.
   

  

 At Keyrock, the
 **Tech Lead** 
 is a
 **senior technical contributor** 
 who drives the
 **implementation and delivery** 
 of engineering initiatives within their Business Unit. The Tech Lead is accountable for
 **technical execution and delivery quality** 
 , ensuring that systems are built to high standards of reliability, performance, and maintainability.
   

  

 While the
 **Head of Engineering (HoE)** 
 focuses on
 **strategic alignment \-** 
 ensuring that engineering outcomes meet the broader objectives agreed with the
 **Head of Product (HoP) \-** 
 the Tech Lead operates as the
 **executional deputy** 
 , translating those strategic objectives into code, architecture, and delivery outcomes.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Act as the technical point of accountability for the Service Market Making Business Unit.
* Balance strategic thinking with pragmatic delivery, ensuring systems are built to last while meeting immediate needs.
* Champion collaboration across teams, ensuring alignment between product, design, QA, and engineering.
* Inspire and develop engineers through mentorship, coaching, and technical guidance, fostering growth and autonomy within the team.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Drive Delivery and Alignment: Partner with the Head of Engineering to own delivery of entire work\-streams, ensuring architecture and engineering decisions align with both immediate requirements and business strategy.
* Balance Code and Leadership: Contribute directly through coding, while also focusing on architecture design, peer reviews, and cross\-functional communication.
* Mentor and Elevate Engineers: Provide structured feedback through design and code reviews, support skill development, and empower junior and mid\-level engineers to take ownership.
* Technical Leadership: Guide system design, ensure scalability and resilience, and optimise performance across applications and infrastructure.
* Maintain Standards: Uphold engineering best practices, enforce coding guidelines, and partner with QA to embed automation and validation in the delivery pipeline.
* Codebase Health: Manage technical debt, lead refactoring initiatives, and ensure long\-term maintainability and operational excellence.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to define scope, refine requirements, and plan delivery in a transparent and predictable manner.
* Risk Management: Anticipate technical risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs early, and propose mitigations to safeguard delivery timelines.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
* 5\+ years in a Technical Leadership position guiding teams, shaping architecture, and driving delivery of complex projects
* Demonstrated expertise in architecting and maintaining high\-concurrency, low\-latency trading systems at scale
* Advanced proficiency in Rust; working knowledge of Node.js (JavaScript/TypeScript) and Python is an advantage
* Deep experience with data\-intensive architectures and real\-time data pipelines
* Proven track record deploying, optimising and operating AWS environments for ultra\-low\-latency workloads
* Hands\-on experience containerising applications and managing Kubernetes clusters in production
* Familiarity with GitOps workflows to automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration and deployments
* Solid command of software engineering best practices, including Agile methodologies, DevOps principles and end\-to\-end CI/CD pipelines
* Knowledge of DevSecFinOps principles to embed security, compliance and cost\-governance throughout the delivery lifecycle
* Demonstrated leadership of engineering teams, with a commitment to fostering collaboration, mentorship and continuous professional growth
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills, able to partner effectively with Product, Architecture, Quantitative Research and Operations
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset, with a passion for building scalable, reliable and secure systems
* Deep domain knowledge of finance and trading, particularly within the cryptocurrency sector
* Experience in fast\-paced, dynamic financial or fintech environments is highly desirable


 We would like the successful candidate to be based in the UK or Europe. Remote and flexible work options are available.
   

  

 Soft Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Ownership \& Reliability – Take full responsibility for your work. Deliver high\-quality service, meet deadlines, and follow through on commitments. Anticipate and proactively address potential issues before they arise.
* Initiative \& Problem\-Solving – Approach challenges with a problem\-solving entrepreneurial mindset. Make sound, independent judgments and take the initiative to drive solutions rather than waiting for instructions.
* Operational Diligence – Respond strategically to technical and operational challenges, ensuring robust and reliable trading infrastructure while instilling confidence in the team’s processes.
* Curiosity \& Growth Mindset – Continuously seek to improve your technical skills and knowledge. Stay ahead of industry trends and take the initiative to practice and explore new technologies that excite you.
* Excellent Communication Skills with a team player mindset, collaborating within a fully remote global team.


 We would like the successful candidate to be based in the UK or Europe. Remote and flexible work options are available.
   

  

**Our recruitment philosophy**
 We value self\-awareness in our recruitment process. We seek people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.
   

  

**Our offer**
* A competitive salary package, with various benefits depending on the method of engagement (employee or freelancer).
* Autonomy in your time management thanks to flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely
* The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence


 As an employer we are committed to build an inclusive, diverse and non\-discriminating work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, creed and sexual orientation. We hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.
   

  

 Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

This role requires strong analytical skills, stakeholder management capability, and business acumen to navigate competing priorities and drive data\-driven portfolio decisions.
   

  

 Key Accountablities
   

  

* Design and operate AI portfolio management framework including intake process, evaluation criteria, and prioritization methodology
* Manage portfolio pipeline across 8 OpCos from ideation through deployment and value realization
* Develop comprehensive business cases for AI initiatives including value hypothesis, KPIs, ROI models, and implementation roadmaps
* Facilitate quarterly portfolio review with OpCo AI Office Heads and Group leadership for prioritization decisions
* Track and report portfolio performance including delivery metrics, financial impact, and strategic value
* Identify and escalate portfolio risks, dependencies, and blockers requiring executive intervention
* Partner with OpCo business owners to refine use case requirements and ensure business alignment
* Contribute market intelligence, competitive benchmarking, and emerging AI trends to strategy refresh
* Prepare executive materials for GCEO/CFO steering committees and Board reporting

**KPIs Can Include But Are Not Limited To**
* Portfolio value delivery: realized financial benefits vs. committed business cases
* Pipeline health: number of qualified use cases in pipeline and conversion rate to execution
* Decision quality: percentage of approved initiatives successfully deployed and delivering value
* Stakeholder satisfaction: OpCo and executive satisfaction with portfolio process and transparency
* Reporting timeliness: on\-time delivery of portfolio reports and executive materials


 What We Need From You
   

  

 Educational Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, or related field. MBA or relevant advanced degree preferred.
   

  

 Experience: 3\-4 years in strategy consulting, portfolio management, business analysis, or related field. Experience with business case development, financial modeling, and executive stakeholder management. Exposure to AI/digital transformation initiatives advantageous.
   

  

 Knowledge: Strong analytical and financial modeling skills. Understanding of AI technologies and use case patterns. Experience with portfolio management frameworks and prioritization methodologies. Excellent business acumen and strategic thinking.
   

  

**About Application Process**
 If you meet the criteria and you are enthusiastic about the role, we would welcome your application. To complete the application you would need the following document(s):
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Passport\-size photograph
* Highest Education Qualification

**Job Title:** 
 Technical Project Manager\- Post Merger Integration
   

  

**Term:** 
 9 months
   

  

**Location:** 
 Kuwait City, Kuwait
   

  

**Division:** 
 Retail Banking
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Business Head\- Retail Banking
   

  

**Relevant experience:** 
 Minimum 10 years in project/ programme management; minimum 5 years in retail banking M\&A/ PMI
   

  

**Mandatory requirements:**
* Proven, hands\-on retail bank merger integration experience (Day 1 readiness through post\-merger stabilisation)
* Experience operating or establishing an Integration Management Office (IMO)
* English Fluency (\& Arabic Preferred)
* Immediately Available


**Purpose of Project:**
 As part of the retail bank merger, this role is responsible for owning and managing all technology and technical product elements of the integration programme. The Technical Product Manager bridges the gap between business integration objectives and technical execution — defining the technology roadmap, managing system integration work streams, and ensuring seamless delivery of core banking, digital, and data migration components across the merging entities.
   

  

**Key Activities:**
* Own the technology integration roadmap from discovery through to live cutover and post\-migration stabilisation
* Lead API mapping, system architecture design, and integration specifications across all platforms
* Manage core banking system integration, digital channel consolidation, data migration, and infrastructure cutover
* Coordinate with engineering teams, technology vendors, and business work stream leads to align technical deliverables to programme milestones
* Define and maintain integration playbooks, API specifications, technical run books, and cutover plans \[jobs.dcg.co]
* Monitor system performance (latency, reliability, transaction integrity) during and post\-integration


**Core Responsibilities:**
* Technology Strategy \& Roadmap Ownership — Define, own, and execute the technology integration strategy and product roadmap, aligning to the merger's business objectives, regulatory requirements, and IT architecture standards. Prioritise technology workstreams to maximise integration velocity and minimise customer disruption.
* Core Banking \& System Integration — Lead the integration of core banking platforms, digital channels, payment systems, and data infrastructure across the two merging entities. Manage vendor relationships with core banking providers, ensuring timely certifications and technical sign\-off at each integration milestone.
* Product Lifecycle Management (SDLC) — Drive end\-to\-end product delivery using Agile and SDLC best practices — from requirements gathering and technical design, through development, UAT, and live deployment. Maintain integration backlogs, sprint plans, and release schedules in tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Stakeholder Engagement \& Technical Communication — Act as the primary liaison between senior business stakeholders, engineering teams, IT vendors, and Compliance/Legal. Translate complex technical dependencies into business\-friendly language for SteerCo and executive audiences.
* Data Migration \& Quality Assurance — Oversee end\-to\-end data migration strategy, including data mapping, cleansing, reconciliation, and post migration validation. Ensure data integrity and regulatory compliance (GDPR, local data residency laws) throughout.
* Risk, Performance \& Continuous Improvement — Identify, assess, and mitigate technology risks (integration failures, system downtime, data loss). Monitor live integration performance metrics and iterate rapidly to resolve issues, ensuring system reliability and SLA adherence post\-cutover.


**KPIs**
* % of technology milestones delivered on schedule and within budget
* System uptime and availability during cutover windows (target: 99\.9%\+)
* Data migration accuracy rate (target: 100% reconciled with zero data loss)
* Number of integration defects / severity\-1 incidents post\-cutover
* API integration delivery timelines vs. plan
* Time to complete core banking system cutover vs. target
* Business stakeholder satisfaction with technical delivery (SteerCo rating)


**Knowledge And Experience**
* 8\+ years of product management or technology delivery experience in fintech, banking, or financial services
* 3\+ years leading integrations with banks, payment processors, or core financial systems \[tealhq.com]
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of core banking platforms (e.g., Temenos T24, Oracle FLEXCUBE, Finacle, Mambu, Fiserv, Jack Henry)
* Expertise in payment rails: SWIFT, SEPA, ACH, RTP, and local real\-time payment schemes
* Experience with data architecture, pipelines, and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP)
* Solid understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies, and DevOps practices \[jobs.anitab.org]
* Experience working in regulated banking environments — familiar with regulatory technology requirements and compliance obligations during system transitions


**Mandatory Skills\*\***
* Proven experience managing technology integration workstreams in a banking M\&A or large\-scale transformation context
* Hands\-on technical fluency with core banking platforms, APIs, and system architecture
* Track record of end\-to\-end product lifecycle management in regulated financial environments
* Familiarity with payment rails (SWIFT, ACH, local real\-time payment schemes), data migration, and digital channel consolidation
* Agile/SAFe certified (PMI\-ACP or equivalent); TOGAF or ITIL

data.jd_text:
SaaS Business Unit Manager
 



  





 Sales, Growth, Customer Success \& Operations
 



  





**About the Company** 




  





 We are an established technology company in Kuwait with several years of market experience, a growing base of more than 600 business customers, and strong relationships with leading local and international partners.
 



  





 The company operates in the business technology sector, providing software, SaaS, payment\-related solutions, hardware, and digital business tools for SMEs and enterprise clients. The SaaS business unit is already active in the market and is now entering a new growth stage that requires stronger structure, leadership, sales execution, customer success, and scalable operations.
 



  





 This is not a role to build something from zero. It is an opportunity to lead and scale an existing business line with real customers, proven demand, market credibility, and strong growth potential.
 



  





  





  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We are looking for a strong, hands\-on SaaS Business Unit Manager to lead the growth and daily operations of our SaaS product in Kuwait.
 



  





 This is a key leadership role for someone who can combine B2B sales, growth execution, customer onboarding, customer success, technical support operations, team building, and process management.
 



  





 The right candidate will take ownership of the SaaS business unit and help build it into a scalable, well\-organized, and high\-growth operation.
 



  





  





**Why Join Us** 




  





 This is not a narrow sales or operations role. It is an opportunity to lead and grow a complete SaaS business unit with direct impact on revenue, customer experience, team structure, and market expansion.
 



  





 You will work closely with senior management, have clear ownership, and play a central role in building the company’s SaaS growth engine in Kuwait.
 



  





  





 1\. Role Objective
 



  





 Lead the full commercial and operational performance of the SaaS business unit, including sales, growth, marketing coordination, onboarding, customer success, technical support, team management, and daily execution.
 



  





 The goal is to build a scalable SaaS operation with clear ownership, structure, and measurable performance, allowing senior management to focus on strategic partnerships, major deals, and product development.
 



  





  





  





 2\. Sales \& Revenue
 



  





 Own sales targets, pipeline management, lead follow\-up, demos, closing activities, renewals, and revenue growth.
 



  





 Build and manage a structured sales process, improve conversion rates, train the sales team, and ensure full CRM discipline.
 



  





  





 3\. Growth \& Marketing
 



  





 Coordinate with marketing to generate qualified leads through campaigns, offers, content, landing pages, WhatsApp messages, and sector\-specific promotions.
 



  





 Measure marketing impact based on lead quality, conversion rate, customer acquisition, and revenue generated.
 



  





  





 4\. Customer Onboarding
 



  





 Manage the full onboarding journey from contract signing to go\-live.
 



  





 Create clear onboarding checklists, assign responsibilities, reduce activation delays, and ensure customers start using the system properly.
 



  





  





  





 5\. Customer Success \& Retention
 



  





 Ensure customer satisfaction, product adoption, renewals, upselling, and churn reduction.
 



  





 Monitor customer issues and usage patterns, identify at\-risk customers early, and build proactive follow\-up processes.
 



  





  





  





 6\. Technical Support Operations
 



  





 Organize daily technical support operations, ticket handling, issue classification, escalation rules, response time, and resolution follow\-up.
 



  





 Coordinate between customers, support staff, technical teams, and management to ensure fast and professional support.
 



  





  





  





 7\. Team Management
 



  





 Plan, hire, train, and manage the required sales, onboarding, customer success, and support teams.
 



  





 Set KPIs, monitor performance, improve discipline, and build a culture of accountability, teamwork, and customer service quality.
 



  





  





  





 8\. Operations \& Processes
 



  





 Build and improve SOPs for sales, onboarding, support, reporting, internal coordination, and customer follow\-up.
 



  





 Reduce operational chaos, dependency on individuals, and create a scalable operating system for the SaaS business.
 



  





  





  





 9\. Product \& Market Feedback
 



  





 Collect feedback from customers, sales, onboarding, and support teams.
 



  





 Organize product improvement requests and coordinate with the development/product team based on business impact, customer value, and scalability.
 



  





  





  





 10\. Reporting \& KPIs
 



  





 Prepare weekly and monthly reports covering sales, MRR, pipeline, onboarding, support, churn, renewals, complaints, team productivity, and operational risks.
 



  





 Track key KPIs including leads, demos, closed deals, conversion rate, onboarding time, support tickets, response time, resolution time, customer satisfaction, and churn.
 



  





  





  





 11\. Authority \& Execution
 



  





 The manager has the authority to prepare business plans, growth plans, sales plans, operational plans, hiring needs, tools, systems, and required resources.
 



  





 Once approved by senior management, the manager has full authority and responsibility to execute the approved plan and manage daily operations within the approved scope.
 



  





  





  





 12\. Required Experience
 



  





 Strong experience in B2B sales, preferably in SaaS, software, POS, fintech, payments, or business technology.
 



  





 Minimum 5 years of experience in the Kuwaiti market is required, with strong understanding of SMEs, restaurants, retail, and local customer behavior.
 



  





  





  





 13\. Language Requirement
 



  





 Fluency in both Arabic and English is mandatory.
 



  





 The candidate must communicate professionally in both languages with customers, teams, partners, vendors, and senior management.
 



  





  





  





 14\. Required Skills
 



  





 Strong sales leadership, operational discipline, customer success mindset, problem\-solving, follow\-up, reporting, and team management skills.
 



  





 The ideal candidate is organized, data\-driven, commercially strong, customer\-focused, and able to build processes and teams from scratch.

**Job location: Dushanbe, Tajikistan** 




**Salary: competitive** 




  





 About the role
 



  





 The General Manager is responsible for the overall operational, administrative, financial, and strategic management of the hospital. The role ensures efficient hospital operations, high\-quality patient care, regulatory compliance, financial sustainability, and achievement of organizational goals.
 



 The General Manager provides leadership to all hospital departments and ensures alignment with healthcare standards, patient safety requirements, and hospital policies.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Operational Management
 


* Oversee daily hospital operations and ensure smooth functioning of all departments.
* Monitor operational efficiency, patient flow, and service quality.
* Develop and implement operational strategies and improvement plans.

 Strategic Leadership

 Financial Management

* Monitor revenue, expenses, procurement, and resource allocation.
* Ensure financial sustainability and operational profitability.



  





 Compliance \& Quality

* Lead internal audits and corrective action plans.



  





 Human Resource Management

* Support recruitment, performance management, staff development, and retention.
* Promote professional discipline and organizational culture.



  





 Patient Experience
 


* Ensure high standards of patient care and patient satisfaction.
* Handle escalated complaints and critical operational issues.
* Implement service quality improvement initiatives.



  





 Reporting \& Administration
 


* Prepare operational and management reports for senior leadership.
* Monitor KPIs, departmental performance, and operational targets.
* Maintain confidentiality of hospital and patient information.



  





 Requirements
 



  





 Education
 


* Bachelor’s Degree in Healthcare Management, Hospital Administration, Business Administration, or related field.
* Master’s Degree is preferred.



  





 Experience
 


* Minimum 10 years of experience as a General Manager in the hospital or healthcare industry.
* Strong experience managing multi\-department hospital operations.

 Skills \& Competencies
 


* Strong leadership and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent operational and financial management abilities.
* Strong knowledge of healthcare regulations and hospital standards.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage large teams and complex healthcare operations.
* Strong problem\-solving and crisis management skills.



  





 Language

**About Becurious Preschool**

 BeCurious is a premium Finnish\-method preschool operating across three branches in Kuwait — Salam, Shuhada, and Salwa. Founded on the principle that curiosity is the most powerful force in early childhood learning, BeCurious has built a proprietary curriculum framework, a structured operating system, and a community of families who choose us for the quality of thinking behind everything we do.
   

  

 We are growing. We are building. And we are looking for the person who will run the engine.
   

  

**The Role**
* The Director of Operations is the operational backbone of BeCurious.
* This is not a coordination role. It is not a support role. The DOO is the person who makes sure that every session in every branch is delivered at the BeCurious standard — consistently, day after day, across all three locations.
* The DOO sits between the General Manager (who sets direction and owns the brand) and the Branch Supervisors (who run daily operations). Everything that matters operationally flows through this role.
* This role is right for you if you have a genuine love for early childhood education, a precise and organized mind, and the ability to hold a high standard without rigidity. You must be comfortable holding people accountable with warmth — not through fear, and not by doing their job for them.


**Responsibilities**
* Operations — Three Branches, One Standard:
* Own the daily operational standard across all three branches — Salam, Shuhada, and Salwa.
* Conduct monthly Branch Reviews with each Branch Supervisor (08\.1\) — reviewing KPIs, flagging patterns, agreeing action plans.
* Ensure every SOP in the BeCurious OS is being followed at branch level — and escalate deviations immediately.
* Manage the scheduling system — session allocation, teacher assignment, Home Preschool routing during continuity periods.
* Own the Feedback Log (08\.4\) — capture, categorize, and respond to all feedback across branches.
* Lead the Quarterly SOP Review (08\.2\) with the GM — identifying what is working, what needs updating, what needs a rebuild.
* Ensure branch readiness for Ministry inspections at all times — not just before announced visits.


**Team And Teaching Quality**
* Line manage Branch Supervisors — three direct reports. Support them. Challenge them. Hold them to the standard.
* Ensure all teaching staff are progressing through the Teacher Training Framework (02\.1\) at the required pace for their role.
* Conduct or coordinate classroom observations at minimum once per quarter per branch (03\.8 Classroom Observation Guide).
* Own the teacher evaluation process (04\.3\) — ensure evaluations are completed on schedule and that feedback leads to action
* Identify teaching staff who are ready to grow and flag them to the GM. Identify those who are struggling and build a support plan.
* Ensure no teacher leads a session alone without completing the required training stage for their role.


**Admissions And Enrollment**
* Own the admissions pipeline across all branches in Odoo — lead stages, conversion rates, follow\-up discipline.
* Oversee the Admissions Coordinator role — review their performance, support their work, escalate decisions that require GM involvement.
* Monitor enrollment capacity across branches — flag when a branch is approaching capacity or running below target.
* Ensure every family completing a tour receives a structured follow\-up within the required SOP timeframe.
* Review lead\-to\-tour and tour\-to\-enrollment conversion rates monthly — identify patterns and surface them to the GM.


**Curriculum And Learning Quality**
* Ensure monthly theme plans are submitted by Lead Teachers on schedule and reviewed before the month begins.
* Ensure weekly planning documents (03\.3\) are completed and filed — not treated as optional paperwork.
* Monitor child observation records (03\.7\) for consistency and quality — flag teachers who are not completing them.
* Ensure the Curiosity Lens Framework is visible in classroom practice — not just in documentation.
* Coordinate with the GM on curriculum development priorities for the year.


**Governance And Reporting**
* Attend the Weekly Leadership Meeting every Monday — present the Weekly Scorecard (09\.3\) and surface decisions that require GM input.
* Ensure the OS Change Log (00\) is updated whenever an SOP, template, or standard is modified.
* Manage incident documentation — ensure every incident has a completed 07\.5 Incident Report filed within 24 hours.
* Maintain the staff register in Odoo — civil IDs, health certificates, first aid certifications current for all staff at all times.
* Support the GM in preparing for the Annual Blueprint Review (08\.3\) — compiling the years evidence and identifying structural questions.


**What This Role Is Not**
* The DOO does not teach classes. This is a leadership and operational role.
* The DOO does not bypass Branch Supervisors to manage teachers directly — the chain of command is respected in both directions.
* The DOO does not make brand decisions — that is the GM's domain. The DOO executes brand standards. They do not change them.
* The DOO does not have financial signing authority above the limits in the authority matrix (04\.0\). Spending decisions above those limits go to the GM.
* The DOO's job is to make the standard work at scale. Not to be liked by everyone. Not to avoid difficult conversations. To make BeCurious excellent, consistently, across three branches.


**You Are The Right Person If**
**You will thrive in this role if you** 
 \|
 **This role is not right for you if you:**
* Have genuine experience in early childhood education or school operations — at least 4 years \| Are looking for a purely administrative or desk\-based role.
* Have managed a team before and understand that management means accountability, not friendship \| Expect to be liked by everyone you hold to a standard.
* Are organized to a degree that other people find remarkable — you track details without being reminded \| Find systematic documentation burdensome rather than protective.
* Can hold a high standard with warmth — you challenge people without humiliating them \| Prefer to avoid difficult conversations until they become crises.
* Are bilingual Arabic\-English — you operate at full professional quality in both languages \| Cannot communicate fluently and professionally in Arabic.
* Believe that curiosity in children is worth protecting — this is not a generic school for you \| See early childhood as a stepping stone to a different field.
* Understand that a system is what makes quality scalable — and you want to build that system \| Prefer to rely on improvisation and personal judgment over documented process.


**Required**
**Qualifications and Experience:**
* Minimum 4 years of experience in early childhood education, preschool management, or educational operations.
* Demonstrated experience managing a team — minimum 3 direct reports.
* Bilingual Arabic and English — professional fluency in both.
* Practical experience with a school management system (Odoo, Brightwheel, or equivalent).
* Based in Kuwait or able to relocate immediately — this is a full presence role across three branches.


**Strongly Preferred**
* Bachelor's degree in Early Childhood Education, Educational Leadership, or Business Administration.
* Experience with Finnish or play\-based education methodology.
* Experience leading or contributing to a curriculum quality review process.
* Experience with the Kuwait Ministry of Social Affairs licensing and inspection process.
* Demonstrated track record of improving operational consistency in a multi\-site environment.


**What BeCurious Offers**
**What You Get \| Detail:**
* A real leadership role \| Not a coordinator title with manager responsibilities. The DOO has genuine authority and is expected to use it.
* A built operating system \| BeCurious has a documented OS — SOPs, templates, review cycles, governance. You are inheriting a system and improving it. You are not building from nothing.
* Direct access to the founder \| Weekly leadership meeting with the Strategic Head and General Manager. Your voice shapes what BeCurious becomes.
* A curriculum you can believe in \| The Curiosity Lens Framework is a genuine educational philosophy. This is not a franchise curriculum or a generic play programme.
* Compensation \| Competitive, commensurate with experience. Discussed at the offer stage.
* Growth \| As BeCurious grows — more branches, Club, Camp — the DOO role grows with it. The person who builds the operational foundation at this stage has a significant role in the next one.


**How to Apply?**
 Send your CV and a short cover note (no more than one page) to the BeCurious HR Lead. In your cover note, answer one question: 'What does operational excellence look like in an early childhood setting, and how have you contributed to it?'
   

  

 We do not require a formal cover letter. We require a genuine answer to that question. Applications without a response to the question will not be reviewed.
   

  

 Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
   

  

* First stage: written review of CV and cover note.
* Second stage: structured conversation with the General Manager.
* Third stage: structured conversation with the Strategic Head.
* Final stage: offer and reference check.


 We move fast for the right person.
   

  

**About Emerge General Contracting Company**
 BeCurious is a Finnish\-inspired, play\-based preschool in Kuwait where children learn by doing, imagining, and exploring. We create joyful, inclusive classrooms and partner closely with families to help every child feel seen and thrive. As a team member, you’ll design hands\-on learning experiences, nurture curiosity and character, and work within a warm, supportive culture that celebrates each child’s uniqueness. If you’re caring, creative, and collaborative, you’ll feel right at home with us.

* Is responsible for developing the overall strategy for soil remediation in the assigned areas, it includes contracting strategies and management of contractors.
* Manage and coordinate multidiscipline engineering activities to ensure projects such as FEED (front end engineering design) studies and preparation, ITB (invitation to bid) check estimate preparation, LSTK (lump sum turnkey) tender package preparation are executed in a safe, efficient, cost effective and timely manner.
* Act as primary technical coordination interface with client to ensure that the client’s expectations are satisfied.
* Ensure the project conforms to the client’s approved Basis of Design and all applicable regulatory and code requirements.
* We’re looking for a Leader, Construction / Construction Project Manager to join our Ahmadi, Kuwait team. Be a part of Worley's dynamic team as we extend our management of the KERP program for another five years. With million m2 of land successfully cleared from contamination and million tons remediated, we're leading the charge in sustainable environmental restoration. Join us and contribute to this incredible journey of transforming contaminated sites into thriving ecosystems.
* When you work for us, you get the chance to join nearly 50,000 people all driven by a common purpose – delivering a more sustainable world. We’re excited about the challenges ahead. If you ask us, there’s never been a more rewarding time to work in the energy, chemical and resources sector


**What You'll Have**

* Maintains HSE focus within the team to ensure OHSE requirements included in design and procurement.


**Client Relationships**

* Proactively resolves performance, scope and schedule issues with the Client as they arises

**Scope Management**

* Compliance with requirements of the contract.
* Effective change control process application.
* Achievement of claims mitigation and claims management if appropriate.


**Cost Control**

* Promotes implementation of VIP (value improving practices) on the assigned project to achieve overall effectiveness of the use of capital on projects.


**Quality Management**
* Contributes to compliance with Worley policies and procedures.

**Team Management**
* Focuses team on achievement of milestones and other key project objectives.

**Design Management**
