* Ensures design team aware of, and complies with, applicable regulations and codes.
* Manages inter\-discipline interfaces effectively.


**About You**
 You will have Bachelor's degree in Engineering with a remarkable year of experience.
   

  

* Remarkable year of experience.
* You are an individual who is self\-motivated, proactive, and works well with a team.
* You will be seen as the Subject matter specialist for the resolution of issues arising across all areas of the job and be able to clearly explain complex processes that surround the role.
* We expect you to ensure the integrity of the work scope and that all work is carried\-out in accordance with applicable codes and standards.
* We expect you to mentor of less experienced members of staff including ‘hands on’ approach to the formulation and delivery of training programs for local Kuwaiti personnel.


**Why you should apply**
* Providing an agile culture and challenging work opportunities results in a positive work environment. Our people enjoy competitive compensation packages and a fun, personal, collaborative and safe working environment. We value equal employment opportunity and are committed to promoting fairness, equality and diversity.
* Our policy is to conduct background checks for all candidates who accept an offer of employment with us.


**Moving forward together**
 We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can bring themselves, and are heard. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by law.
   

  

 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.
   

  

 Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

data.title: ZAIN2269 - Tech & Platforms Director
data.raw_snippet:
**About The Role**
 The Director, Tech \& Platforms serves as the technical co\-leader of the AI Center of Excellence, owning the architecture, platforms, and engineering foundations that enable AI at scale across Zain Group. This director\-level role engages as a peer with Group technology director
data.jd_text:
**About The Role**
 The Director, Tech \& Platforms serves as the technical co\-leader of the AI Center of Excellence, owning the architecture, platforms, and engineering foundations that enable AI at scale across Zain Group. This director\-level role engages as a peer with Group technology directors (CTO, IT, Data, Security) and OpCo AI Office Heads to set technical strategy, enforce architecture standards, and ensure production\-ready AI systems. The Director defines Zain's AI reference architecture, leads platform selection and vendor management, establishes engineering practices, and builds internal technical capability. This role requires deep AI/ML platform expertise, enterprise architecture leadership, and the executive presence to influence senior stakeholders across a federated organization.
   

  

 Key Accountabilities
   

  

* Define and maintain Group AI reference architecture for GenAI, Agentic AI, ML, and intelligent automation
* Own AI platform strategy and service catalog including LLM platforms, orchestration, MLOps, and data platforms
* Lead platform evaluation, vendor selection, commercial negotiations, and implementation oversight
* Establish and enforce technical standards for AI delivery including coding practices, deployment patterns, and monitoring
* Chair Group AI Architecture Review Board with OpCo CTO/IT directors to drive alignment and manage exceptions
* Enable delivery teams with proven engineering practices, tooling, accelerators, and technical problem\-solving
* Define and oversee AI production operations including SLAs, monitoring, incident management, and continuous improvement
* Partner with Group CTO, IT, Data, and Security directors on platform integration, infrastructure, and compliance
* Serve as technical peer to 6 OpCo AI Office Heads for architecture guidance and cross\-OpCo alignment
* Build and develop high\-performing technical team of architects and engineers
* Manage structured knowledge transfer from Strategy\& and delivery partners to build internal capability


**KPIs Can Include But Are Not Limited To**
* Platform adoption: percentage of OpCos using shared Group AI platforms
* Time\-to\-production: average time from use case approval to production deployment
* Architecture compliance: percentage of initiatives aligned to reference architecture
* System reliability: uptime and performance of AI platforms meeting defined SLAs
* Internal capability: percentage of use cases delivered by internal team vs. external vendors


 What We Need From You
   

  

 Educational Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field. Master's degree in AI/ML, Data Science, or Computer Science preferred.
   

  

 Experience: 15\+ years in technology leadership roles with progression from engineering to architecture to leadership. Experience building and operating AI/ML platforms at enterprise scale, designing reference architectures, and leading technical teams in federated organizations. Telecom or complex regulated industry experience highly valuable.
   

  

 Knowledge: Deep expertise in GenAI/Agentic AI, MLOps/LLMOps, cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), data platforms, and enterprise integration. Strong understanding of architecture governance, platform operations, and vendor management. Experience with telecom BSS/OSS systems advantageous.
   

  

**About Application Process**
 If you meet the criteria and you are enthusiastic about the role, we would welcome your application. To complete the application you would need the following document(s):
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Passport\-size photograph
* Highest Education Qualification

data.jd_text:
**Position Overview**




 We are seeking an accomplished and commercially driven Lighting Sales Manager with a strong background in managing medium and large\-scale lighting projects across Kuwait. The ideal candidate will have well\-established relationships with engineering consultants, main contractors, and end clients, and will be capable of leading a sales team while personally driving key account development. You will take ownership of the full project sales cycle — from early specification influence through to order closure and delivery coordination.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




**Sales Leadership \& Strategy** 



* Develop and execute a structured sales strategy for lighting projects aligned with the company's annual revenue targets and growth objectives.
* Lead, mentor, and manage the lighting sales team, setting individual targets and conducting regular performance reviews.
* Report weekly and monthly project pipeline status and sales performance directly to the Managing Director.



**Client \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Build and maintain long\-term relationships with key engineering consultants, MEP contractors, main contractors, interior designers, and project owners across Kuwait.
* Conduct regular client visits, site surveys, and design\-stage meetings to influence lighting specifications in favour of the company's portfolio.
* Act as a senior point of contact for key accounts, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction and repeat business.



**Technical \& Commercial Sales** 



* Prepare and present detailed technical proposals, lighting design concepts, and commercial quotations tailored to project requirements and budgets.
* Review tender documents, BOQs, and consultant specifications to ensure correct product selection and full compliance.
* Negotiate pricing, contract terms, and supply agreements with clients, contractors, and manufacturers to close orders profitably.
* Collaborate with manufacturer representatives and technical teams to deliver customised lighting solutions, mock\-ups, and value\-engineering alternatives.



**Project Execution \& Coordination** 



* Oversee order handling, delivery scheduling, and documentation (product data sheets, photometric reports, warranties, and certifications) to ensure on\-time project delivery.
* Monitor active projects to ensure alignment with client timelines, budget constraints, and technical specifications.
* Resolve post\-sale technical issues and coordinate with suppliers to manage warranties, replacements, and site support.



**Market Intelligence \& Business Development** 



* Identify and pursue new project opportunities in commercial, hospitality, retail, government, healthcare, and infrastructure segments across Kuwait.
* Conduct ongoing market research to track competitor activity, new project awards, and emerging lighting technology trends.
* Evaluate and expand the company's lighting product portfolio in response to market demand and project requirements.



  





**Qualifications \& Requirements**



* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Architecture, or a related discipline (preferred).
* Minimum 8 years of lighting project sales experience in Kuwait, with a demonstrated track record of managing medium and large\-scale projects from specification to delivery.
* Strong existing network of relationships with engineering consultants, MEP contractors, and procurement decision\-makers in the Kuwait market.
* Proficiency in lighting design and calculation software (DIALux, Relux, or equivalent) is a strong advantage.
* Solid commercial acumen with experience in tender preparation, BOQ analysis, and contract negotiation.
* Prior experience in a managerial or team\-lead sales capacity.
* Bilingual proficiency in Arabic and English
* Valid Kuwait driving licence; must be based in Kuwait with a transferable residency visa.

 The AI Solution/Platform Architect defines technical solution designs and ensures alignment with Group AI reference architecture across all AI initiatives. This role conducts architecture reviews, provides design guidance to delivery teams, resolves complex technical dependencies, and ensures OpCo implementations comply with Group standards. The Architect partners with the Director, Tech \& Platforms on platform strategy and reference architecture evolution, engages with OpCo technical teams on solution design, and serves as the technical escalation point for delivery teams. This role requires deep understanding of AI architectures, enterprise integration patterns, and the ability to balance technical purity with pragmatic business constraints in a federated organization.
   

  

 Key Accountabilities
   

  

* Design end\-to\-end technical solutions for AI use cases ensuring alignment with Group reference architecture
* Conduct architecture reviews and provide design guidance to delivery teams and OpCo technical staff
* Resolve complex technical dependencies across enterprise systems, data sources, and platforms
* Ensure OpCo AI implementations comply with Group architecture standards or have documented exceptions
* Partner with Director, Tech \& Platforms on reference architecture definition and evolution
* Define integration patterns for AI systems with enterprise platforms (CRM, BSS/OSS, data platforms)
* Support platform evaluation and vendor selection with technical due diligence and architecture assessment
* Create architecture blueprints, design patterns, and technical reference materials for reuse

**KPIs Include But Are Not Limited To**

 What We Need From You
   

  

 Educational Qualifications: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field.
   

  

 Experience: 10\+ years in technology roles with 5\+ years in solution architecture or enterprise architecture. Experience designing AI/ML solutions, enterprise integrations, and cloud architectures. Background in telecom BSS/OSS systems or complex regulated industries valuable.
   

  

 Knowledge: Deep understanding of AI/ML architectures (GenAI, traditional ML, automation), enterprise integration patterns, cloud platforms, and data architectures. Experience with architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman) and governance. Strong communication skills to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
   

  

**About Application Process**
 If you meet the criteria and you are enthusiastic about the role, we would welcome your application. To complete the application you would need the following document(s):
   

  

* Resume/CV

**Job Description**
**Department: Center of Continuing Education**
**Reports to:** 
**Director \- CCE**
**Scope And Purpose**
 Center for Continuing Education (CCE) is committed to providing a wide range of professional development courses, training workshops, certificate programs, and customized corporate training solutions designed to meet the needs of individuals, businesses, and the community. By partnering with international certifying bodies and industry experts, the Center ensures that its programs are globally relevant, innovative, and aligned with labor market demands.
   

  

 The Training Operation Officer supports the effective delivery of CCE programs and training services by managing daily operational, logistical, and administrative processes. This role ensures that classes, instructors, and facilities are efficiently scheduled and prepared, that quality standards are consistently maintained, and that all post\-training documentation and reports are accurately completed. Working closely with the Team leader \- Training operation \& testing and the CCE Director, the training operations officer plays a key role in ensuring a seamless learning experience for participants and operational excellence across all CCE activities.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* Coordinate Training Operations: Plan and manage the scheduling and setup of CCE training programs, ensuring all logistical, technical, and material requirements are met.
* Administer CCE Systems, Data, and Operational Schedules: Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records within CCE’s management systems, including product sheets, class openings, participant and instructor data, and operational reports. Develop and monitor the annual training calendar, trainers’ schedules, and classroom allocations to ensure effective resource management, operational efficiency, and accurate reporting.
* Monitor Quality and Service Standards:Oversee training delivery and gather feedback from participants and instructors to uphold CCE’s quality benchmarks.
* Support Instructors and Participants:Communicate essential course information, coordinate instructor schedules, and provide responsive support to ensure a positive learning experience.
* Oversee Facilities and Logistics:Ensure training venues, equipment, and course materials are properly arranged and maintained to create an effective learning environment.
* Maintain Administrative Efficiency:Process course\-related forms, certificates, cancellations, and transfers promptly to ensure compliance and smooth program operations.
* Manage Testing Center Operations: Coordinate scheduling, setup, and supervision of CCE testing activities, ensuring proper administration of exams, adherence to testing protocols, and maintenance of a secure and professional testing environment.
* Process Trainer Payments and Financial Requisitions: Prepare and process trainer payment requests \& handle BC petty cash advances.


**Qualifications**
**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Education, Management Information Systems, or a related field is required.


**Experience**
* Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in training administration, program coordination, or operation management, preferably within a university, continuing education, or professional training enviroment.
* Demonstrated experience managing trainign logistics, scheduling course setup, and reporting systems.
* Experience with testing center operations,including exam scheduling, supervision, and compliance with testing protocols, is highly desirable.


**Key Competencies**
* Administration: Effectively plans and coordinates tasks, resources, and schedules to ensure smooth execution of training and testing activities.
* Quality Management: Maintains high standards of accuracy and thoroughness in all operational and administrative processes.
* Applying Technology: Demonstrates proficiency in CCE systems, digital tools, and IT processes required for training delivery and reporting.
* Process Excellence: Understands, follows, and improves operational workflows to enhance efficiency and service quality.
* Information and Data Management: Collects, organizes, and analyzes data to generate accurate reports that support decision\-making and performance tracking.
* Office Management: Manages physical and digital resources—such as training rooms, materials, and equipment—to ensure readiness and proper utilization.
* Communication Skills: Communicates clearly, respectfully, and effectively with colleagues, trainers, and learners to foster collaboration and understanding.
* Service Orientation: Demonstrates commitment to providing high\-quality service to internal and external stakeholders through responsiveness and professionalism.
* Accountability: Takes ownership of responsibilities, delivers on commitments, and ensures consistent performance and dependability.
* Teamwork: Works cooperatively with others across departments to achieve shared goals and support organizational effectiveness.
* Adaptability: Responds positively to change, adjusting priorities and approaches to meet evolving operational and institutional needs.
* Self Management: Seeks opportunities to enhance personal effectiveness, update knowledge, and contribute to process improvement within the CCE.


**Certifications (preferred)**
* Project Management certification.
* Training Administration or Learning Management Systems (LMS)certification.
* Customer Service or Quality Management certification.
* Information Technology proficiency certification.

* Able to conduct the role independently and with integrity.
* Ability to plan, organize and prioritize tasks and projects.

data.jd_text:
**SUMMARY OF ROLE:** 
  

 Lead and drive enterprise\-wide transformation and process optimization initiatives across the Bank, focusing on enhancing operational efficiency, strengthening governance and controls, enabling digital innovation, and improving overall service delivery. The role ensures that transformation efforts are practical, measurable, and aligned with the Bank’s strategic objectives.
   

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**
**Enterprise Transformation Strategy \& Execution**
 • Develop, refine, and oversee the execution of the Bank’s transformation roadmap, ensuring alignment with corporate strategy, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
   

 • Lead cross\-functional transformation initiatives that integrate digital innovation, process re\-engineering, and operational excellence.
   

 • Establish and institutionalize transformation frameworks, governance models, and methodologies to ensure consistency, scalability, and sustainability.
   

 • Drive enterprise\-wide synergies across business units to ensure transformation delivers measurable value and impact.
   

  

**Process Optimization \& Operational Excellence**
 • Conduct end\-to\-end reviews of critical banking processes to identify inefficiencies, control gaps, duplication, and manual dependencies.
   

 • Redesign and standardize processes to enhance efficiency, accuracy, turnaround time (TAT), and service quality.
   

 • Embed Lean, continuous improvement, and best\-practice methodologies across the organization.
   

 • Strengthen operational controls and accountability frameworks to reduce risk and improve performance
   

  

**Transformation Execution \& Delivery (Hands\-on)**
 • Lead the implementation of transformation initiatives, ensuring practical and executable solutions.
   

 • Work closely with Business, Operations, and Technology teams to embed changes into day\-to\-day operations.
   

 • Ensure transformation initiatives move beyond design into sustainable execution and adoption.
   

  

**Digitalization, Automation \& Innovation**
 • Drive adoption of emerging technologies to enhance efficiency and customer experience.
   

 • Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual intervention and enable straight\-through processing.
   

 • Partner with IT and Digital teams to modernize platforms and transition from legacy systems to scalable digital solutions.
   

 • Support the development of seamless omnichannel customer experiences to enhance engagement and competitiveness.
   

  

**Performance Management \& Impact Tracking**
 • Define and track KPIs related to operational efficiency, productivity, cost optimization, error rates, and service delivery.
   

 • Establish reporting mechanisms to monitor transformation outcomes and ensure measurable business impact.
   

 • Drive a performance\-driven culture by linking transformation initiatives to tangible results.
   

  

**Risk Management, Governance \& Compliance**
 • Establish robust governance structures to monitor and control transformation initiatives.
   

 • Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements, internal policies, and industry standards.
   

 • Identify and mitigate transformation\-related risks, including operational, regulatory, and cybersecurity risks.
   

 • Promote a risk\-aware transformation culture aligned with the Bank’s risk appetite.
   

  

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Change Management**
 • Engage and influence stakeholders across all levels to drive alignment and ownership.
   

 • Lead change management efforts to ensure smooth adoption of new processes, systems, and operating models.
   

 • Act as a key liaison between internal teams, external partners, regulators, and consultants.
   

 • Challenge existing practices and drive accountability for continuous improvement.
   

  

**Strategic Partnerships \& Industry Engagement**
 • Manage vendor and partner relationships to support transformation and digital initiatives.
   

 • Represent the Bank in industry forums, regulatory discussions, and innovation networks to stay ahead of market trends.
   

  

**Continuous Improvement \& Capability Building**
 • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and operational excellence across the Bank.
   

 • Continuously enhance personal knowledge and capabilities through learning, market insights, and project exposure.
   

 • Support capability development across teams to sustain transformation and process excellence initiatives.
   

  

**Business Control \& Governance**
 • Ensure adherence to the bank's policies, regulatory requirements, and industry standards in all operational activities.
   

  

**Self/People Development \& Continuous Learning:**
 • Continually update oneself through knowledge acquisition, on\-the\-job training, or project involvement; advocate and support others to do the same.
   

  

  

  

 Requirements
   

  

 • Omani Nationals Only
   

  

 • Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Engineering, or a related field.
   

  

 • 10–15\+ years in banking operations, process improvement, or transformation roles
   

  

 • Strong hands\-on experience in operations, process redesign, or operational excellence
   

  

 • Experience in areas such as payments, cards, reconciliation, back office, or service operations is a strong advantage
   

  

 • Certification in Lean Six Sigma (Black Belt or Master Black Belt) is highly desirable.
   

  

 • Demonstrated experience in driving digital transformation projects, including RPA, AI, or workflow automation.

data.jd_text:
**About Rawanq Al Salam International** 




 Rawanq is a global seafood company and fishery. We own and operate vessels across the Arabian Peninsula, Indian Ocean and West Africa, supplying high quality raw material to international customers while upholding rigorous standards in sustainability, traceability and food safety.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are seeking an experienced individual for the position of Director of Production \& Commercial Development with the technical depth to materially increase the value extracted from our catches and the commercial breadth to translate that uplift into new growth opportunities for our sales channels.
 



  





 This is a hands on senior role for someone who can walk a vessel and a processing factory with equal authority, identify where yield, product mix, handling, freezing, packaging, and routing can be improved, and lead the changes through to implementation.
 



  





 The same person will work hand in hand with our sales department, exploring new growth opportunities and turning operational improvements into strong commercial propositions that the sales team can take to customers.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




***Production and Value Uplift***



* Assess and continuously improve fishing operations on board our vessels, including handling, chilling, sorting, and on board freezing or storage practices that influence end product quality.
* Redesign and optimise factory layouts, lines, freezing regimes, packaging, and labeling to maximise yield, quality grades, and sellable value per kilogram of raw material.
* Identify capital and process investments (equipment, automation, vessel refits, factory upgrades) and build the business cases that justify them.
* Drive a structured programme of yield, throughput, and quality improvement across all sites, with measurable KPIs and clear before and after results.
* Ensure that all production changes maintain or strengthen compliance with food safety, traceability, sustainability, and customer specific requirements.



  





***Commercial Growth and Sales Support***



* Identify and develop new commercial growth opportunities across priority species, product forms, and target markets, and feed them into the Sales team's pipeline.
* Translate production improvements into specific value added product propositions and premium positioning that the sales team can take to customers.
* Provide technical and product expertise to support sales in customer conversations, pricing decisions, contract structuring and key account negotiations.
* Build market and product intelligence on customers, partners, and supplier networks across the regions in which we operate, and use it to shape what we offer and how we go to market.



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 We are looking for a candidate with strict and detailed expertise across the seafood value chain.
 


* Demonstrable hands\-on experience with fishing vessels (factory trawlers and / or purse seiners), including on board handling practices and a working understanding of vessel design and refit.
* Deep technical knowledge of seafood factories, including line design, yield optimisation, freezing technologies, packaging, and quality grading.
* Strong understanding of fisheries, species behaviour, seasonality, raw material variability, and how each factor affects product quality and value.
* A track record of successfully designing and implementing changes to vessels or processing operations that delivered measurable increases in yield, quality, or end product value.
* Strong commercial acumen and a proven track record of partnering with sales teams to identify, scope, and convert growth opportunities in international seafood markets.
* Excellent written and spoken English. Additional languages relevant to our operating regions, such as Icelandic, Spanish, or Arabic, are a strong advantage.
* Willingness and ability to travel internationally.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A senior leadership role with direct, measurable impact on the profitability and strategic direction of the company.
* The flexibility to be based in Muscat, Las Palmas, or Reykjavík, in an international working environment.
* 30 days of paid vacation per year.
* The opportunity to shape one of the most dynamic segments of the global seafood industry from the inside out.



  





**How to Apply** 




 If you combine deep technical expertise in fishing and processing with strong commercial instincts, we would like to hear from you. Please submit your CV together with a brief cover letter outlining specific examples of value uplift you have led, on vessels, in processing facilities, or in commercial growth.
 



  





 All applications will be treated in strict confidence.

* Customer\-focused with a strong commitment to service excellence.
* Proficiency in English (written and spoken); Arabic is an advantage.
* Experience in multinational HVAC organizations.

 Position Title: Lead Reservoir Engineer
   

 Work Location: Muscat, Oman
   

 Contract duration: 1 year extendable.
   

  
   

**Job purpose**
 The Lead Reservoir Engineer provides hands\-on reservoir engineering support for Block 8, ensuring timely and technically sound delivery of the key in\-house subsurface work program. The role will execute and coordinate reservoir engineering and dynamic simulation activities for Block 8 or other company assets, including model update, forecasting, scenario generation, appraisal support and Field Development Plan inputs and write\-up.
   

 The position integrates surveillance, production and test data (including PVT, SCAL, PTA/RTA, pressure data and production history) with relevant geological and petrophysical inputs to evaluate reservoir and well performance, identify opportunities and risks, and support decision\-making on development, optimization and subsurface studies.
   

 The role is intended to reinforce the in\-house Subsurface Team, working closely with Geoscience, Operations, Well Engineering and Facilities to deliver fit\-for\-purpose technical work, maintain data quality and documentation standards, and support consistent application of company technical practices.
   

 The position will act in accordance with the Group’s Mission, Vision, Values \& Strategies, as well as, policies, guidelines, and standards, supported by an IT Technology platform, HSE standards, Omani’s government \& other legal justifications, and best international practices in consonance with national objectives.
   

  
   

  
   

**Education requirements**
 Bachelor’s degree in Petroleum Engineering (or equivalent discipline such as Chemical/Mechanical Engineering, or Geoscience with strong reservoir engineering experience). A postgraduate degree (MSc/MBA) is an advantage.
   

  
   

**Main tasks and responsibilities**
 Execute assigned reservoir engineering studies and provide strong technical support to the Head of Subsurface for delivery of the Block 8 work plan.
   

 Build, update, maintain and apply reservoir simulation models for West Bukha, Bukha and Tibat to support reservoir management, depletion planning, forecasting and FDP updates.
   

 Integrate static model inputs, including DFN\-related understanding where applicable, into dynamic studies and ensure consistency between geological interpretation and reservoir engineering outputs.
   

 Perform history matching, sensitivity studies, uncertainty assessment and scenario generation to support technically defensible development options and reporting.
   

 Evaluate well and reservoir performance using production data, pressure behaviour, material balance concepts, inflow/outflow analysis and other fit\-for\-purpose reservoir engineering methods.
   

 Analyse and integrate surveillance and test data, including PVT, SCAL, RFT/MDT, build\-up data and well test interpretation results (PTA/RTA), into reservoir studies and recommendations.
   

 Support appraisal and development activities, including inputs for Tibat\-2 well location proposal and other near\-field exploration or appraisal opportunities.
   

 Provide reservoir engineering input to artificial lift optimization, well modelling, well completion and production system analysis activities in coordination with the relevant disciplines.
   

 Contribute to subsurface studies such as geomechanics, regional geological framing, 3D seismic revision and fault seal analysis, ensuring proper RE integration where required.
   

 Develop and maintain reservoir management plans, surveillance requirements and data acquisition recommendations to improve understanding of field performance and remaining uncertainties.
   

 Prepare high\-quality technical reports, presentations, dashboards and management summaries, including inputs required for internal governance, planning cycles and regulator reporting where applicable.
   

 Coordinate effectively with Geoscience, Wells, Operations, Facilities, Planning and external contractors to ensure timely delivery of integrated subsurface studies.
   

 Review third\-party technical studies, challenge assumptions where needed, and recommend additional work or alternative approaches to improve the quality of outcomes.
   

 Participate in technical assurance, peer reviews and decision\-analysis sessions to support robust and traceable recommendations.
   

 Coach junior engineers and contribute to knowledge transfer, continuous improvement and adoption of fit\-for\-purpose new technologies and workflows.
   

  
   

  
   

**Background and experience**
**Experience level: Lead Reservoir Engineer: minimum 10 years** 
 of relevant reservoir engineering experience, with demonstrated delivery in mature/brownfield assets and integrated subsurface studies.
   

**Reservoir engineering depth:** 
 Strong, hands\-on experience in reservoir management and depletion strategy, well and reservoir performance evaluation, forecasting, and uncertainty assessment.
   

**Dynamic modelling and simulation:** 
 strong and proven track record in
 **reservoir simulation** 
 (model development/maintenance, history match support, scenario evaluation, and forecasting) and integration of petrophysics, PVT, SCAL and surveillance data into dynamic models.

 Solid experience in well test interpretation (PTA/RTA), pressure and formation data interpretation (RFT/MDT), and use of surveillance results to guide reservoir management decisions.
   

**Integrated studies:**

**Planning / governance exposure:** 
 Experience supporting business planning (WP\&B), input to development programs and well proposals, and preparation of high\-quality technical reporting for management and external stakeholders (including regulator reporting where applicable).
   

**Tools:** 
 Proficiency with relevant industry software (reservoir simulation tools, PTA, PVT modelling, and production analysis/economic evaluation tools), with strong data handling and QA/QC discipline.

 reservoir simulator .

 Lead and integrate all Geoscience (Geology, Geophysics, and Petrophysics) activities under the Commercial structure to maximize subsurface value, mature hydrocarbon resources, reduce geological uncertainty, and support economically sound investment decisions. The role ensures delivery of high\-quality subsurface interpretations, volumetric assessments, prospect maturation, and reservoir characterization to enable exploration success, field development optimization, reserves growth, and commercial negotiations.
 



  





 The position will act in accordance with the OQEP’s Mission, Vision, Values \& Strategies, as well as, policies, guidelines, and international standards, supported by an IT Technology platform, QHSE \& Energy Management System requirements standards, Omani’s government \& other legal justifications, and best international practices in consonance with national objectives.
 



**Main tasks and responsibilities:** 




  





**Strategic \& Commercial Alignment** 



* Align G\&G strategies with corporate growth objectives, portfolio strategy, and commercial targets.
* Translate subsurface insights into value\-driven business cases and investment proposals.
* Support farm\-in/farm\-out evaluations, asset acquisitions, and divestments.
* Contribute to reserves booking strategy and certification processes.



  





**Exploration \& Prospect Maturation** 



* Oversee basin analysis, play fairway evaluation, and prospect generation.
* Ensure robust risking, volumetrics, and uncertainty analysis for exploration opportunities.
* Approve prospect maturation workflows prior to drill\-ready status.
* Present subsurface evaluations to management and investment committees.



  





**Reservoir Characterization \& Development Support** 



* Integrate seismic, geological, petrophysical, and well data into coherent reservoir models.
* Guide static model construction and ensure subsurface integrity for FDPs (Field Development Plans).
* Support well planning, placement, and post\-well evaluation.
* Drive uncertainty reduction strategies to improve recovery factors and reserves classification.



  





**Technical Governance \& Quality Assurance** 



* Establish G\&G technical standards, workflows, and best practices.
* Ensure independent technical assurance and peer reviews.
* Validate subsurface risks prior to major capital commitments.
* Maintain compliance with international reporting standards (e.g., SPE\-PRMS).

* Oversee subsurface data management, seismic reprocessing strategies, and petrophysical database integrity.
* Promote digital subsurface solutions, AI\-based interpretation, and integrated modeling technologies.
* Ensure effective knowledge management and lessons learned capture.



  





**Leadership \& Capability Development** 



* Lead and develop Principal\-level technical experts.
* Foster a high\-performance, collaborative subsurface culture.
* Build succession planning and technical competency frameworks.
* Act as senior technical authority in G\&G matters.

* Represent the company in JV technical committees and regulator discussions.
* Support commercial negotiations with technical subsurface insights.
* Coordinate with Drilling, Reservoir Engineering, Production, and HSSE functions.

 Operations team, Exploration team, Subsurface, support functions.

 Partners, OQEP JVs, consultancy firms, Government related entities

 Office environment, intensive computer screen use, sporadic visits to operation site.

 BS Degree in Geology, relevant science subject or equivalent. MSc degree desirable

 Excellent knowledge of written, read, and spoken English (required) Arabic \- Native (desirable)
 



**Background and experience** 




  





 • 8\+ years of relevant experience in similar role with an operator, preferably with experience in Exploration or New Ventures with various subsurface fields experience and different environments.
 


* Broad geoscience knowledge, with experience in both geophysics , geology and petrophysics.

* Demonstrated strong experience in the following fields:
* Well operations planning and execution

* Prospect generation, evaluation and proposal

* Ability to work in a multi\-disciplinary team environment

**Technical:**

data.jd_text:
We are a leading international law and professional services firm providing legal, corporate and fiduciary services to global corporations, financial institutions, capital market participants and investment fund managers. With a global presence spanning the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Asia, we advise on the laws of Bermuda, the British Virgin Islands, the Cayman Islands, Guernsey, Ireland and Jersey.
 



  





 We treat everyone as the intelligent professional they are. Our approach is to trust and empower our people to deliver consistently, and enable them to succeed. Diversity is our secret weapon – it’s the sheer breadth of Walkers people that makes us who we are – gathered from across the globe and fluent in languages, jurisdictions and cultures that help us to mirror our clients and keep our own thinking in tune with the world in which we operate.
 



  





**Overview Of Role** 




  





 This role will ideally be based in either our Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore office.
 



 We are keen to hear from qualified candidates in London who are open to relocating to Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore.
 



  





 This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced compliance professional with a background in the legal or professional services sector to join a team dealing with conflicts of interest and client confidentiality matters.
 



  





 Reporting to our Director of Conflicts and joining the OGC team, the successful candidate will assist with the development of a specialised team of conflicts professionals responsible for analysing, advising on and resolving legal and commercial conflicts of interest, information barriers and share dealing requests. This is to ensure we comply with all applicable regulations, professional rules of conduct, contractual terms related to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality, and protect client relationships and our reputation.
 



  





 Our conflicts analysts assist with the resolution of complex conflicts issues, deal with sensitive confidential matters, and carry out conflict checks associated with share dealing requests and lateral hires into the business.
 



  





 The Senior Conflicts Manager will work closely with the Director of Conflicts on the ongoing development of our policies, controls and processes as they relate to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, information barriers, share dealing and Market Abuse Regulations. This will include optimising our use of tech/automation (including
 *Intapp* 
 ), standardising and simplifying our policies and processes across the Walkers group, and building an optimal team shape that provides agility, efficiency, consistency and excellent service to the business and our clients.
 



  





**Duties, Responsibilities \& Person Specification** 




  




* Day\-to\-day management of conflicts advisors within the relevant time zone (including leading the recruitment of additional conflicts advisors).

* Working with the Director of Conflicts and key stakeholders from across the business, develop and deliver a phased programme of work that: (i) rapidly enhances our conflicts offering/service delivery to the business (including through improved time zone coverage/capacity, responsiveness, efficiency and expertise); (ii) enables us to provide a fully centralised conflict checking/analysis function within the next two years.
* Support the Director of Conflicts in driving quality, consistency, service excellence, efficiency, proactivity and adaptability across the Conflicts team.
* Assist the Director of Conflicts in developing and leading people initiatives within the Conflicts team to drive development of expertise and skills, attraction and retention, and fostering a high\-performing, collaborative and open team culture.

* Participate in cross\-functional initiatives which impact or relate to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality.

* Bachelor's degree in law, business, finance or another relevant field.
* Experience in a compliance or in\-house legal role in an international law firm or professional services environment.
* Compliance expert with deep technical and practical knowledge of legal conflicts of interest, commercial conflicts and client confidentiality, with some knowledge of Market Abuse Regs.
* Familiarity with Intapp Intake.
* Experience of policy work.
* Experience of people management, including supervision/management of large teams and experience devising and driving people initiatives (including around recruitment and development).
* Proven track record of delivering change and process improvements.
* Experience working in an offshore environment or with offshore structures would be helpful but not required
* Strategic: ability to work in pursuit of a clear strategic direction, align the team's priorities with those of the wider OGC team and the firm, and proactively identify improvements.

data.jd_text:
At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life\-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.
   

  

 The Senior Director \- Ethics \& Compliance, Gulf is responsible for leading the integration of high performance with high integrity in Lilly Gulf. The role will partner with the Gulf Management Team, the ICH, IBU and Global E\&C Teams, and relevant business partners to implement the Global 7 elements E\&C Program and cultivate a Speak up Culture in Gulf. The role requires working with the E\&C Manager in Gulf and other affiliate functions to provide expert Ethics and Compliance guidance on affiliate strategies, decisions and activities. (including risk assessment, policies, communications, training, monitoring, etc.) in a way that effectively supports the affiliate risk management and identifying areas to improve business systems based on monitoring findings and business needs. This position is expected to have regular interactions with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment with ethics and compliance objectives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 E\&C Program Management:
   

  

* Collaborate/consult and influence leadership to ensure the key elements of an effective compliance program are built into local governance and decision forums, business and operational processes, and training.
* Ensure reliable controls are in place and understood by the business to address key risk areas (existing and emerging) to mitigate/prevent – in the “what”, “how” and “why” so that business activities are appropriately implemented.
* Collaborate with the business together with the Gulf E\&C Manager to regularly develop and implement dynamic compliance risk assessments and integrate mitigating measures into business processes.
* Support E\&C procedure localization and providing input to global procedure updates.
* Contribute to developing and driving monitoring plans, root cause analysis, and meaningful corrective actions/preventive actions in close collaboration with an integrated approach across other functions (Finance, Center of Excellence, HR, Medical, Marketing, Sales, etc.).
* Actively contribute to key meetings in E\&C (e.g., monitoring forums, staff, etc.) and with business partners (e.g., lead teams, ICCG committees, etc.).
* Seek out and bring in external perspectives on processes to eliminate, simplify, automate, and leverage technologies to enhance E\&C capabilities and focus on business partnership
* Responsible for driving E\&C\-related compliance communications and training needs for the business.
* Effectively communicate the ‘state of control’ to leadership teams.
* Ensure business processes and operational procedures are consistent with Global Policies and Standards.
* Lead, together with CFO, the CAS audits implementation and follow\-up at local level.


**Business Influence And Cross Function Collaboration**
* Through deep business acumen and effective influence across different layers of the organization/leadership, ensure business discussions and decisions encompass and consistently take into consideration appropriate ethics and compliance elements, and that there is clear business ownership of ethics in all decisions taken.
* Influence leadership and business practices through effective communication of internal policies/standards and external environment risks.
* Ensure an open and collaborative environment that promotes teamwork, open communication, and collaborative interactions to foster a culture of integrity.
* This role collaborates with other ECOs from ICH to improve capabilities, mitigate regional risks and establish E\&C Strategy in the region.
* Lead the compliance review and compliance agreement development for new business development deals.
* Represent Lilly in the local industry association and in the interactions with regulators.
* Coach and develop people in E\&C including but not limited to direct report(s).


**Basic Requirements**
* At least 10\+ years of industry experience, leading Legal and / or E\&C with knowledge of local laws, regulations, guidance and Codes. Experience within the pharmaceutical or related healthcare industry would be strongly preferred.
* Solid business knowledge and leadership experience – has the ability to influence all areas of the affiliate. This is critical success factor of this role.
* Cross functional experience.
* Agility using and working with technology, automation and AI tools as well as driving creation and implementation of digital transformation initiatives.
* English proficiency to work across and contribute to global E\&C.
* Bachelor's degree.


**Additional Preferences**
* Demonstrated history of operating with integrity. Candidate must not have had any compliance violations over the last 12 months.
* Demonstrated ability to consistently apply good judgement to enable quality business decisions.
* Ability to proactively and collaboratively influence decisions and outcomes.
* Ability to effectively communicate, lead, embrace and drive change across all layers of the organization.
* Strong strategic and critical thinking and ability to effectively operationalize the strategy.
* Ability to translate ambiguity and complexity into meaningful actions.
* Ability to work across boundaries and influence without authority.
* Strong business knowledge and leadership skills (critical thinking, detailed and results oriented, etc.), including a strong reputation for integrity and sound judgement.


 Position reports into Associate VP \- Ethics \& Compliance, Intercontinental Hub (ICH)

 The Mobility \& Asset Control Specialist will be responsible for coordinating workforce mobility across project sites in Saudi Arabia, including site access, mobilization, and demobilization in collaboration with HR and PMO teams. The role oversees accommodation and transportation arrangements while ensuring compliance with project and client requirements. Additionally, the position manages and monitors all lease contracts under company agreements. A key aspect of the role involves overseeing the full lifecycle of MEP assets, including electrical testing instruments, calibration tracking, vehicles, consumables, and high\-value materials across multiple project locations.

* Coordinate mobilization and demobilization of site personnel in alignment with HR and PMO requirements
* Manage accommodation requests, including allocation and room assignments for site staff
* Handle transportation arrangements for staff and equipment between project sites
* Ensure compliance with client and project\-specific entry and exit protocols
* Lease Contract Management
* Maintain and track all active lease contracts, including vehicles, site accommodations, offices, and equipment
* Monitor lease expirations, renewal timelines, and rental payment schedules
* Maintain an accurate and centralized lease register
* Coordinate with procurement and administration for timely contract renewals or terminations
* Asset \& Materials Management

* Maintain calibration schedules and track certification validity and timely renewals
* Coordinate with third\-party laboratories for equipment recalibration

* Maintain documentation for asset handovers, maintenance schedules, and calibration records
* Enforce asset security and custody protocols to prevent misuse or loss


**Qualifications \& Experience**

* 2–4 years of experience in asset management, mobility coordination, and inventory control, preferably within MEP or electrical testing services in KSA

* Bilingual proficiency in Arabic and English

* Hybrid role involving both office and site\-based responsibilities, including coordination with central warehouse operations

**About Us**
 Tamara is the leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC region with a mission to help people make their dreams come true by building the most customer\-centric financial super\-app on earth. The company serves millions of users in KSA, UAE and Kuwait, and partners with leading global and regional brands such as SHEIN, Jarir, noon, Amazon, IKEA, eXtra and Farfetch as well as small and medium businesses.
   

  

 Tamara is Saudi’s first fintech unicorn and is backed by Sanabil Investments, SNB Capital, Checkout.com, amongst others, operating out of its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia with other regional and global support offices.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a startup\-within\-a\-startup role. You will be responsible for building a net new banking product from scratch for the Saudi Arabia market — from ideation through design and launch.
   

  

 This role is high ambiguity, high complexity, and requires someone who thrives in uncharted territory. There is no playbook — you will write it. You must be comfortable navigating ambiguity, making tactical trade\-offs, and moving with execution velocity.
   

  

 As Product Manager, you will own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle of a new fintech product that will advance how merchants at Tamara manage their money. You will work daily with a full\-stack team — engineers, product designers, researchers, data analysts, operations, and business stakeholders — to ship an innovative and incredible experience.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the execution, vision \& strategy for a net new fintech vertical.
* Work with engineers, designers, data scientists, and commercial teams to drive the roadmap for a net\-new product.
* Be technically competent enough to be able to decide on the execution plan while managing several internal technical dependencies.
* Deeply understand the KSA Fintech ecosystem, compliance rules \& regulations — and understand how it may impact your roadmap.
* Deeply understand the operational impacts of the products we are releasing \& work with risk, compliance, treasury, customer support and others to ensure product success.
* Prototype rapidly using tools like Cursor, Claude \& Codex to accelerate product development work.
* Contribute to commercial planning \& GTM of the product and own the outcomes.
* Lead a core team of engineers \& designers and drive the end to end execution forward.
* Contribute to the evolution of Tamara’s Product Management practices as AI scales our work.


**Qualifications**
* You have 4\+ years of Product Management experience, with proven experience building 0—\>1 products that have shipped and scaled.
* You have worked with early stage product teams or startups and have successfully taken a product from concept to launch.
* You have strong UX taste — you care deeply about the end\-to\-end customer experience and can hold a high bar for product quality.
* You have experience working on complex, multi\-surface products with a large blast radius of impact.
* You are a strong collaborator who works effectively with engineering, design, data, and operations teams on a daily basis.
* You are data\-driven — you have strong analytical skills, are comfortable with experimentation, and can use data to inform decisions and measure outcomes.
* You are able to think from first principles, break down complex problems, and navigate ambiguity with confidence.
* You have strong business acumen — you understand unit economics, business models, and can make decisions that balance customer value with business outcomes.
* You understand regulatory requirements and operational considerations that come with building financial products.
* You are customer\-obsessed — you aren’t shy about getting on calls with merchants, visiting them, and deeply understanding their needs.
* FinTech experience — you have worked on financial products before and understand the nuances of payments, banking, lending, or adjacent spaces.
* Must have the ability to use AI in their day to day to work. Preferred experience working in high\-growth companies.
* Arabic speaking is required for this role — you will work closely with merchants and stakeholders in KSA.


 All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

**Company Description**
 We’re Checkout.com – you might not know our name, but companies like eBay, ASOS, Klarna, Uber Eats, and Sony do. That moment when you check out online? We make it happen.
   

  

 Checkout.com is where the world checks out. Our global network powers billions of transactions every year, making money move without making a fuss. We spent years perfecting a service most people will never notice. Because when digital payments just work, businesses grow, customers stay, and no one stops to think about why.
   

  

 With 19 offices spanning six continents, we feel at home everywhere – but London is our HQ. Wherever our people work their magic, they’re fast\-moving, performance\-obsessed, and driven by being better every day. Ideal. Because a role here isn’t just another job; it’s a career\-defining opportunity to build the future of fintech.
   

  

**The Role**
 Checkout.com is seeking a talented Senior Financial Partnerships Specialist in Riyadh to join the adventure and support our rapid growth and expansion in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 Working with a regional team, your main responsibility will be to manage and grow our partnerships with Acquiring Banks, APMs and card networks such as Visa, Mastercard and MADA. You will contribute to the development and execution of our strategy for such partnerships.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of Financial Partnerships \- MENA, the successful candidate will be able to handle multiple projects and partnerships autonomously, have sufficient payments knowledge and experience to do so, and have a hands\-on approach necessary in a fast growing start\-up like ours. This is a great opportunity to contribute, learn and grow working on a broad range of projects in building a world\-class payments infrastructure.

data.jd_text:
**About Yellow Door Energy**
 Yellow Door Energy is the leading sustainable energy partner for commercial and industrial businesses across the Middle East and Africa. We deliver sustainable energy solutions through power purchase agreements and solar leases, helping businesses reduce energy costs, improve power reliability, and lower carbon emissions.
   

  

 Our solutions include solar PV, battery energy storage systems, hybrid energy, and energy efficiency. Our shareholders include Actis, Mitsui \& Co, TAEF, and the International Finance Corporation.
   

  

 🔍 About the Role
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Renewable Energy PV Project Manager – KSA** 
 to support the delivery of commercial and industrial solar PV projects across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Experience with
 **BESS or hybrid energy projects** 
 would be a strong advantage.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on project delivery role focused on the site\-based execution of solar PV projects from mobilisation, EPC and subcontractor coordination, progress tracking, and project controls through to quality inspections, commissioning, documentation, and handover.
   

  

 Working under the direction of the Senior Project Manager, you will act as YDE’s on\-site representative, ensuring EPC contractors deliver safely, on schedule, within budget, and in line with YDE’s technical, contractual, HSE, and quality standards.
   

  

 This role is best suited to a project professional with strong solar PV construction experience, practical engineering knowledge, and the discipline to manage daily site execution, contractor performance, project controls, variations, and reporting in a fast\-moving, site\-based environment.
   

  

 ⚡ What You’ll Deliver \& Own
   

  

 In this role, you will support the successful delivery of commercial and industrial solar PV projects across KSA, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to YDE’s technical and quality standards.
   

  

**You Will**
* Drive day\-to\-day site execution, EPC and subcontractor coordination, progress tracking, and issue resolution.
* Translate approved PV designs, drawings, schedules, and project plans into contractor\-ready execution activities.
* Monitor EPC contractor and subcontractor performance, review look\-ahead schedules, challenge recovery plans, and maintain accurate site records.
* Support project controls and contract administration activities, including contractor payment application review, milestone tracking, variation inputs, and time/cost impact assessment.
* Track critical project controls, including RFIs, technical queries, drawing revisions, submittals, procurement dependencies, risks, costs, variations, and reporting.
* Support HSE leadership on site through toolbox talks, inspections, permit\-to\-work processes, incident reporting, and corrective action follow\-up.
* Conduct quality inspections at key hold points, including piling, racking, DC cabling, AC works, switchgear installation, and inverter commissioning.
* Support commissioning, punch\-list close\-out, handover documentation, and transition to Asset Management and O\&M teams.


 🛠️ What You Must Bring
   

  

**To Be Successful In This Role, You Must Have**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering preferred; Mechanical or Civil Engineering may also be considered.
* Minimum 8 years’ experience in project management or site engineering for EPC/construction projects.
* Minimum 3 years’ experience in solar PV or renewable energy projects.
* Hands\-on experience managing solar PV construction sites, including DC and AC electrical works, mounting structure installation, inverter commissioning, and grid interconnection.
* Strong experience coordinating EPC contractors and project subcontractors, including progress tracking, RFIs, submittals, variation inputs, payment application review, project documentation, and stakeholder communication.
* Practical experience with PVsyst, MS Project or Primavera P6, and AutoCAD.
* Working knowledge of the KSA or regional construction environment, including SEC standards, municipality permit processes, and site safety regulations.
* Willingness to travel regularly to project sites across KSA.


**Strong Advantage**
 We would especially like to hear from candidates who also have:
   

  

* PMP, IPMA Level D/C, or equivalent project management certification.
* Experience delivering C\&I grid\-tied solar PV projects in the 1 MW–20 MW range.
* BESS or hybrid energy project experience.
* Arabic language skills or strong experience working in Arabic\-speaking site environments.


 You’ll Thrive Here If...
   

  

 You are likely to succeed in this role if you are a hands\-on project professional who is comfortable being close to the work, coordinating EPC contractors and site teams with technical credibility, and managing the detail required to deliver high\-quality solar PV projects.
   

  

**You Should Be Someone Who**
* Understands solar PV construction beyond high\-level project coordination.
* Is confident working regularly on project sites, not only from an office or PMO environment.
* Brings discipline in schedules, documentation, RFIs, submittals, variations, inspections, and commissioning records.
* Can track contractor performance, identify risks early, and escalate with practical mitigation options
* Cares deeply about HSE, quality, accountability, and delivery standards.
* Can balance urgency with structure, attention to detail, and collaborative communication.


 🌱 Why Join Us?
   

  

 At Yellow Door Energy, you’ll be part of a leading sustainable energy company delivering real impact across the Middle East and Africa.
   

  

 You’ll work on high\-impact solar PV and clean energy projects, alongside experienced renewable energy professionals, in a culture that values safety, ownership, collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 📩 Apply Now
   

  

 If you are a hands\-on solar PV project professional with strong EPC construction experience and the drive to deliver safe, high\-quality renewable energy projects in KSA, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Let’s lead the charge in sustainable energy solutions together.

data.jd_text:
**About the Company**
 Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
   

  

 Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2\.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70\+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
   

  

***We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem\-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.***
**The mission**
 We believe the transformative potential of AI is significantly under\-realised in our region. To bridge this gap, we are incubating a new division within Careem dedicated to Enterprise AI Transformation.
   

  

 We are reimagining and building the future of work to simplify and improve how businesses function in the era of GenAI with WorkOS: a next\-generation ‘operating system’ designed to deploy, orchestrate, and improve AI agents across every customer and operational journey (and increasingly autonomously). This isn’t just automation; it’s about creating a hybrid workforce where self\-learning AI agents handle the heavy lifting, empowering our people to focus on the highest\-value, most creative work.
   

  

**The team**
 This group operates as a
 **startup within Careem** 
 with a distinct mandate: move fast, build boldly, and deliver production\-grade AI systems that fundamentally change how the region leverages technology.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for a
 **Founding Forward Deployed Engineer \- WorkOS \- Enterprise Agentic AI** 
 to be the vanguard of the WorkOS mission. This is a role for a "heretic": someone who cares more about solving the problem and delivering value than following a rigid spec. You will be the bridge between our core AI engine and the messy, high\-stakes reality of our customers’ operations.
   

  

 As an FDE, you aren't sitting in the back office; you are on the front lines, embedded with internal Careem verticals and external enterprise partners. In partnership with your implementation squad, consisting also of business transformation consultants, you will identify their deepest friction points and build the "special ops" code that proves the power of WorkOS. Your work is the proof of concept that will redefine how the region works.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Tip of the Spear: Lead the deployment of WorkOS in the field. You will be responsible for understanding a customer's operational "chaos" and architecting an AI\-driven solution that fixes it in weeks, not months.
* Rapid\-Fire Execution: Build, iterate, and ship. You will write high\-quality, full\-stack code to create bespoke integrations and augment our platform’s core capabilities and create custom agents. This goes beyond context engineering; you’ll build the connective tissue \- integrating bespoke APIs, setting up RAGs and Evals, tuning the E2E system and performance, and architecting multi\-agent handoffs.
* Feedback Loop Mastery: You are the eyes and ears of the product team. You will translate field\-tested insights into core product requirements, ensuring WorkOS remains grounded in real\-world utility.
* Winning Stakeholders: Act as the technical face of WorkOS. You’ll need to win the trust of stakeholders, navigate complex enterprise hierarchies, and persuade skeptics by shipping results that speak for themselves.
* Technical Versatility: One day you’re setting up a RAG pipeline; the next, you’re debugging a legacy enterprise API or designing a custom dashboard. You do whatever is necessary to make the solution land.


**What You’ll Need**
* 5–8\+ years of high\-octane engineering experience. You are likely a senior\-level engineer who is "hungrier" than your peers and bored by traditional, slow\-moving dev cycles.
* The FDE Pedigree: Experience in forward\-deployed, mission\-driven environments (e.g., Palantir, high\-growth startups, or specialized consultancy) where you worked directly with customers.
* Full\-Stack Polyglot: Mastery of the modern stack (React/TS, Python/Node) with the ability to jump into any codebase and be productive on day one.
* AI Fluidity: Strong working knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, and agentic frameworks. You don't just know the theory; you know how to make AI work in production.
* Excellent Communication: You are a "social engineer." You can explain complex AI logic to a CEO and then pivot to a deep\-dive session with an infrastructure lead without missing a beat.
* Relentless Bias for Action: You are a builder who values shipping over perfection. You have a "founder\-level" sense of ownership and aren't afraid to get your hands dirty.
* Willingness to work on\-site full time in UAE, with occasional travel to be embedded with regional partners.


**What You’ll Receive**
* A Blank Canvas and Live Ammunition: The rare opportunity to build a "0\-to\-1" product while immediately deploying it into the real\-world operations of a regional giant. No "sandbox" projects here, you’ll be shipping code that moves people and goods on day one. This is a huge opportunity to create impact in our region.
* A Special Ops Mission: We’re a lean, impact\-obsessed team operating with total autonomy. You’ll be free from corporate bureaucracy and legacy baggage, focused entirely on winning the customer and solving "unsolvable" problems.
* Direct Collaboration with Leadership: Direct engagement with Careem and enterprise client leadership, in addition to working side\-by\-side with the WorkOS founding team including Magnus Olsson (Careem’s original Co\-founder).


**Competitive Compensation** 
 : Including direct equity in this new division. Our philosophy is meritocratic: we want you to own a meaningful stake in the value you create.
